Such a proxy forwarding to the listener's HTTPS port, re-encrypting, was counted against in the same way, and listing it in WebServicesTrustedProxies did not spare it. The auto-ban is on by default and AutoBanNeverBan, which spares an address, is empty by default; the listener itself went on serving the proxy.

CVE-2026-18767.description: A local low privileged attacker or process can access I/O ports via TcRouter.sys because of exposed IOCTL function calls resulting in a full compromise of the affected devices.

CVE-2026-18768.description: A local low privileged attacker can access arbitrary physical memory or define its mapping via TcRouter.sys because of exposed IOCTL function calls resulting in a full compromise of the affected devices.

CVE-2026-18769.description: A local low privileged attacker can move arbitrary physical memory content via TcRouter.sys because of exposed IOCTL function calls resulting in a full compromise of the affected devices.

CVE-2026-112174.description: Local privilege escalation vulnerability in Iperius Backup 8.8.3, due to insufficient separation between the graphical user interface running with elevated privileges and local users with low privileges. When the backup service is configured to run persistently with Administrator privileges, a local attacker with low privileges can use the native Windows dialogues exposed by the application to run programmes that inherit its elevated context. This allows commands to be executed with SYSTEM or Administrator privileges, depending on the application’s context, and compromises the affected Windows system.

CVE-2026-124250.description: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in AyeCode Ltd GeoDirectory geodirectory allows Reflected XSS.This issue affects GeoDirectory: from n/a through 2.8.202.

CVE-2026-124256.description: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in CodeRockz Delivery & Pickup Date Time for WooCommerce woo-delivery allows Stored XSS.This issue affects Delivery & Pickup Date Time for WooCommerce: from n/a through 1.3.90.

CVE-2026-124257.description: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in wordplus BP Better Messages bp-better-messages allows Stored XSS.This issue affects BP Better Messages: from n/a through 3.2.1.

CVE-2026-124737.description: A flaw was found in BusyBox. When the TFTP (Trivial File Transfer Protocol) client requests a custom small block size and receives a standard response, it falls back to the default block size without resizing the allocated memory buffer. A malicious TFTP server can exploit this issue by sending standard-sized network packets during a transfer, causing a heap buffer overflow. This flaw allows an attacker to achieve arbitrary code execution or cause a Denial of Service (DoS) by crashing the application.

CVE-2026-111792.description: Uncontrolled Recursion vulnerability in Apache XML Graphics Batik. This issue affects Apache XML Graphics Batik: through 1.19. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 1.20, which fixes the issue.

CVE-2026-118965.description: Path traversal in the discovered host label synchronization in Checkmk <2.5.0p19, <2.4.0p40 and 2.3.0 (EOL) allows an attacker in control of a remote site in a distributed monitoring setup to write arbitrary files on the central site and thereby execute code as the central site user.

CVE-2026-120495.description: Path traversal in the Synthetic Monitoring "Robotmk" test service of Checkmk <2.5.0p19, <2.4.0p40, and 2.3.0 (EOL) allows an attacker who controls the agent output of a monitored host's check output for a host to inject a crafted robot output to define the contents and location for the generated HTML log, leading to code execution as the site user.

CVE-2026-121374.description: Argument injection in the Kubernetes special agent in Checkmk <2.5.0p19, <2.4.0p40, and 2.3.0 (EOL) allows a user with permission to edit rules in at least one folder to write files to arbitrary locations writable by the site user via crafted node roles in the "Exclude nodes based on their role" rule option, leading to code execution as the site user.

CVE-2026-123478.description: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Meow Apps AI Engine ai-engine allows Stored XSS.This issue affects AI Engine: from n/a through 3.9.1.

CVE-2026-124253.description: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in codepeople Calculated Fields Form calculated-fields-form allows DOM-Based XSS.This issue affects Calculated Fields Form: from n/a through 5.5.2.8.

CVE-2026-124739.description: A flaw was found in BusyBox. When the httpd web server processes subdirectory configuration files, an overly long index page name can trigger a stack-based buffer overflow. An attacker with permissions to write to a subdirectory configuration file could exploit this vulnerability to execute arbitrary code with elevated privileges or cause a denial of service (DoS) by crashing the server process.

CVE-2026-124741.description: A flaw was found in BusyBox. The udhcpc6 DHCPv6 client does not properly validate the size of network options sent by a server before copying them into memory. A malicious DHCPv6 server on the local network can exploit this flaw by sending a crafted reply, triggering a stack-based buffer overflow. This vulnerability could allow an attacker to achieve arbitrary code execution with root privileges or cause a denial of service (DoS) crash.

CVE-2026-78287.description: Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection') vulnerability in Staggs STAGGS staggs allows Remote Code Inclusion.This issue affects STAGGS: from n/a through 3.3.0.

CVE-2026-90993.description: XXE vulnerability in Apache XML Graphics Batik. This issue affects Apache XML Graphics Batik: through 1.19. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 1.20, which fixes the issue.

CVE-2026-103883.description: The 6Storage Rentals plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Authentication Bypass leading to Administrator Account Takeover in all versions up to, and including, 2.31.0. The vulnerability exists because the `six_storage_portal_registration()` AJAX handler — registered on `wp_ajax_six_storage_portal_plugin_registration` — performs no capability check and no nonce verification before writing the caller-supplied `six_storage_online_api_url` POST parameter to the site-wide option of the same name; the unauthenticated `six_storage_create_wp_user()` handler then redeems a transient seeded from that attacker-controlled URL's response and unconditionally calls `wp_set_current_user()` and `wp_set_auth_cookie()` with no ownership or credential verification. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with Subscriber-level access and above, to authenticate as any existing WordPress user — including any administrator whose email address is known or guessable — resulting in full site compromise. This issue represents an incomplete fix for a prior vulnerability: the 2.29.0 remediation moved the target email out of POST data into a server-side transient, but because any Subscriber can still overwrite the outbound API URL that populates that transient, the full authentication bypass chain remains exploitable in three AJAX requests.

CVE-2026-115600.description: Missing Authorization vulnerability in DEV Institute Restrict User Access – Membership Plugin with Force restrict-user-access allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects Restrict User Access – Membership Plugin with Force: from n/a through 2.8.3.

CVE-2026-119097.description: The Author Image plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'display_name' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 4.9.3 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page.

CVE-2026-119615.description: The Reset Database plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to privilege escalation in versions up to, and including, 1.1.3. This is due to the process_reset() function being registered on admin_init with no capability check, a computed-but-unused nonce, a gating condition that passes whenever no WordPress administrator literally named 'admin' exists (the default on modern installs), and an identity test that verifies the ATTACKER'S OWN password rather than an administrator's. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to drop every prefixed database table, re-run wp_install() with their own credentials — making the attacker the sole site administrator — authenticate as that administrator via wp_set_auth_cookie(), and delete the uploads directory.

CVE-2026-121014.description: Missing Authorization vulnerability in Ahmad WP Job Portal wp-job-portal allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects WP Job Portal: from n/a through 2.7.2.

CVE-2026-121028.description: Improper Neutralization of Script-Related HTML Tags in a Web Page (Basic XSS) vulnerability in WP Chill Strong Testimonials strong-testimonials allows Code Injection.This issue affects Strong Testimonials: from n/a through 3.3.17.

CVE-2026-121574.description: Missing Authorization vulnerability in WP Chill Passster content-protector allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects Passster: from n/a through 4.3.20.

CVE-2026-121770.description: Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) vulnerability in VillaTheme VISeek viseek-easy-custom-search allows Cross Site Request Forgery.This issue affects VISeek: from n/a through 1.0.5.

CVE-2026-121773.description: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in GeneratePress GenerateBlocks generateblocks allows Stored XSS.This issue affects GenerateBlocks: from n/a through 2.5.0.

CVE-2026-122671.description: Missing Authorization vulnerability in E2Pdf.com e2pdf e2pdf allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects e2pdf: from n/a through 1.32.65.

CVE-2026-123473.description: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in weDevs Happy Addons for Elementor happy-elementor-addons allows Stored XSS.This issue affects Happy Addons for Elementor: from n/a through 3.51.0.

CVE-2026-124255.description: Improper Neutralization of Script-Related HTML Tags in a Web Page (Basic XSS) vulnerability in Franky Events Made Easy events-made-easy allows Code Injection.This issue affects Events Made Easy: from n/a through 3.3.5.

CVE-2026-124271.description: Missing Authorization vulnerability in DEV Institute Restrict User Access – Membership Plugin with Force restrict-user-access allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects Restrict User Access – Membership Plugin with Force: from n/a through 2.8.3.

CVE-2026-124408.description: Missing Authorization vulnerability in Arraytics WPCafe wp-cafe allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects WPCafe: from n/a through 3.0.22.

CVE-2026-124413.description: Missing Authorization vulnerability in WP User Manager WP User Manager wp-user-manager allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects WP User Manager: from n/a through 2.10.4.

CVE-2026-124421.description: Missing Authorization vulnerability in BdThemes ZoloBlocks zoloblocks allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects ZoloBlocks: from n/a through 2.8.2.

CVE-2026-124738.description: A flaw was found in BusyBox. When the HTTP daemon (httpd) has pre-compressed file support enabled, authentication checks are evaluated only against the requested URL path rather than the pre-compressed file being served. A remote attacker can exploit this flaw by requesting an uncompressed file path while specifying gzip encoding, bypassing password rules configured specifically for the compressed file. This vulnerability can lead to unauthorized information disclosure of sensitive files.

CVE-2026-124740.description: A flaw was found in BusyBox's udhcpc6 DHCPv6 client. A malicious server on the local network can trigger a use-after-free condition by responding with a crafted Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol for IPv6 (DHCPv6) reply packet lacking usable address options. This issue causes the client to read stale heap memory, which can result in a Denial of Service (DoS) due to an application crash or disclose previously assigned network address data in subsequent discovery requests.

CVE-2026-124742.description: A flaw was found in BusyBox. The volume identification component fails to properly validate cluster parameters when analyzing specially formatted FAT filesystems. An attacker able to present a crafted storage device or disk image can trigger a divide-by-zero condition when partition scanning utilities inspect the volume. This issue causes the probing utilities to crash unexpectedly, resulting in a Denial of Service (DoS) that can disrupt device discovery and system boot operations.

CVE-2026-124743.description: A flaw was found in BusyBox. When processing filesystem metadata, the volume identification component does not properly validate header values in HFS+ filesystems. CVE-2026-126627.description: Creation of Temporary File With Insecure Permissions vulnerability in Apache XML Graphics FOP. This issue affects Apache XML Graphics FOP: through 2.11. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 2.12, which fixes the issue.

CVE-2026-105152.description: Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor in Apache Roller 4.0 through 6.1.6 allows a weblog administrator to read another user's stored password hash by authoring a custom weblog template that reaches the wrapped persistent object behind the template's weblog or entry data, rather than the reduced set of fields the wrapper is meant to expose. Roller treats weblog administrators as untrusted and exposes weblog and entry data to templates only through wrapper classes, but a public accessor on those wrapper classes returned the underlying persistent object directly, including the stored password hash of the weblog's creator and of any author whose entry renders on the page. No non-default configuration is required; this affects any weblog whose administrator can author templates. Users are recommended to upgrade to Apache Roller 6.1.7 or later, which removes template access to the underlying wrapped objects.

CVE-2026-105153.description: Improper Restriction of XML External Entity Reference in Apache Roller 4.0 through 6.1.6 allows an authenticated user with no weblog permissions to read files readable by the Roller process and cause the server to issue outbound HTTP requests to attacker-chosen destinations, by submitting a crafted Atom entry to the AtomPub endpoint. The entry body is parsed with a parser configuration that permits external parameter entities and external DTD subsets, and the parse happens before any per-weblog authorization check and before any check of whether the AtomPub feature is enabled, so the endpoint is reachable by any authenticated account on a default installation. Users are recommended to upgrade to Apache Roller 6.1.7 or later, which parses AtomPub entries with a hardened XML configuration and rejects AtomPub requests while the feature is disabled.

CVE-2026-105154.description: Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) in the Planet feed aggregator administration of Apache Roller 4.0 through 6.1.6 allows an unauthenticated attacker to make the Roller server fetch a URL the attacker chooses, including internal addresses, by inducing a logged-in global administrator to open a crafted web page. The action that adds a Planet subscription can be triggered cross-site; in recent releases it accepts GET requests, which Roller's CSRF token check does not cover. The action fetches the supplied URL and saves the subscription, and any fetched content that parses as a feed is then published without authentication in the aggregated Planet feed. The Planet aggregator is enabled by default. Users are recommended to upgrade to Apache Roller 6.1.7 or later, which requires POST requests with a valid CSRF token for Planet administration changes and turns the Planet aggregator off by default.

CVE-2026-108338.description: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') in Apache Roller 5.0.1 through 6.1.6 allows an authenticated user with the Author role on a weblog to store script in entry tags submitted through AtomPub. Roller's tag filter allowed HTML characters in tag names, and the bundled gaurav, fauxcoly and frontpage themes and the showEntryTags macro print tag names without escaping, so the script runs in the browser of anyone who views the weblog. This matters when weblog authors are not trusted with script (weblogAdminsUntrusted=true, the default since 6.1.4). AtomPub is disabled by default. Users are recommended to upgrade to Apache Roller 6.1.7 or later, which removes HTML characters from tag names, including names stored earlier.

CVE-2026-111824.description: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') in Apache Roller 6.1.6 allows an authenticated user with the Author role on a weblog that uses a custom theme to store script that runs in the browser of anyone who opens the file's resource URL. The fix for CVE-2026-82387 serves uploaded media as a download unless it is an image, audio, video, PDF or plain text, but media files found through a custom theme were served with the type their path implies, and the upload form let the uploader choose that path. Media uploads are disabled by default. Users are recommended to upgrade to Apache Roller 6.1.7 or later, which serves these files under the same rules as other media and no longer accepts the path from the upload form.

CVE-2026-112201.description: A flaw was found in the login-failure storage component of Keycloak, the identity and access management solution. This issue specifically affects deployments using MySQL or MariaDB databases in a multi-node configuration. When multiple failed login attempts occur simultaneously for the same account, a synchronization error can cause the system to enter a repetitive loop that locks the user's record in the database. This results in legitimate login attempts for that user being blocked and failing with an error. Furthermore, because some failures are not correctly recorded during this loop, the system's brute-force protection may not accurately count all failed attempts.

CVE-2026-118405.description: Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor in Apache Roller 4.0 through 6.1.6 allows any logged-in user to learn other users' email addresses. The user search in the authoring interface shows only user names, but it also matched the search text against email addresses, so a user could confirm an address one character at a time. Users are recommended to upgrade to Apache Roller 6.1.7 or later, which matches only user names for users who are not administrators.

CVE-2026-118408.description: Missing Authorization in Apache Roller 4.0 through 6.1.6 allows any logged-in user to read unpublished entries of a weblog they have no role in. The entry preview checked that the user was logged in, but not that the user had a role in the weblog being previewed. The attacker must know the weblog name and the entry's link name. Users are recommended to upgrade to Apache Roller 6.1.7 or later, which requires a role in the weblog to preview its entries.

CVE-2026-118409.description: Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor in Apache Roller 4.0 through 6.1.6 allows an unauthenticated visitor to recover the email addresses of people who left approved comments. The search index stored commenter email addresses, and the public weblog search accepted queries on that field, including wildcard queries that confirm an address one character at a time. Users are recommended to upgrade to Apache Roller 6.1.7 or later and rebuild the search index.

CVE-2026-118410.description: Exposure of Resource to Wrong Sphere in Apache Roller 4.0 through 6.1.6 allows an unauthenticated visitor to read an entry after its author has withdrawn it to draft through the AtomPub API. The entry was removed from the weblog but stayed in the search index, and public search showed its content. AtomPub is disabled by default. Users are recommended to upgrade to Apache Roller 6.1.7 or later, which shows only published entries in search results.

CVE-2026-118411.description: Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) in Apache Roller 5.0.1 through 6.1.6 allows an unauthenticated attacker to create an administrator account if a logged-in Roller administrator opens a link that the attacker controls. The request-token check applied only to POST requests, and administrative actions also accepted GET requests. Users are recommended to upgrade to Apache Roller 6.1.7 or later, which requires POST and a valid token for actions that change data.

CVE-2026-118412.description: Improper Authentication in Apache Roller 5.1.0 through 6.1.6 allows a user whose account an administrator has disabled to sign in again through OpenID and read unpublished entries. The OpenID sign-in path did not check whether the account was enabled. Only sites that enable the non-default OpenID authentication mode are affected; later major versions do not include OpenID 2.0. Users are recommended to upgrade to Apache Roller 6.1.7 or later.

CVE-2026-118413.description: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') in Apache Roller 4.0 through 6.1.6 allows a weblog administrator to store script that runs in the browsers of the weblog's visitors. Blogroll links imported from an OPML file were not checked, and the default theme printed them without escaping. Users are recommended to upgrade to Apache Roller 6.1.7 or later, which accepts only web links on import and escapes them on output.

CVE-2026-118414.description: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') in Apache Roller 6.1.2 through 6.1.6 allows a weblog administrator to store script that runs in the browsers of the weblog's members when they open their main menu. The HTML-stripping routine kept a tag that was not closed, and the main menu printed the weblog description without escaping. Users are recommended to upgrade to Apache Roller 6.1.7 or later.

CVE-2026-122096.description: Uncontrolled Resource Consumption vulnerability in the sketch deserialization of Apache DataSketches Java. Several deserializers trusted sizes and counts declared in the serialized input. A small crafted input could make an application allocate an excessive amount of memory, leading to an OutOfMemoryError. A crafted string passed to FrequentLongsSketch.getInstance(String) could also make deserialization, or a later update, loop indefinitely. Only applications that deserialize sketches from untrusted sources are affected. This issue affects Apache DataSketches Java: through 9.0.0. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 9.1.0, which fixes the issue.

CVE-2026-122300.description: Missing Authorization vulnerability in Apache Roller 4.0 through 6.1.6 allows a weblog member with the Limited role to remove or change entries that member may only read, including entries published by other members. The entry editor checked the member's weblog role but not whether that role permits work on the entry. Users are recommended to upgrade to Apache Roller 6.1.7 or later.

CVE-2026-123374.description: Deserialization of Untrusted Data vulnerability in Apache Roller. When Roller sends a weblog update ping, its XML-RPC client deserializes Java object data contained in the ping target's response, so a party that controls that response can run code in the Roller server process. This issue affects Apache Roller from 4.0 through 6.1.6. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 6.1.7, which removes the unsafe deserialization.

When extracting an archive, the tar utility improperly resolves deferred hardlink targets across symbolic links pointing outside the intended extraction directory. CVE-2026-126537.description: The Ninja Forms - File Uploads add-on for WordPress is vulnerable to Arbitrary File Deletion (and arbitrary file read via S3/Dropbox/Google Drive exfiltration) in versions up to, and including, 3.3.36. The flaw spans NF_FU_Fields_Upload::process() in includes/fields/upload.php — which returns early (leaving the client-supplied files[] intact) whenever a public submission carries a nonempty extra.saveProgress — and NF_FU_External_Abstracts_Service::process_upload() in includes/external/abstracts/service.php, whose authoritative-path reload only fires when the client sends upload_id. By omitting upload_id, an attacker's data[file_path] survives into the Background Upload queue and is used by both upload_file_to_s3() (as SourceFile) and the maybe_delete_server_file() unlink() call in includes/external/abstracts/backgroundupload.php, with no canonicalization or upload-directory containment check (the plugin's own is_path_within_upload_dir() helper is only applied on admin paths). This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to delete arbitrary files on the affected site's server which may make remote code execution possible — specifically, deleting wp-config.php forces WordPress into its setup screen, enabling full site takeover.

CVE-2026-126658.description: ByteStash 1.5.10 before 1.6.2 contains an insufficient session expiration vulnerability that allows holders of API keys to keep access after account deactivation because validateApiKey never checks account status. Attackers holding a deactivated account's API key can read, create, modify and delete its snippets via /api/snippets and use every MCP tool via /mcp.

CVE-2026-126659.description: BlueprintUE Self-Hosted Edition 1.0.0 before 4.3.5 contains a resource exhaustion vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to fill server storage by repeatedly creating anonymous blueprints. Attackers can send large requests to HomeController::doProcessCreateBlueprint() with a 'never' expiration, bypassing purges to fill the disk and deny service.

CVE-2026-126662.description: Contao 4.0.0 before 5.3.54, 5.4.0 before 5.7.17, and 6.0.0 before 6.0.6 contains an access control bypass vulnerability that allows filemount-restricted backend users to modify folders outside their filemount via the file manager Edit-Multiple operation. Attackers holding the protected or syncExclude field permission can submit outside folder paths in the IDS parameter to publish protected folders or exclude them from DBAFS synchronization, exposing files for public download.

CVE-2026-126663.description: Contao 4.0.0 before 5.3.54, 5.4.0 before 5.7.17, and 6.0.0 before 6.0.6 contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows content editors to read image files anywhere on the filesystem via the {{image::}} insert tag. Attackers can embed percent-encoded sequences like ..%2f that pass Validator::isInsecurePath() before rawurldecode(), making the frontend resize and serve readable image files outside the files directory.

Users are recommended to upgrade to version 3.2.0, which fixes the issue.

553beba81ca130375ee4212c.title_ko: 앤트로픽, '클로드 페이블 5.2' 프롬프트 가이드 공개…코드 소유권 표현 중요성 강조
553beba81ca130375ee4212c.summary_ko: 앤트로픽이 최신 모델 '클로드 페이블 5.2'의 성능을 최적화하기 위한 프롬프트 작성법을 공개했습니다. 실험 결과, 코드 소유권을 명시하는 문구를 추가했을 때 AI의 코드 통합 능력이 대폭 향상되었으나 출력 토큰 증가 등 부작용도 확인되어 상황에 맞는 지침 사용이 권장됩니다.

cbaae3b5c6766189e92eb11d.title_ko: Openwave 및 Cisco BroadWorks 취약점 악용 사례 발견
cbaae3b5c6766189e92eb11d.summary_ko: Openwave Webtop Media Transcoder(CVE-2026-111793)와 Cisco BroadWorks(CVE-2026-20320)의 취약점이 실제 공격에 악용되고 있습니다. CISA는 연방 기관들에 해당 취약점의 보안 패치를 11월 24일까지 완료할 것을 지시했습니다.

d585c23c65b7301c4ba77dfa.title_ko: 구글, '제미나이 로보틱스 2.5' 공개…자동차 공장 작업 성공률 96% 달성
d585c23c65b7301c4ba77dfa.summary_ko: 구글 딥마인드가 물리적 AI 모델 '제미나이 로보틱스 2.5'를 발표했습니다. 실제 자동차 생산라인에서 휴머노이드 로봇 '아폴로 2'를 통해 정교한 조립 준비 작업을 수행한 결과 96%의 성공률을 기록하며 산업 현장 적용 가능성을 확인했습니다.

5c25f2143f054556d9ba621c.title_ko: 메타, AI 에이전트 '뮤즈' 웨어러블 기기 확장
5c25f2143f054556d9ba621c.summary_ko: 메타가 AI 에이전트 서비스 '뮤즈'를 애플워치와 구글 웨어OS 지원 기기로 확대했다. 사용자는 스마트워치에서 음성이나 텍스트로 클라우드 기반 AI에 작업을 요청하고 결과를 확인할 수 있으며, 기존 스마트폰과 태블릿에 이어 일상적인 서비스 접점을 넓히고 있다.

5258950be18c9ee67bc2c1cd.title_original: [금보원 해킹-3] 금융보안원 해킹, 위탁한 금융위원회도 책임 면할 수 없다…상시평가 감독 책임도 따져야
5258950be18c9ee67bc2c1cd.excerpt: 금융보안원의 정보보호 상시평가 시스템이 해킹돼 금융회사가 제출한 행정서식과 개인정보 등이 유출됐다. 금융보안원은 11월 9일 오후 3시께 외부의 비정상적인 접근에 따른 유출을 확인해 접속을 차단했다고 밝혔다. 10일자 발표에서 확인한 유출 내역은 행정서식 약 200건, 서식에 포함된 개인정보 300여 건, 시스템 이용자 정보 350여 건이다. 금융보안원은 금융회사 시스템 구성도 등 보안정보는 유출되지 않았다고 밝혔다. 데일리시큐가 앞서 확보한 내용에 따르면 금융보안원 측은 내부자료 유출이 확인된 금융회사에 우선 연락했다고 설명했다.

18b9f03239e48bd8877fb903.title_original: Isolation Is Not Confidentiality: Security Boundaries of Geometric Access Control in RAG
18b9f03239e48bd8877fb903.excerpt: arXiv:2611.14061v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems increasingly rely on vector databases containing documents governed by different access-control policies. Recent search-preserving geometric approaches enforce such access control by structuring the embedding space so that transformed embeddings, which we call protected representations, remain retrievable without exposing information across policy boundaries. We provide a unified security analysis of this paradigm, covering policy isolation, representation confidentiality, query forgery resistance, and policy-membership hiding. We consider both a curious cloud service provider observing the protected representations stored in the vector database and a curious user holding aligned pairs of original embeddings and protected representations. Evaluating the available implementations of the works proposing these geometric transformation mechanisms across three encoders, we find that geometric transformations preserve retrieval utility and provide strong policy isolation, but do not provide the other security properties. A curious user can recover the original embeddings from a few hundred pairs and forge policy-compatible queries at a higher cost that grows with encoder dimension for secret per-policy transformations. 3ce9880ffbf9d326d2103590.title_original: 미 주요 은행 이어 항공사도 AI 에이전트 차단…거래·보안 통제 강화
3ce9880ffbf9d326d2103590.excerpt: 미국 주요 은행에 이어 항공사도 외부 AI 에이전트의 시스템 접근과 거래를 제한하기 시작했다. AI가 이용자를 대신해 금융거래와 항공권 예약까지 수행하면서 개인정보 유출과 의도하지 않은 결제 문제가 제기되자, 기업들이 고객 계정과 거래에 대한 통제를 강화하고 있다.유나이티드항공은 11일(현지시간) 승인받지 않은 외부 AI 에이전트가 자사 웹사이트와 앱에서 항공권 예약이나 고객 계정 관리 등의 작업을 수행하지 못하도록 제한하겠다고 밝혔다. 여행사와 예약 중개 플랫폼을 통한 간접적인 접근도 제한하기 위해 예약·발권·유통 정책을 변경할
3ce9880ffbf9d326d2103590.title_ko: 유나이티드항공, 승인되지 않은 AI 에이전트의 예약·계정 접근 제한
3ce9880ffbf9d326d2103590.summary_ko: 유나이티드항공은 승인받지 않은 외부 AI 에이전트가 웹사이트와 앱에서 예약·결제·계정 관리 등을 하지 못하도록 제한하고 관련 정책도 바꾸겠다고 밝혔다. 항공편 검색과 요금 비교는 가능하지만 실제 예약은 제한하며, 개인정보 노출과 의도하지 않은 결제·예약 변경 위험을 이유로 들었다.

curation.reason_ko: 유나이티드항공이 예약·계정 접근에 외부 AI 에이전트 제한을 추진한다고 밝혔다.

af032134479622afa902c19a.title_original: 앤트로픽, 클로드 오피스 출시…IPO 앞두고 MS·구글과 경쟁
af032134479622afa902c19a.excerpt: 앤트로픽이 클로드 안에서 스프레드시트와 화이트보드를 만들고 공동 편집하며, 화상회의 중에도 업무를 처리할 수 있는 기능을 선보였다. 기존 마이크로소프트(MS) 오피스나 구글 워크스페이스에서 수행하던 업무를 클로드 자체에서 처리하도록 해 기업용 소프트웨어 시장에서 직접 경쟁에 나선 것이다.앤트로픽은 10일(현지시간) 공식 블로그를 통해 협업용 '클로드 화이트보드(Claude Whiteboards)', 스프레드시트 도구 '클로드 시트(Claude Sheets)', 데이터 분석 플랫폼 '클로드 데이터(Claude Data)'를 공개했다.
af032134479622afa902c19a.title_ko: 앤트로픽, 클로드 오피스 기능 공개…MS·구글과 경쟁
af032134479622afa902c19a.summary_ko: 앤트로픽은 협업용 화이트보드, 스프레드시트, 데이터 분석 도구와 회의 중 업무를 수행하는 클로드 미팅을 공개했다. 화이트보드와 시트는 유료 사용자 대상 베타로 제공되며, 미팅은 팀·엔터프라이즈 고객의 구글 미트에서 베타 서비스 중이다. 클로드를 업무 플랫폼으로 확장해 오피스 소프트웨어 시장에 진출하려는 움직임이다.

curation.reason_ko: 앤트로픽이 문서·데이터 작업 도구를 공개하며 클로드를 업무 플랫폼으로 확장했다.

35239f869c8b05eea09c1344.title_original: 미니맥스, 4K 이미지 약 10초에 생성하는 'H3-이미지' 공개…가중치도 배포
35239f869c8b05eea09c1344.excerpt: 중국 AI 기업 미니맥스(MiniMax)가 4K 이미지를 약 10초 만에 생성하는 오픈웨이트 모델 'H3-이미지(H3-Image)'를 출시했다. 하나의 모델로 이미지 생성과 편집을 처리하고 최대 16장의 참조 이미지를 활용할 수 있는 것이 특징이다.미니맥스는 11일 공식 발표를 통해 H3-이미지를 공개하고, 모델 가중치와 관련 코드를 허깅페이스와 깃허브에 배포했다고 밝혔다. 미니맥스 API와 AI 개발 도구 '미니맥스 코드(MiniMax Code)', 영상·이미지 생성 서비스 '하이뤄 AI(Hailuo AI)'에서도 이용할 수 있다
35239f869c8b05eea09c1344.title_ko: 미니맥스, 4K 이미지 생성 모델 H3-이미지 공개…가중치 배포
35239f869c8b05eea09c1344.summary_ko: 미니맥스는 4K 이미지를 고속 모드에서 약 10초에 생성하고, 최대 16장의 참조 이미지를 활용해 편집할 수 있는 오픈웨이트 모델 H3-이미지를 공개했다. 가중치와 코드를 배포했지만 한국 등 일부 지역은 기본 커뮤니티 라이선스 대상에서 제외돼 직접 사용·배포에 별도 허가가 필요하다.
35239f869c8b05eea09c1344.background_ko: H3-이미지는 앞서 공개된 멀티모달 생성 모델 H3를 바탕으로 데이터 구성과 강화학습 등 후속학습을 개선하고 샘플링 단계를 6회로 줄여 개발됐다.

curation.reason_ko: 미니맥스가 이미지 생성·편집 모델의 가중치와 코드를 공개했지만 지역별 라이선스 제한이 있다.

d4563c6df9d8f73f778dcfa9.summary_ko: 대한민국 국민 누구나 개인 또는 10명 이내 팀으로 참가할 수 있으며, AI 게임·시나리오·영상 부문을 모집합니다. 접수 기간은 2026년 10월 12일부터 11월 22일까지이고, 조달청 또는 조달정책을 주제로 하며 AI 시나리오는 ‘2050년 미래의 조달청’을 다룹니다.

curation.reason_ko: 대한민국 국민이 참여할 수 있는 AI 게임·콘텐츠 공모전으로 접수 마감은 11월 22일이다.

0c6d47913b4605786e68dc76.title_ko: AI, 실제 프리랜서 프로젝트 41.3%서 전문가 수준 수행
0c6d47913b4605786e68dc76.summary_ko: 미국 AI 안전센터와 스케일 AI의 원격 노동 지수 최신 평가에서 AI 결과물이 전문가와 동등하거나 더 낫다고 인정된 실제 프리랜서 프로젝트 비율은 최고 41.3%였다. 평가에는 240개 프로젝트가 포함됐다. 이 수치는 일자리 41.3%가 사라진다는 뜻은 아니며, 고객 소통과 팀 협업 등은 평가하지 않았다.
0c6d47913b4605786e68dc76.background_ko: 원격 노동 지수는 실제 전문가 프로젝트를 바탕으로 AI 에이전트의 실무 수행 역량을 평가하는 지표로 만들어졌다.

curation.reason_ko: 평가 지표에서 AI 에이전트의 실무 수행 비중이 크게 상승했다는 분석이 나왔다.

2cdb5f24496c894dc15c7641.title_ko: MOAI: 비대화형 보안 트랜스포머 추론을 위한 모듈 최적화 아키텍처
2cdb5f24496c894dc15c7641.summary_ko: 연구진은 동형암호 기반 비대화형 트랜스포머 추론 구조 MOAI를 제안했다. 초록에 따르면 회전 연산을 줄여 BERT-base에서 기존 방식보다 동형암호 회전 수가 최소 1.7배 적고, THOR 대비 평가 시간이 52.8% 감소했으며 Powerformer 적용에서도 55.7% 감소했다고 보고했다.
2cdb5f24496c894dc15c7641.background_ko: 클라우드에서 LLM 추론 시 개인정보 우려가 제기됐고, 동형암호는 해결책으로 거론되지만 계산 부담이 큰 점이 연구 배경이다.

curation.reason_ko: 논문은 암호화된 입력으로 트랜스포머 추론을 수행하는 기법의 효율 개선을 보고했다.

806755bd7b4d0b3fcb2ed0ca.title_ko: 미 제재 중국 군 관련 대학, 엔비디아 H200 구매…서버 임대로도 확보
806755bd7b4d0b3fcb2ed0ca.summary_ko: 로이터가 확인한 조달 기록에 따르면 서북공업대는 중국 업체를 통해 H200 2개를 구매했고, H200 8개가 탑재된 서버 임대 계약도 체결했다. 다만 구매 칩의 실제 사용 목적과 유통 경로는 확인되지 않았으며, 서버 계약은 AI 모델 미세조정·강화학습용으로 기재돼 수출통제의 허점 논란이 제기됐다.
806755bd7b4d0b3fcb2ed0ca.background_ko: 서북공업대학은 미사일 확산 및 군사 연구 관여를 이유로 2001년 미국 거래제한기업목록에 올랐고 2019년 제재가 강화됐다.

curation.reason_ko: 미국 제재 대상 중국 대학의 H200 구매 보도로 AI 반도체 수출 통제의 허점이 제기됐다.

hot.reason_ko: 실제 공격 악용이 확인된 Chrome 취약점에 보안 업데이트가 배포돼 이용자 영향이 크다.
인증 우회 취약점이 실제 악용돼 관리자 권한과 연결된 XCP-ng 호스트 root 권한까지 노릴 수 있다.
CISA가 실제 악용 취약점으로 지정했으며 로그인 없이 민감한 설정 파일에 접근할 수 있다.
마이크로소프트가 치명적 결함과 RCE를 포함한 1,235개 취약점을 수정해 영향 범위가 넓다.
국내 금융보안 평가 시스템이 해킹돼 금융회사 제출 자료와 이용자 개인정보가 유출됐다.
SGLang 원격 코드 실행 취약점이 악용돼 서버와 사용자 계정·AI 대화 기록이 유출됐다.
빌드 인프라 침해로 소스 코드와 고객 환경 변수에 접근했고 최대 10만 워크스페이스가 영향권이다.
일본 니토리에서 최대 약 3,762만 건의 개인정보 유출 가능성이 제기돼 규모가 크다.
탈취된 Qubole IAM 자격 증명으로 고객 AWS 환경에 침입해 데이터와 비밀 정보를 탈취했다.
ScreenConnect 공격으로 MSP 6곳과 47개 조직의 엔드포인트 286대 이상이 영향을 받았다.

CVE-2026-126262.description: A improper neutralization of special elements used in an sql command ('sql injection') vulnerability in Fortinet FortiAnalyzer 8.0.0 through 8.0.1, FortiAnalyzer 7.6.0 through 7.6.7, FortiAnalyzer 7.4.0 through 7.4.11, FortiAnalyzer 7.2.0 through 7.2.12, FortiManager 8.0.0, FortiManager 7.6.0 through 7.6.7, FortiManager 7.4.0 through 7.4.11, FortiManager 7.2.0 through 7.2.12 may allow an unauthenticated attacker who has access to the oftp port to execute code or command on the system via crafted OFTP packets.
CVE-2026-126262.summary_ko: FortiAnalyzer 및 FortiManager의 SQL 인젝션 취약점으로, OFTP 포트에 접근 가능한 인증되지 않은 공격자가 조작된 OFTP 패킷을 통해 시스템에서 코드나 명령을 실행할 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: FortiAnalyzer와 FortiManager의 OFTP 처리 결함으로 비인증 코드 실행이 가능합니다.

CVE-2026-126259.description: A missing authentication for critical function vulnerability in Fortinet FortiOS 8.0.0, FortiOS 7.6.0 through 7.6.7, FortiOS 7.4.0 through 7.4.12, FortiOS 7.2.0 through 7.2.13 may allow an unauthenticated attacker with HA FGSP + standalone-config-sync, or autoscale to execute command as super admin via crafted HA packets.
CVE-2026-126259.summary_ko: FortiOS의 중요 기능에 인증이 누락된 취약점입니다. 특정 HA 구성 또는 오토스케일 환경에서 인증되지 않은 공격자가 조작된 HA 패킷으로 슈퍼 관리자 권한의 명령을 실행할 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: 특정 FortiOS 구성에서 인증 없이 슈퍼 관리자 권한 명령을 실행할 수 있습니다.

CVE-2026-126147.description: A improper limitation of a pathname to a restricted directory ('path traversal') vulnerability in Fortinet FortiMail 8.0.0 through 8.0.1, FortiMail 7.6.0 through 7.6.6, FortiMail 7.4.0 through 7.4.8, FortiMail 7.2 all versions may allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute unauthorized code or commands via crafted requests.
CVE-2026-126147.summary_ko: FortiMail의 경로 순회 취약점으로, 인증되지 않은 공격자가 조작된 요청을 통해 허가되지 않은 코드나 명령을 실행할 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: FortiMail의 경로 순회로 비인증 공격자가 코드나 명령을 실행할 수 있습니다.

CVE-2026-126148.description: A improper neutralization of special elements used in an os command ('os command injection') vulnerability in Fortinet FortiMail 8.0.0 through 8.0.1, FortiMail 7.6.0 through 7.6.6 may allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute unauthorized code or commands via crafted HA join-request packets.
CVE-2026-126148.summary_ko: Fortinet FortiMail에서 OS 명령어 삽입 취약점이 발견되었습니다. 인증되지 않은 공격자가 조작된 HA 가입 요청 패킷을 전송하여 무단 코드나 명령어를 실행할 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: FortiMail의 HA 가입 요청 처리에서 비인증 OS 명령 실행이 가능합니다.

CVE-2026-126164.description: A improper neutralization of special elements used in an sql command ('sql injection') vulnerability in Fortinet FortiMail 8.0.0 through 8.0.1, FortiMail 7.6.0 through 7.6.6, FortiMail 7.4.0 through 7.4.8, FortiMail 7.2 all versions may allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute unauthorized code or commands via crafted requests.
CVE-2026-126164.summary_ko: FortiMail의 SQL 인젝션 취약점으로, 인증되지 않은 공격자가 조작된 요청을 통해 허가되지 않은 코드나 명령을 실행할 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: FortiMail의 SQL 인젝션으로 비인증 코드나 명령 실행이 가능합니다.

CVE-2026-126170.description: A improper encoding or escaping of output vulnerability in Fortinet FortiAnalyzer 8.0.0 through 8.0.2, FortiAnalyzer 7.6.0 through 7.6.7, FortiAnalyzer Cloud 8.0.1 through 8.0.2, FortiAnalyzer Cloud 7.6.0 through 7.6.7, FortiAnalyzer-BigData 7.6.0 through 7.6.2, FortiManager 8.0.0 through 8.0.2, FortiManager 7.6.0 through 7.6.7, FortiManager Cloud 8.0.1 through 8.0.2, FortiManager Cloud 7.6.0 through 7.6.7 may allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute unauthorized code or commands via a specially crafted HTTP request
CVE-2026-126170.summary_ko: FortiAnalyzer, FortiAnalyzer Cloud, FortiAnalyzer-BigData, FortiManager 및 FortiManager Cloud의 출력 인코딩 취약점으로, 인증되지 않은 공격자가 조작된 HTTP 요청을 통해 허가되지 않은 코드나 명령을 실행할 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: Fortinet 관리 제품의 HTTP 요청 처리 결함으로 비인증 코드나 명령 실행이 가능합니다.

CVE-2026-126150.description: A weak password recovery mechanism for forgotten password vulnerability in Fortinet FortiMail 8.0.0, FortiMail 7.6.0 through 7.6.5, FortiMail 7.4.0 through 7.4.7, FortiMail 7.2.0 through 7.2.9 may allow an unauthenticated attacker to reset the password of an arbitrary IBE webmail user and take over their account via specially crafted HTTP requests.
CVE-2026-126150.summary_ko: Fortinet FortiMail의 취약한 비밀번호 복구 기능으로 비인증 공격자가 임의의 IBE 웹메일 사용자 비밀번호를 재설정하고 계정을 탈취할 수 있다.

curation.reason_ko: FortiMail의 비밀번호 복구 취약점으로 IBE 웹메일 계정을 탈취할 수 있습니다.

CVE-2026-126155.description: A incorrect authorization vulnerability in Fortinet FortiMail 8.0.0 through 8.0.1, FortiMail 7.6.0 through 7.6.6, FortiMail 7.4.0 through 7.4.8, FortiMail 7.2 all versions may allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to obtain an authenticated IBE webmail session as any IBE recipient and read or send their encrypted mail via crafted HTTP requests.
CVE-2026-126155.summary_ko: Fortinet FortiMail의 잘못된 권한 부여 취약점으로 비인증 원격 공격자가 임의의 IBE 수신자 인증 세션을 얻어 암호화된 메일을 읽거나 보낼 수 있다.

curation.reason_ko: FortiMail에서 비인증 공격자가 IBE 수신자의 메일 세션을 얻을 수 있습니다.

CVE-2026-126229.description: A authorization bypass through user-controlled key vulnerability in Fortinet FortiAnalyzer 8.0.0 through 8.0.1, FortiAnalyzer 7.6.0 through 7.6.7, FortiAnalyzer 7.4.0 through 7.4.11, FortiAnalyzer 7.2 all versions, FortiAnalyzer Cloud 8.0.1, FortiAnalyzer Cloud 7.6.0 through 7.6.7, FortiAnalyzer Cloud 7.4.1 through 7.4.11, FortiAnalyzer Cloud 7.2 all versions, FortiManager 8.0.0 through 8.0.1, FortiManager 7.6.0 through 7.6.7, FortiManager 7.4.0 through 7.4.11, FortiManager 7.2 all versions, FortiManager Cloud 8.0.1, FortiManager Cloud 7.6.0 through 7.6.7, FortiManager Cloud 7.4.1 through 7.4.11, FortiManager Cloud 7.2 all versions may allow an authenticated administrator to access to other VDOMs via specially crafted HTTP requests.
CVE-2026-126229.summary_ko: Fortinet FortiAnalyzer 및 FortiManager 제품의 권한 우회 취약점으로, 인증된 관리자가 다른 VDOM에 접근할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-126229.background_ko: 사용자 제어 키를 통한 권한 우회가 원인이다.

curation.reason_ko: FortiAnalyzer와 FortiManager에서 다른 VDOM에 접근할 수 있는 권한 우회입니다.

CVE-2026-126251.description: A incorrect authorization vulnerability in Fortinet FortiAuthenticator 8.0.0 through 8.0.3, FortiAuthenticator 6.6.0 through 6.6.10 may allow an attacker to bypass authentication and gain unauthorized access.
CVE-2026-126251.summary_ko: FortiAuthenticator의 잘못된 권한 부여 취약점으로, 공격자가 인증을 우회해 허가되지 않은 접근 권한을 얻을 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: FortiAuthenticator의 인증 우회로 허가되지 않은 접근이 가능합니다.

CVE-2026-126254.description: A numeric truncation error vulnerability in Fortinet FortiOS 8.0.0 through 8.0.1, FortiOS 7.6.0 through 7.6.7, FortiOS 7.4.0 through 7.4.12, FortiOS 7.2.0 through 7.2.13 may allow a configured ibgp neighbor to send malicious/malformed attributes to all connected routers via a specially crafted request
CVE-2026-126254.summary_ko: Fortinet FortiOS의 숫자 절단 오류 취약점으로, 설정된 iBGP 이웃이 악성 또는 잘못된 속성을 연결된 모든 라우터에 보낼 수 있다.

curation.reason_ko: FortiOS의 iBGP 처리 결함으로 연결된 라우터에 악성 속성을 전파할 수 있습니다.

CVE-2026-123710.description: A flaw was found in Red Hat Quay. An unauthenticated client can obtain an anonymous registry token with an audience it controls, present that token to the service key rotation endpoint, and install its own approved signing key with no expiry. Registry tokens signed with that key are accepted for any repository, allowing read and write access to private images and replacement of repository tags.
CVE-2026-123710.summary_ko: Red Hat Quay의 레지스트리 토큰 처리 결함입니다. 인증되지 않은 클라이언트가 임의의 서명 키를 등록하여 사설 이미지에 대한 읽기 및 쓰기 권한을 얻고 태그를 교체할 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: Red Hat Quay의 서명 키 취약점으로 사설 이미지의 읽기·쓰기와 태그 변경이 가능합니다.

CVE-2026-110697.description: A flaw was found in Quay where the robot account listing function constructs a SQL LIKE pattern from user-controlled namespace names without escaping wildcard metacharacters. An attacker who creates a namespace containing an underscore character can match and retrieve robot accounts and their decrypted authentication tokens from other tenants' namespaces, leading to cross-tenant credential theft and unauthorized image operations.
CVE-2026-110697.summary_ko: Quay의 로봇 계정 목록 기능에서 SQL LIKE 패턴 생성 시 와일드카드를 적절히 처리하지 않아 발생하는 취약점입니다. 공격자가 특정 네임스페이스를 생성하여 타 테넌트의 로봇 계정 정보와 복호화된 인증 토큰을 탈취하고 무단 이미지 작업을 수행할 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: Quay의 취약점으로 다른 테넌트의 로봇 계정 토큰을 탈취할 수 있습니다.

CVE-2026-119618.description: Concurrent Execution using Shared Resource with Improper Synchronization vulnerability in Apache HTTP Server's mod_http2 in assign_headers() can lead to RCE. This issue affects Apache HTTP Server: from 2.4.55 through 2.4.70. Affected releases of mod_h2 from GitHub: from 2.0.8 through 2.0.42.
CVE-2026-119618.summary_ko: Apache HTTP Server의 mod_http2에서 공유 자원 동기화 오류로 발생하는 원격 코드 실행 취약점입니다. 헤더 할당 과정에서의 결함이 영향을 미칩니다.

curation.reason_ko: Apache HTTP Server mod_http2의 동기화 결함이 원격 코드 실행으로 이어질 수 있습니다.

CVE-2026-126325.description: A critical remote code execution (RCE) vulnerability has been reported in PTC Windchill and PTC FlexPLM. The vulnerability may be exploited through the deserialization of untrusted data.
CVE-2026-126325.summary_ko: PTC Windchill 및 FlexPLM에서 발생하는 치명적인 원격 코드 실행 취약점입니다. 신뢰할 수 없는 데이터의 역직렬화 과정을 통해 악용될 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: PTC Windchill 및 FlexPLM에서 신뢰할 수 없는 데이터 역직렬화로 원격 코드 실행이 가능합니다.

CVE-2026-123864.description: A re-entrancy flaw in Node.js HTTPS lets an unauthenticated client read memory belonging to other connections, including TLS private keys and other users' requests. TLSWrap::DoWrite() calls ClearOut() directly when asked to write zero bytes; if that write is issued from JavaScript running inside the HTTP parser's on_body callback, ClearOut() decrypts the next TLS record while the parser is still mid-body, re-entering llhttp_execute() and causing a use-after-free and an out-of-bounds heap read. The server then copies that freed or unrelated heap memory into the response for the request body. Triggering it requires a handler that calls res.flushHeaders() before the request body ends and later calls res.end() with a non-empty chunk, and reading the leaked memory requires any ordinary route that echoes or stores a request body. Cleartext node:http is not affected. This vulnerability affects Node.js 26.x, 24.x, and 22.x.
CVE-2026-123864.summary_ko: Node.js HTTPS 모듈의 재진입 결함으로 인한 메모리 유출 취약점입니다. TLS 비공개 키를 포함한 타인의 요청 데이터를 공격자가 읽을 수 있으며, 힙 메모리 손상이 발생합니다.

curation.reason_ko: Node.js HTTPS의 재진입 결함으로 TLS 비공개 키 등 연결 간 메모리가 노출될 수 있습니다.

CVE-2026-123872.description: A client certificate authentication bypass in Node.js TLS lets a client change the servername during TLS 1.2 renegotiation to reach endpoints it was not authorized for. On a server that applies different client-certificate policies per hostname, for example stricter admin-only client-cert auth on one host and ordinary client-cert auth on another, a client that authenticates for a permitted host can renegotiate the TLS 1.2 connection under a different servername and carry its existing authentication to the protected host, bypassing the stricter policy. This vulnerability affects Node.js 26.x, 24.x, and 22.x.
CVE-2026-123872.summary_ko: Node.js 26.x, 24.x, 22.x의 TLS에서 클라이언트 인증서 인증 우회가 발생할 수 있다. TLS 1.2 재협상 중 서버 이름을 바꾸면 허용된 호스트의 기존 인증이 더 엄격한 정책의 보호 호스트에 적용될 수 있다.

curation.reason_ko: Node.js TLS의 인증 우회로 호스트별 클라이언트 인증 정책을 건너뛸 수 있습니다.

CVE-2026-123872.background_ko: TLS 1.2 재협상 중 서버 이름을 변경해 기존 클라이언트 인증을 다른 호스트에 적용할 수 있는 것이 원인이다.

CVE-2026-123866.description: A use-after-free in Node.js HTTP/2 stream teardown can leak response memory, including the contents of other connections' response buffers, to a peer. When a stream is torn down while a write is still backpressured, for example by a peer RST_STREAM or by the server's own per-stream timeout destroying the stream, the stream's response buffer is freed but a reference to it is still used, so freed or unrelated heap memory is written to the socket instead of the intended response. On Node.js 26.x and 24.x the teardown can be driven purely by a remote peer once the window-size change from 26.9.0 and 24.22.0 is present, and on all supported lines the same defect is reachable through an application-initiated teardown such as a per-stream idle timeout. This vulnerability affects Node.js 26.x, 24.x, and 22.x.
CVE-2026-123866.summary_ko: Node.js HTTP/2 스트림 종료 과정의 해제 후 사용 취약점으로, 의도한 응답 대신 다른 연결의 응답 버퍼를 포함한 메모리 내용이 상대방에게 노출될 수 있습니다. Node.js 26.x, 24.x, 22.x가 영향을 받습니다.

curation.reason_ko: Node.js HTTP/2의 해제 후 사용 결함으로 다른 연결의 응답 메모리가 노출될 수 있습니다.

CVE-2026-123863.description: A reachable assertion in Node.js HTTP/2 session teardown lets any unauthenticated client abort the server, over both TLS and cleartext. A client can arrange for an Http2Stream that still holds nghttp2-allocated header buffers to outlive its session: the stream is removed from the session's stream set but never detached, so when ~Http2Session() runs the memory accounting is nonzero and the CHECK_EQ(current_nghttp2_memory_, 0) assertion fails, terminating the process. The trigger needs only a default http2 server whose handler responds before the request body has ended, which is typical. It is a variant of CVE-2024-27983 that the earlier fix did not cover, because that fix only detached streams still tracked in the session. This vulnerability affects Node.js 26.x (since 26.9.0) and 24.x (since 24.22.0).
CVE-2026-123863.summary_ko: Node.js HTTP/2 세션 종료 과정의 검증 취약점으로, 인증되지 않은 클라이언트가 서버 프로세스를 종료시킬 수 있습니다. Node.js 26.x와 24.x가 영향을 받습니다.

curation.reason_ko: Node.js HTTP/2의 세션 종료 결함으로 비인증 원격 사용자가 서버를 중단시킬 수 있습니다.

CVE-2026-126885.description: Use after free in ServiceWorker in Google Chrome prior to 157.0.8103.78 allowed a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code outside the sandbox via a crafted HTML page. (Chromium security severity: Critical)
CVE-2026-126885.summary_ko: Google Chrome의 ServiceWorker에 발생한 해제 후 사용 취약점입니다. 조작된 HTML 페이지를 이용해 원격 공격자가 샌드박스 외부에서 임의 코드를 실행할 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: Chrome ServiceWorker의 해제 후 사용 취약점으로 샌드박스 밖 코드 실행이 가능합니다.

CVE-2026-126846.description: Use after free in Skia in Google Chrome on on Android prior to 157.0.8103.78 allowed a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code outside the sandbox via a crafted HTML page. (Chromium security severity: Critical)
CVE-2026-126846.summary_ko: Google Chrome(Android)의 Skia 엔진에서 발생하는 Use-after-free 취약점입니다. 원격 공격자가 조작된 HTML 페이지를 통해 샌드박스 외부에서 임의의 코드를 실행할 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: Chrome Android의 Skia 취약점으로 조작된 페이지를 통한 샌드박스 밖 코드 실행이 가능합니다.

CVE-2026-126879.description: Use after free in Layout in Google Chrome prior to 157.0.8103.78 allowed a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code inside the sandbox via a crafted HTML page. (Chromium security severity: Critical)
CVE-2026-126879.summary_ko: Google Chrome의 Layout에서 발생하는 use-after-free 취약점으로, 원격 공격자가 조작된 HTML 페이지를 통해 샌드박스 내부에서 임의 코드를 실행할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-126879.background_ko: Layout에서 메모리 해제 후 사용(use-after-free)이 발생하는 것이 원인이다.

curation.reason_ko: Chrome Layout의 취약점으로 조작된 페이지에서 샌드박스 내 코드 실행이 가능합니다.

CVE-2026-126859.description: Link following in FileSystem in Google Chrome prior to 157.0.8103.78 allowed a remote attacker leveraging social engineering to execute arbitrary code outside the sandbox via a crafted HTML page. (Chromium security severity: High)
CVE-2026-126859.summary_ko: Google Chrome 157.0.8103.78 이전 버전의 FileSystem 링크 추적 취약점으로, 사회공학을 이용한 원격 공격자가 샌드박스 밖에서 임의 코드를 실행할 수 있다.

curation.reason_ko: Chrome의 파일 링크 처리 취약점이 사회공학과 결합하면 샌드박스 밖 코드 실행으로 이어질 수 있습니다.

CVE-2026-67449.description: Portabase is a database backup and restore tool for PostgreSQL, MySQL, MsSQL, MariaDB, Firebird SQL, SQLite, MongoDB, Redis, Files and Docker Volume. Prior to version 1.21.2, a path traversal in the TUS upload webhook handler (app/api/tus/hooks/route.ts) allowed an unauthenticated attacker to overwrite arbitrary files under the private data directory, including /data/private/keys/master_key.bin (the AES-256-GCM master key). This issue has been patched in version 1.21.2.
CVE-2026-67449.summary_ko: Portabase의 웹훅 핸들러에서 경로 탐색 취약점이 발견되었습니다. 인증되지 않은 공격자가 데이터 디렉토리 내 임의의 파일을 덮어쓸 수 있으며, 마스터 키 파일 등을 변조할 위험이 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: Portabase의 비인증 경로 순회로 개인 데이터 디렉터리의 임의 파일을 덮어쓸 수 있습니다.

CVE-2026-126813.description: Roundcube Webmail before 1.6.21 and 1.7.x before 1.7.6 contains an IMAP command injection vulnerability that allows attackers to inject commands via CRLF in the _uid parameter when messages_cache is enabled. Attackers can lure logged-in victims into opening crafted GET links to mail/show or mail/get, executing IMAP commands that delete messages, change flags, or grant mailbox access via SETACL.
CVE-2026-126813.summary_ko: Roundcube Webmail 1.6.21 이전 버전 및 1.7.6 이전 1.7.x 버전에는 IMAP 명령 주입 취약점이 있다. 로그인한 피해자의 메시지 삭제·플래그 변경이나 사서함 접근 권한 부여로 이어질 수 있다.

curation.reason_ko: Roundcube의 IMAP 명령 삽입으로 피해자 메일 삭제나 사서함 권한 변경이 가능합니다.

CVE-2026-126813.background_ko: messages_cache가 활성화된 경우 _uid 매개변수의 CRLF로 IMAP 명령을 주입할 수 있는 것이 원인이다.

CVE-2026-100307.description: Missing authorization in the external management API in Amazon mcp-gateway-registry 1.0.9 through 1.24.7 might allow an authenticated remote user to assign the registry administrator scope to their own identity group and obtain administrative control of every registered gateway asset via a crafted group import request. To remediate this issue, users should upgrade to version 1.25.0.
CVE-2026-100307.summary_ko: Amazon mcp-gateway-registry 1.0.9~1.24.7의 외부 관리 API에 권한 확인 누락 취약점이 있어, 인증된 원격 사용자가 자신의 그룹에 레지스트리 관리자 권한을 부여하고 등록된 모든 게이트웨이 자산을 관리할 수 있습니다. 설명에 따르면 1.25.0으로 업그레이드해 조치할 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: mcp-gateway-registry의 권한 확인 누락으로 인증된 사용자가 전체 게이트웨이를 관리할 수 있습니다.

CVE-2026-126797.description: NextScan 1.1.0 through 1.2.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in ns-admin that allows unauthenticated attackers to forge administrator tokens using a hardcoded JWT signing key. Attackers can sign an HS256 X-Access-Token carrying the public super administrator role ID to gain full access to user management, scan tasks and stored vulnerability results.
CVE-2026-126797.summary_ko: NextScan의 ns-admin 구성 요소에서 하드코딩된 JWT 서명 키를 사용하는 인증 우회 취약점입니다. 공격자는 조작된 관리자 토큰을 생성하여 사용자 관리, 스캔 작업 및 저장된 취약점 결과에 대해 완전한 접근 권한을 얻을 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: NextScan의 하드코딩된 JWT 키로 비인증 공격자가 관리자 토큰을 위조할 수 있습니다.

CVE-2026-126768.description: OpsTree REMS through 1.0.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to obtain valid JWTs by setting the client-controlled is_local_auth field. Attackers can send a POST /api/v1/user/login/ request for the admin account with an invalid password and is_local_auth true to gain SuperUser administrative access.
CVE-2026-126768.summary_ko: OpsTree REMS의 인증 우회 취약점입니다. 클라이언트가 조작 가능한 필드를 통해 관리자 계정으로 로그인하여 슈퍼유저 권한을 획득할 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: OpsTree REMS의 인증 우회로 비인증 공격자가 슈퍼유저 권한을 얻을 수 있습니다.

CVE-2026-126769.description: OpsTree REMS through 1.0.0 contains a missing authentication vulnerability that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to access Governance API endpoints, including /api/v1/databases. Attackers can send requests without an Authorization header, or with invalid or tampered JWT tokens, to retrieve stored database hosts, usernames, and passwords.
CVE-2026-126769.summary_ko: OpsTree REMS 1.0.0 이하에서 인증 없이 Governance API에 접근해 저장된 데이터베이스 호스트, 사용자 이름, 암호를 조회할 수 있다.

curation.reason_ko: OpsTree REMS의 API 인증 누락으로 저장된 데이터베이스 접속 정보가 노출될 수 있습니다.

CVE-2026-126769.background_ko: 인증 확인이 누락되어 인증되지 않은 요청도 Governance API에 접근할 수 있는 것이 원인이다.

CVE-2026-85632.description: Missing authentication for critical function and Improper validation of integrity check value vulnerability in Sipay Electronic Money and Payment Services Inc. WooCommerce Virtual POS Module allows Authentication Bypass and Application API Message Manipulation via Man-in-the-Middle. This issue affects WooCommerce Virtual POS Module: from 26.8.3 before 26.9.1.
CVE-2026-85632.summary_ko: Sipay WooCommerce Virtual POS 모듈 26.8.3 버전에서 인증 누락 및 무결성 검증 미흡 취약점이 발견되었습니다. 중간자 공격을 통해 인증 우회 및 API 메시지 조작이 가능합니다.

CVE-2026-67544.description: Heym builds and runs agentic systems and business-process automations on self-hosted infrastructure. Prior to version 0.0.71, Heym's workflow engine accepts an arbitrary Python code string in the playwrightCode field of a Playwright node. This string is written to a temporary .py file and executed directly by the backend process via subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, script_path]) with no sandboxing, AST validation, or role gate. Any authenticated user — including a freshly registered account — can achieve full remote code execution (RCE) on the backend host, running as the service process user (observed as root in the default Docker deployment). This issue has been patched in version 0.0.71.
CVE-2026-67544.summary_ko: Heym 워크플로우 엔진에서 파이썬 코드를 검증 없이 실행하는 취약점입니다. 인증된 사용자는 샌드박스나 역할 제한 없이 백엔드 호스트에서 원격 코드 실행(RCE)을 수행할 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: Heym 워크플로우에서 검증되지 않은 Python 코드를 실행해 백엔드 원격 코드 실행이 가능합니다.

CVE-2026-67543.description: Heym builds and runs agentic systems and business-process automations on self-hosted infrastructure. Prior to version 0.0.70, heym hardens one untrusted-code path but not its sibling. The Python tool executor (python_tool_executor.py) treats user code as untrusted and mandates a Docker sandbox (no network, read-only fs, non-root, no docker socket), failing closed. The skill executor (skill_python_executor.py) runs skill Python via a local backend subprocess with no Docker isolation — only a 512 MB RLIMIT and a 7-key env denylist — so a skill executes inside the backend execution context, with filesystem access, network egress, and non-denylisted environment variables that should not be exposed to untrusted/shared skills. In the shipped Docker config (backend runs as root + /var/run/docker.sock mounted), this escalates to host root. This issue has been patched in version 0.0.70.
CVE-2026-67543.summary_ko: Heym 0.0.70 이전 버전은 스킬의 Python 코드를 격리 없이 실행해 파일 시스템·네트워크 등에 접근하게 할 수 있다. 제공된 Docker 설정에서는 호스트 root 권한까지 확대될 수 있다.

curation.reason_ko: Heym의 skill 실행기가 격리되지 않아 백엔드 파일과 환경에 접근할 수 있습니다.

CVE-2026-67543.background_ko: 스킬 실행기가 Python 코드를 Docker 격리 없이 로컬 백엔드 하위 프로세스로 실행하는 것이 원인이다.

CVE-2026-67546.description: Heym builds and runs agentic systems and business-process automations on self-hosted infrastructure. Prior to version 0.0.75, the same POST /api/mcp/fetch-tools endpoint (any authenticated user, lowest role) also accepts the stdio transport, which spawns the attacker-supplied command with attacker-supplied args and an environment merged over os.environ. The process executes on the shared backend host before MCP protocol validation fails — so side effects fire regardless of whether the command speaks MCP. This is a distinct weakness class and exploit primitive from the SSRF (Advisory 2) on the same endpoint, and needs a different fix (role gating / opt-in trust boundary rather than egress controls). This issue has been patched in version 0.0.75.
CVE-2026-67546.summary_ko: Heym 0.0.75 이전 버전의 취약점으로 인증된 사용자가 공유 백엔드 호스트에서 임의 명령을 실행해 부작용을 일으킬 수 있다.

curation.reason_ko: Heym의 MCP 도구 요청이 공격자 제공 명령을 백엔드 호스트에서 실행할 수 있습니다.

4710db9f53a1d6134fe7a8da.excerpt: Microsoft did another four-digit patch drop today, releasing updates to fix almost 1,100 security vulnerabilities in its Windows operating systems and supported software. This month’s Patch Tuesday addresses 63 critical flaws — including a zero-day in Microsoft Outlook — and comes amid important security updates from other software makers, including Adobe , Apple , Google and Mozilla . Image: Shutterstock.com. Diorama by @zepp1969. November’s patch release from Redmond tackles 1,093 vulnerabilities, fixing 63 “critical” flaws that can be exploited to seize control over a Windows system with little or no help from users. Nearly half of those critical bugs are remote code execution vulnerabilities. Overall, 535 of the flaws addressed this month allow an attacker to elevate their privileges on a vulnerable device. This latest round of updates means Microsoft has shipped more than 5,100 security patches so far this year, a staggering number considering that a year ago Microsoft was averaging around 100 patches per month. Microsoft credits advances in artificial intelligence for helping to find (and fix) such a large volume of security bugs in recent months. Last month, Microsoft pushed more than 1,400 fixes. According to Redmond, just one of the flaws is already seeing active exploitation: CVE-2026-124194 , a spoofing bug in Outlook. e13fef03e17cd50aeaf79795.title_original: Auditable Human-Agent Teams for Autonomous X-ray Experimentation
e13fef03e17cd50aeaf79795.excerpt: arXiv:2611.12933v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Closed-loop autonomous experimentation can accelerate scientific discovery, but implementation effort limits accessibility. Agentic systems may lower this barrier, although sustained operation on physical instruments remains largely unexplored. Here, using coding-agent infrastructure grounded in validated scientific methods, we demonstrate autonomous synchrotron X-ray experiments on nanoparticle superlattices under evolving, human-defined objectives. Complete human-agent and agent-agent transcripts enable an audit that reconstructs decision provenance and characterizes the division of cognitive labor. Across three experiments, 61-67% of messages involved interpretation or judgment, while the share of methodological and scientific contributions increased from 46% in the setup-focused first experiment to 56-61% in later experiments. Provenance showed that 59-68% of error corrections involved multiple participants and that about half of all decisions incorporated the input of another participant. These results may guide design principles for multi-agent scientific systems and inform future agent harnesses, model training, and accessible autonomous experimentation.

9affa9cd6dc2b2dba93c2c3d.title_original: EarthRecord: From Pixels to Land Change with Multimodal Agents over Four Decades of Satellite Imagery
9affa9cd6dc2b2dba93c2c3d.excerpt: arXiv:2611.12934v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: While multimodal agents now carry out complex data analysis with tools, their ability to turn decades of satellite imagery into reliable land-change analysis, crucial for Earth observation science, remains unmeasured. Existing benchmarks fall short: they pose questions on curated images or give agents preprocessed inputs, leaving out the raw multi-sensor archives where such analysis begins. We introduce EarthRecord, a benchmark built on the raw record of 56 sites: four decades of Landsat, MODIS, VIIRS, and Sentinel-2 data, with cloud masking and cross-sensor harmonization left to the agent. It poses 238 land-change questions across ten analysis tasks, scored against withheld references from global products, agreement among methods, and visual interpretation. Two controls test what answers rest on: the closed book removes the record, and instrument pairs alter one satellite's data while nothing changes on the ground. Evaluations of twelve multimodal agents reveal that leading agents complete most analyses end to end but falter when an answer requires mapping from imagery. Further analysis shows that the record moves answers from prior knowledge to the pixels but not yet to the real change on the ground: when one satellite's data are altered, half of the right answers follow the alteration. EarthRecord thus provides a principled platform for measuring and advancing agents from pixels to land change.

05a4d97cbf13375a4f2dc273.title_original: Train on prefill, monitor at decode: Using sparse autoencoders for topic monitoring
05a4d97cbf13375a4f2dc273.excerpt: arXiv:2611.12935v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Topic monitoring is the task of labelling the topic of each token in a model's response during generation. Activation-based monitors that run at generation time have so far been trained to detect harmful content and are limited to two or three classes. We introduce TopicScope, a framework for training causal topic classifiers on SAE features that assign a topic to every token, so that the label can change partway through a response. We train three detector architectures on synthetic multi-topic conversations covering seven topics. Across Gemma-3 1B and 4B, monitors trained on features extracted from prefill hidden states were able to generalise to decoding. We also found that the classifiers are robust to perturbations, losing at most 5 macro-F1 points when off-topic asides are inserted, topics are removed or sections are reordered. Ablations conducted to understand the contribution of the SAE revealed that classifiers reaching baseline performance without it were several times larger. Our findings show that compact topic monitors can be trained inexpensively in prefill and deployed during generation. More broadly, our work shows where SAEs are useful beyond safety classification. Our code, dataset and checkpoints are available at https://github.com/Mercity-AI/SAE-Guardrails and https://huggingface.co/collections/Mercity/online-guardrails-using-sparse-autoencoders-6ac602940468c62fefb2b9e8

a03923671dff1cfe378fc56d.title_original: LandslideFM: A Foundation Model Towards Unified Landslide Perception and Understanding
a03923671dff1cfe378fc56d.excerpt: arXiv:2611.12936v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Intelligent landslide detection is essential for disaster prevention. However, existing models primarily focus on isolated visual tasks, require extensive labeled data, and lack deep analytical and scene-understanding capabilities. To address these limitations, we propose LandslideFM, the first unified foundation model that connects visual perception tasks with contextual interpretation of landslides. Specifically, LandslideFM adapts to multiple visual tasks via a Source-Agreement Graduated Trust semi-supervised learning framework that leverages limited labeled data alongside abundant unlabeled data. Furthermore, predicted landslide regions provide explicit spatial guidance to a Vision-Language Model adapted through parameter-efficient fine-tuning, enabling comprehensive landslide reasoning. To support training and evaluation in this domain, we also present LandslideVL, the first benchmark for intelligent landslide analysis, combining visual imagery and newly introduced textual prompts. Comprehensive experiments across public datasets and LandslideVL demonstrate that LandslideFM achieves superior quantitative and qualitative performance. Most importantly, LandslideFM surpasses general-purpose VLMs in specialized landslide reasoning and scene analysis. Our code is released at https://github.com/wangshanwen001/LandslideFM.

604d123d8dbb01e5a37c0cfa.excerpt: arXiv:2611.12937v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Do large language models represent psychological constructs internally, or do they only generate outputs that resemble psychometric structure? Given responses on one psychological scale from real individuals (N = 272 Taiwanese university students), models predict responses on six other scales. At the behavioral level, larger variants reproduce and amplify human cross-scale correlations; amplification persists after correcting the seven-scale human correlations for measurement attenuation. We then examine whether this structure is reflected internally. Contrastive direction analysis finds geometry aligned with the human matrix in larger instruct variants, but little alignment in base variants under this assay. Across models, geometry strength is associated with behavioral amplification (r = 0.68, p = 0.008; partial r = 0.69 controlling for log size). To relate internal structure to output behavior, a matched activation-probing paradigm shows that probe slopes vary less than behavioral slopes (1.38-1.77 vs 0.52-1.53). A synthetic control shows that ridge probing can inflate these slopes; after subtracting a baseline based on a reliability proxy from another analysis, adjusted slopes remain associated with behavior (r = 0.88). e2b5a53e422d5f716f67493a.title_original: Graph Visualizations in Prompts for Knowledge Graph Question Answering
e2b5a53e422d5f716f67493a.excerpt: arXiv:2611.12938v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study when and how multimodal input improves knowledge graph question answering (KGQA) in large vision--language models. Adding a graph image yields an average gain of 1.85 F1 points, driven by strong precision improvements on low-complexity questions (+4.65 F1). Mixed-effects and regression analyses show that these multimodal gains do not depend strongly on model scale, but are highly sensitive to graph layout: image-only settings sharply degrade performance, hierarchical Graphviz layouts outperform less organized renderings, and decomposing large subgraphs into separated paths yields the largest improvements. Taken together, the results indicate that visual prompting primarily aids KGQA by enhancing prediction precision in low-complexity contexts, provided that visual design respects cognitive and perceptual constraints. To optimize both accuracy and inference efficiency, we argue for adaptive visual prompting policies that selectively append diagrams to small, visually sparse subgraphs with well-structured layouts, avoiding unnecessary visual clutter and token overhead on complex queries. a628563961f16f3e8af252d3.title_original: Reinforcement Learning based control of Cancer Chemotherapy treatments
a628563961f16f3e8af252d3.excerpt: arXiv:2611.12940v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Reinforcement Learning has achieved tremendous success in recent years. Extending its scope from the traditional complex games such as Atari, Go, Pokeman, and Chess, reinforcement learning has caught researchers' attention on modelling real-life scenarios. Personalized medicine and the dynamic treatment regimen are two such preliminary research fields; researchers are focusing their mindsets currently. Estimating the optimal dynamic treatment regimens from the observational real clinical data is being popularized among the researchers, widening its scope towards more advanced versions of reinforcement learning algorithms. This research is about a research study that focused on reinforcement learning techniques that have been approached in the context of cancer chemotherapy treatments. Primarily this thesis addresses the result of the study by means of the state-of-the-art on reinforcement learning techniques used in generating the optimal policy for sequential treatments, including the existing online reinforcement learning approaches. Thereby a simulation for cancer chemotherapy via traditional Q-learning would be presented. Secondly, the study will extend towards using offline reinforcement learning in the optimal policy generation. 8f76b02d8047e768a61e170d.title_original: AI Governance Should Prioritize Control and Knowledge Boundaries Over Limiting Intelligence
8f76b02d8047e768a61e170d.excerpt: arXiv:2611.12941v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The rapid proliferation of autonomously acting AI agents makes the governance of agentic systems urgent. We propose the competence circuit, summarized as IKC + KC + C, that decomposes an agent's real-world impact into three pathways: intelligence-mediated discovery, procedural know-how, and direct control. Using the canonical fast-takeoff debate as a stress test, we formalize the conditions for intelligence-mediated fast takeoff as a conjunction jointly sufficient for fast catastrophic supremacy, showing that most rely on rapid knowledge acquisition or control attainment rather than intelligence alone. We operationalize epistemic intelligence as hypothesis-selection efficiency and validate this framework via stochastic simulation on NK fitness landscapes across six scenarios spanning the conjunctive chain. An analytic bound supported by the simulations shows that intelligence-driven speedup is capped by the ratio of competing intelligence levels regardless of task difficulty. The simulations also expose a fast-takeoff dilemma: a large intelligence-driven speedup multiplier materializes only when the hypothesis space is noisy, but the absolute timescale remains constrained by the time required for capability-critical tests, so a large multiplier need not imply rapid progress. Simulations also indicate that institutional chokepoints disproportionately slow down superintelligent agents when mandatory authorization delays are large

413c1a371e57b80b36589e6a.excerpt: arXiv:2611.12942v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Tabular foundation models (TFMs) predict from a labelled context in a single forward pass. A recent benchmark reported that they decisively outperform tree ensembles for customer churn, but it compared them with untuned gradient-boosted trees (GBDTs) and scored only ranking metrics, while a retention campaign is judged in money. We re-evaluate TabPFN-2.5, TabPFN-3.5, TabPFN-3.5-Fast and TabICL v2 against Optuna-tuned GBDTs on five public telecom churn datasets over 10 seeded splits. We separate three questions: whether a model ranks churners well, whether that ranking earns more expected maximum profit (EMP), and whether its probabilities can drive a threshold policy. With a split-aware test and Holm correction over 20 pre-declared comparisons, TabPFN-3.5 earns significantly more EMP than the best tuned GBDT on Cell2Cell (1.9%) and Iranian (7.6%), and these two gains also hold against each of the three tuned GBDTs separately. TabICL v2, the earlier benchmark's leader, beats the best tuned GBDT only on Iranian, not all three of them, and underpredicts Orange churn by 2.1 points on a 7.3% base rate. 4639ed8212f7e73d71977928.title_original: SetPrint: Black-Box LLM Fingerprinting via Setwise Correspondence of Response Changes
4639ed8212f7e73d71977928.excerpt: arXiv:2611.12950v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Black-box LLM fingerprinting aims to determine whether a target model was derived from a source model when only the output responses to input queries are observable. One way to reveal this relationship is to perturb each query and observe the resulting responses of both models, yielding two corresponding sets of response variations. These sets provide two complementary sources of information: the relations among response changes within each set, and the correspondence of response changes between the two sets. Existing approaches, however, have not fully exploited both. We introduce \textbf{SetPrint}, a training-free method that jointly captures both within-set relations and between-set correspondence. SetPrint expresses each response change relative to the mean change of its own set, and then compares changes from the two models that were induced by the same perturbation. On LeaFBench, SetPrint consistently outperforms existing training-free black-box fingerprinting methods. Further analyses attribute these gains to both within-set relations and between-set correspondence.

cc953d6e93989cd5931edbab.excerpt: arXiv:2611.12953v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Enterprises increasingly use large language model agents to execute standard operating procedures (SOPs): long, branching, tool-intensive workflows. Yet there is little controlled evidence for choosing among competing agentic architectures. Holding the model, tasks, and tools fixed and varying only the architecture, we compare four designs (a function-calling single agent, a skill-augmented agent, centralized multi-agent orchestration, and a triage swarm; eight arms) across 13 enterprise SOPs, and introduce a skill-definition quality rubric to build matched high and low-quality skill corpora. Three takeaways emerge. (1)~\textbf{There is no universal best architecture; the right choice is SOP-dependent.} On a given SOP, task success ranges from under $10\%$ on the hardest to near $100\%$ on the easiest; no architecture is statistically separable in aggregate, and added structure only plausibly pays off on complex, branching SOPs (a directional, not yet significant, trend). (2)~\textbf{Added architecture cost must be justified by a task-success gain.} Every coordinated arm (multi-agent or skill-augmented) spends $1.4$--$4.7\times$ the tokens and $2.6$--$5.8\times$ the latency of the single agent for gains that are usually small and rarely significant, making the single agent the efficient default; high-quality skills do lift success (to $73.1\%$ from $67.4\%$) while degraded skills fall below it.
