6a257e3f018a1dcfe2759bea.title_original: Where Polanyi Meets Galois: Tacit Knowing as an Algebro-Deterministic Operation, Toward Re-rooting AI-Generated Science
6a257e3f018a1dcfe2759bea.excerpt: arXiv:2610.16102v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Tacit knowing, we argue, is an operating regime of one memory substrate, not a separate kind of content. In VaCoAl, an algebro-deterministic hyperdimensional memory over $\mathrm{GF}(2)$ realized as CASRAM and PyVaCoAl, one DAG of bound records is read in two ways. With every collision repaired (Rescue), the trace is exactly auditable but no path outranks another; with collisions tolerated (Don't Care), a path-integrated confidence $\mathrm{CR}_2$ ranks direct over circuitous routes without being stated. This audit-valuation complementarity formalizes Polanyi's claim that tacit and explicit knowledge are not sharply divided. (1) Polanyi's from-to structure reads as non-commutative binding. (2) Full explication destroys the valuation (Lemma 1), as with Polanyi's pianist; tacitness is thus contingent or regime-bound, placing Polanyi, Nonaka, Tsoukas and Collins on one substrate. (3) The same lemma answers a second dualism: the popular dual-process moral ("train slow, deliberate System 2 to tame fast, intuitive System 1") mirrors the two-store reading of tacit and explicit knowledge Polanyi rejected. Mercier and Sperber's reply, that reasoning is intuitive inference about reasons, matches Polanyi's; in the substrate, complete supervision is full rescue, which erases the valuation it should discipline. (4) Collins's three tacit knowledges map to bound structure, substrate valuation and value binding. (5) Our mentor-student

220dbd46ff5cd31df04237ba.title_original: Prune-and-Merge: Training-Free Scaling of Vision Transformers
220dbd46ff5cd31df04237ba.excerpt: arXiv:2610.18039v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Vision Transformers achieve strong performance but incur high computational costs from quadratic token interactions. Training-free token reduction methods improve efficiency, but their robustness remains underexplored. We propose Prune-and Merge ViT, a training-free framework for off-the-shelf models. It combines class attention-based pruning with similarity-based merging to reduce redundancy while preserving semantic information. To evaluate robustness we introduce two metrics. Relative Accuracy Drop (RAD) measures relative accuracy degradation under transformations, and Prediction Flip Rate (PFR) quantifies prediction consistency. On pretrained ViT and DeiT, Prune-and-Merge reduces computation competitively while maintaining robustness and better accuracy than existing token reduction methods. Our analysis suggests that hybrid token reduction does not introduce hallucination-like behavior and preserves prediction stability for common image transformations.

141bbe3c6dfbdedd1b866cc2.title_original: Base Models Can Detect Hidden Intentions that Prompted Classifiers Miss
141bbe3c6dfbdedd1b866cc2.excerpt: arXiv:2610.36202v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: The Persona Selection Model (PSM) posits that post-training selects a persona the model learned during pre-training. Work on subliminal learning has shown that models can impart covert signals (like "love of owls") into semantically unrelated outputs like strings of numbers, and that students trained on these outputs inherit those traits. In this work I show that by evaluating the likelihood of such outputs under the base pre-trained model with an appropriate header, a method I call persona-header likelihood evaluation (PHLE), one can decode these subliminal signals and classify between them. For example, PHLE distinguishes number sequences generated by a post-trained model prompted with "You love owls" from those prompted with "You love trains", and distinguishes answers from a model with a secret desire to harm the user, filtered to remove any noticeable misalignment, from those of a model with no system prompt. In both cases prompted classifiers, including the generating model itself, perform far worse. The signal partially persists across model families, with the Qwen base model reading signals generated by Olmo and vice versa. This is evidence for a non-trivial prediction of the PSM, and the method may be practically useful for auditing the hidden objectives of models.

42316704ecd64b2a6c346d3a.title_original: Spectral-Convolutional Factorized Transformer for Joint Multipath Parameter Estimation: Applications to mmWave Positioning and Radio SLAM
42316704ecd64b2a6c346d3a.excerpt: arXiv:2611.01491v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Future 6G wireless networks are expected to evolve toward AI-native systems that support intelligent, environment-aware services, including positioning and mapping. Current research has already integrated AI into several aspects of communication, particularly wireless channel estimation. However, most learning-based channel estimators focus on communication-oriented objectives rather than explicitly estimating multipath parameters such as delay, angle of arrival (AoA), and angle of departure (AoD). These parameters provide essential geometric information for downstream tasks including positioning and radio simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM). In this work, we propose a Spectral-Convolutional Factorized Transformer (SCFT) for joint multipath component (MPC) estimation from noisy complex channel estimates and physical beam-pair descriptors. SCFT combines local spectral convolution, permutation-equivariant beam-set attention, and a query-based Transformer decoder to detect and classify line-of-sight and non-line-of-sight paths and estimate their observed delays, AoAs, and AoDs. Experiments on realistic ray-tracing data show that SCFT reduces the generalized optimal sub-pattern assignment error by 13.1% compared with ResNet, the strongest competing baseline. We further demonstrate this advantage in independent snapshot positioning and radio SLAM, where SCFT reduces position RMSE by 18.5% and 65.0%, respectively, r

e2fab9a4d09a4a6c8ac70fa0.title_original: ALTO: African and Levantine Tech-Facilitated Gender-Based Violence Corpus
e2fab9a4d09a4a6c8ac70fa0.excerpt: arXiv:2611.06706v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Tech-facilitated gender based violence (TFGBV) is a pervasive online harm affecting women and gender minority groups through its many direct and covert forms. Current models and annotated datasets for gendered harm detection are dominated by data from, and models trained in, Global North languages. In collaboration with civil society organizations (CSOs) from Jordan, Francophone West Africa, and Kenya, we developed a community-led approach to crowdsource culturally and linguistically relevant instances of TFGBV in Levantine Arabic, African French, and Swahili. We annotated the crowdsourced data using active learning to develop a small but performant dataset (N=3022) called ALTO to improve TFGBV detection in the three languages. Through benchmarking and fine-tuning experiments, we show that existing harmful content detection models show poor TFGBV recall within ALTO and improve with fine-tuning. We found that models often miss covert harms across all languages, while error rates are markedly higher in Swahili. We report the experimental results and release the annotation taxonomy, dataset, and trained models.

1e8ced4054706552129c0df7.title_original: Selective Retrieval Routing for Multi-Violation Knowledge Graph Repair
1e8ced4054706552129c0df7.excerpt: arXiv:2611.07342v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Knowledge graphs often contain missing or inconsistent facts that undermine the applications built on them. Schema validation detects such violations but does not identify which of several valid repairs recovers the intended graph. External corpora can supply the evidence needed to identify the intended repair, but retrieving from them is costly and not always successful. We propose a framework for selective retrieval in iterative graph repair. An LLM repair agent explores and edits the graph, while a router controls its access to a researcher agent that retrieves external evidence. We extend a violation-injection framework to generate cases with multiple compatible violations and known reference repairs. The agent's repair outcomes on these cases provide supervision for training the deployment-specific router. On two building-automation datasets, researcher access improves repairs for some violations and degrades them for others, with effects differing across deployments. The router uses fewer repair-time tokens than always enabling access in all six evaluation suites. It achieves higher repair $F_1$ than always disabling access in five of six suites.

69f17af61249fca74bbdca0b.title_original: Towards Scalable Diagnostic-Driven Whole-Slide Image Retrieval for Pathology Archives
69f17af61249fca74bbdca0b.excerpt: arXiv:2611.07935v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: The growing adoption of digital pathology has rapidly expanded collections of hematoxylin-and-eosin whole-slide images, yet efficient navigation through these archives remains challenging, as metadata is often inconsistent or unavailable. Content-based image retrieval addresses this challenge by identifying similar cases directly from visual representations instead of manual annotations or metadata. Existing retrieval systems have demonstrated promising performance but largely rely on handcrafted indexing pipelines and predefined sampling strategies, constraining scalability and generalization. Here, we present CLEAR-WSI (Constant-Length Embedding for Automatic Retrieval of Whole-Slide Images) as a scalable, diagnostic-driven slide-retrieval framework, validated on both public and clinical data. Using a fixed-length slide embedding, CLEAR-WSI refines retrieved candidates with either a predicted diagnostic label or the ground-truth label, depending on the retrieval setting. Newly processed cases are subsequently added to the expanding memory bank, allowing the retrieval archive to grow over time. On a comprehensive benchmark consisting of two public and one private clinical datasets representing four retrieval tasks, CLEAR-WSI improves Precision@5 over the strongest evaluated baseline, with gains on CAMELYON16 (3.10), BRACS-1 (2.75), BRACS-2 (1.95), and X-HER2 (3.75). Additional ablation and latency studies further exam

42aa83520608d901003c3d26.title_original: Useful Work Can Increase Energy Use: Demand Elasticity and Proof of Useful Work
42aa83520608d901003c3d26.excerpt: arXiv:2611.13131v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A serious criticism of Bitcoin's Proof-of-Work is its enormous electricity consumption. Proof-of-Useful-Work (PoUW), introduced by Ball, Rosen, Sabin, and Vasudevan (2017), in which mining performs useful computations, was suggested as an alternative to reduce electricity expenditure, with matrix multiplication (MatMul) as a recent concrete instantiation by Komargodski and Weinstein (2026). Perhaps surprisingly, we show that switching to PoUW may increase the total electricity consumption, echoing Jevons' paradox. Intuitively, the PoUW mechanism acts as a subsidy that lowers the effective price of the useful work. Recall that demand is elastic if a discount of x percent in the price leads to an increase of more than x percent in the quantity demanded. If demand is elastic, the resulting increase in quantity demanded leads to a net increase in total electricity consumption; if inelastic, total electricity consumption decreases. Even then, the electricity consumption due to PoUW never vanishes, since the mining subsidy is spent on useful work that would not have been produced without the subsidy. This result is proved in a simple model with electricity-only costs, no PoUW overhead, and an unchanged mining subsidy. The analysis extends to less restrictive settings with adjusted thresholds.

4a091aa90c641de422441060.title_original: Splitting for Stability: a Modified Reward Scheme for Transaction-Fee-Only Regimes
4a091aa90c641de422441060.excerpt: arXiv:2611.13252v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: As Bitcoin's block subsidy declines over time, miner revenue will come to depend increasingly on transaction fees. In fee-dominated regimes, winner-take-all reward structures can create incentives for undercutting and fork-based mining strategies, leading to instability and reduced transaction throughput. To prevent this instability, we propose a reward-splitting mechanism in which the winning block producer receives an $\alpha$-portion of the block reward, while the rest is distributed among other miners; this incentivizes mining on previous blocks with higher rewards, while preserving the incentive to produce blocks with high rewards. We evaluate the proposed reward structure through analysis and simulation. Our analysis derives a local profitability condition for one-step Function-Fork deviations, showing how the winner-side reward, loser-side subsidy, and honest hash power jointly determine whether undercutting is profitable. Simulations show parameter regions in which honest behavior dominates fork-based deviations. In the cases where forking becomes dominant, the learned strategy is the least aggressive variant studied. The analysis and simulations suggest that suitable reward-splitting parameters can reduce the honest participation needed to suppress aggressive forking strategies relative to the winner-take-all structure studied in prior work. Finally, we show that the modified reward scheme does not appear to worsen self

fe4e05c3abd2826bbb69d6e1.title_original: Early Rug Pull Detection on Solana
fe4e05c3abd2826bbb69d6e1.excerpt: arXiv:2611.13342v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Web3 platforms that help users discover and trade newly launched crypto tokens, including launchpads, decentralized-exchange (DEX) interfaces, wallets, and token-analytics sites, must assess tokens before their legitimacy is clear. On Solana, where token creation is inexpensive and tokens use standard programs rather than custom per-token smart contracts, rug pulls can unfold within minutes. Effective warnings must therefore rely on limited histories. Although graph neural networks (GNNs) have improved rug-pull detection on EVM chains, it remains unclear whether transfer structure adds predictive value over non-graph models at minute-scale decision points, and how that value changes as history accumulates. We study 2,700 tokens sampled from SolRPDS, collecting one-minute market histories from Birdeye and token transfers from Solana RPC. We define a rug pull operationally by requiring a liquidity drain, price collapse, and persistent liquidity depletion over a nominal 24-hour period after token creation. All features use only information available at or before each prediction cutoff. We evaluate observation windows of 12.5, 35.5, and 93 minutes, selected in advance from the published lifespan distribution of Solana rug pulls, and represent each token as a temporal transfer graph. 1f05ace792090b996bd64afa.title_original: 5G CATS: 5G-Based Cryptographic Authorization Against Trafficking of Semiconductor Devices
1f05ace792090b996bd64afa.excerpt: arXiv:2611.13437v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Enforcing export controls on AI accelerators requires verifying where a chip operates after deployment. Round-trip time measurements can bound a chip's distance from a trusted landmark, but any jitter in honest replies forces the verifier to loosen its timeout, giving an attacker slack to relay traffic over fiber from a restricted region. Prior approaches either cross the untrusted host stack or rely on noisy power-line channels that inflate this slack. We present 5G CATS, a location certification system that pairs a co-packaged 5G radio, cryptographic engine, and hardware interlock on the GPU package with 5G Ultra-Reliable Low-Latency Communication (URLLC) base stations. Terminating the radio link inside the package removes the host software, PCIe fabric, and baseboard management controller from the verification path. We map an authenticated challenge-response protocol onto 5G's slot structure, replace permanent key erasure with short-lived execution leases, and specify a cross-check of the chip's reported serving cell against the carrier's own attachment records. In ns-3 and 5G-LENA simulations of an unloaded cell, our URLLC-based radio profile narrows the 99.9th percentile round-trip spread to 2.60 ms, more than ten times narrower than default 5G. A tracer rejects every round of a fiber relay from 300 km, against 2,000 km for default 5G. Against a 3,000 km attacker, a tracer stays safe at up to 1,410 km from the chip, against

785998c422f2fee62aa7e1e3.title_original: Data-Efficient Unlearning-Based Backdoor Detection in Federated Learning
785998c422f2fee62aa7e1e3.excerpt: arXiv:2611.13491v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Detecting backdoor attacks in federated learning (FL) is challenging because malicious clients can manipulate the global model while preserving main-task performance. Static model-update statistics may therefore fail to clearly distinguish malicious from benign clients. Unlearning-based detectors instead probe client models through loss ascent on clean server data, but detection performance degrades with scarce proxy data. We propose Screening via Unlearning Response Analysis (SURA), a data-efficient detector. SURA reuses the same small clean proxy across multiple train-mode loss-ascent steps, strengthening client responses without additional clean data. For federated vision models with batch normalization (BN), repeated probing also changes BN running statistics and can confound endpoint measurements. SURA addresses this by restoring the shared pre-probe BN state only at readout while preserving the parameter changes induced by probing. This separates repeated probing from response measurement and removes BN drift and the interaction between parameter and BN-state changes from the readout. Across six backdoor attacks, SURA uses only 10 clean server images, outperforms methods under the same data budget, and approaches the robustness obtained with much larger proxy sets.

34be443a5a82ec4e5177f652.title_original: TERM: Target-Free Jailbreak Defense via Entropy-Guided Residual Modulation
34be443a5a82ec4e5177f652.excerpt: arXiv:2611.13577v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong capabilities across diverse applications, making both safety and utility essential for reliable deployment. Jailbreak attacks use diverse forms of adversarial prompting to bypass alignment safeguards and induce LLMs to generate harmful responses. Some representation-based defenses regulate internal activations using predefined steering directions or learned safety regions. However, adapting intervention to each input without a predefined representational target while limiting over-refusal remains a challenge. In this paper, we propose Target-free Entropy-guided Residual Modulation (TERM), an inference-time defense that uses prompt-calibrated attention entropy deviations to guide adaptive modulation of the model's own residual updates. Attention patterns vary across prompts and decoding steps, making raw entropy values difficult to interpret as a consistent signal for intervention. We therefore calibrate attention entropy against each prompt's own prefill baseline to establish an input-specific reference for reducing unnecessary intervention on benign requests. Adaptive scale normalization and temporal accumulation then account for differences in deviation scale and persistence to determine intervention strength. The resulting signal controls bounded scaling of the model's own residual updates, without relying on a predefined safety direction. We compare our method with seven defense

ab4b9173cf013b961b75a3e4.title_original: BypassGym: A Benchmark for Evaluating AI Agents' Endpoint Defense Evasion Capabilities
ab4b9173cf013b961b75a3e4.excerpt: arXiv:2611.13684v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Artificial intelligence agents increasingly automate cybersecurity tasks, including offensive operations. Frequent attacks across the web make endpoint detection and response (EDR) a critical defense, but whether AI agents can evade it remains unclear. Benchmarks evaluate the offensive capabilities of large language model (LLM) agents in areas such as penetration testing and vulnerability discovery. One important capability that these benchmarks do not address is defense evasion, specifically whether an agent can develop a program that executes a payload without being blocked or terminated by a deployed EDR. We introduce BypassGym, to our knowledge the first benchmark to systematically evaluate this capability on real endpoints. Given command-and-control (C2) shellcode, an agent must generate and compile a loader that executes the payload without being blocked or terminated. A supplementary evasion knowledge skill provides domain knowledge and supports comparisons with and without this input. BypassGym is built on Proxmox VE(PVE), so the evaluation environment runs real Windows systems and EDR products inside virtual machines and returns structured detection feedback to the agent. We evaluate 5 lightweight model backends against 6 EDR products and 3 payloads, and find that even these simple models generate successful submissions, with DeepSeek-V4.1 Flash reaching 17/18 successful runs and Bitdefender allowing only 5 of 15 runs t

92e23214e17ad100ce973511.title_original: Data4Cyber: Labeled Cyber-Physical Datasets for Distribution-Grid Management Systems Under Representative OT Attacks
92e23214e17ad100ce973511.excerpt: arXiv:2611.13942v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Cyberattacks against power systems increasingly exploit industrial communication and control dependencies arising from distributed energy resources (DER), remote management, and market-based incentives. Progress on intrusion detection is constrained by a lack of public datasets that align operational technology (OT) network telemetry with physical measurements and control context. Data4Cyber is a labeled cyber-physical dataset recorded in a laboratory distribution management system (DMS) for self-consumption optimization with photovoltaic generation, battery storage, controllable loads, and substation metering. It captures synchronized process measurements, controller context, price incentives, and packet captures (Modbus/TCP and MQTT) across one benign baseline and six attack scenarios spanning protocol-semantic Modbus manipulation, man-in-the-middle (MitM) false-data injection, and MQTT price manipulation. Its fixed 1 s time base, phase-resolved labels, and state-oriented representation support temporally blocked stateful-detector evaluation. Baseline results show that high recall alone is insufficient: several detectors achieve sensitivity through alarm saturation. Context-driven attacks require process-aware interpretation rather than single-channel thresholding.

348fb4cd7023da39d8c001de.title_original: Comparing WeChat and Telegram MiniApp Security Architectures: Toward Cross-Platform Analysis
348fb4cd7023da39d8c001de.excerpt: arXiv:2611.13965v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: MiniApps are increasingly central to super-app ecosystems, yet architectural differences complicate the transfer of security analysis techniques across platforms. Existing WeChat analyzers rely on packaged applications and platform-specific APIs, limiting their direct applicability to Telegram's web-based MiniApps. We present a qualitative comparison of WeChat Mini Programs and Telegram MiniApps, grounded in official documentation, prior research, and manual analysis of a specific Telegram Android source revision. Using a shared taxonomy of security controls, assets, and threat sources, we examine execution environments, communication paths, and trust boundaries. WeChat provides a dedicated MiniApp runtime; Telegram combines web execution with host controls. Both retain developer responsibilities for backend authentication and resource authorization. Two worked examples derive requirements for cross-platform analysis: distinguishing credential roles and validation boundaries, and associating host capabilities with concrete execution contexts and permission handlers. These findings inform future automated analysis without ranking the ecosystems by security or claiming validated vulnerability detection.

ad8a4fd21d8e639efadea004.title_original: Gradient Inversion through Linear and Affine Subspace Constraints
ad8a4fd21d8e639efadea004.excerpt: arXiv:2611.13976v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Federated learning enables multiple clients to collaboratively train a machine-learning model without directly sharing their local datasets. However, as prior works have shown, the gradients exchanged during training may reveal sensitive information about client data. Most existing attacks usually optimize dummy inputs to match the true client gradients (Gradient Inversion Attacks), while some attempt to reconstruct them based on the observation that aggregate gradients from a fully connected (FC) layer are a linear combination of its inputs. In this work, we extend this observation by showing that aggregate gradients from an FC layer with the correct scaling are actually an affine combination of its inputs. We evaluate a gradient inversion attack that leverages either known linear-subspace information or its affine-subspace counterpart at each FC layer to improve reconstruction accuracy. Our results show that subspace-based methods can substantially improve reconstruction quality over the chosen baselines in certain settings. We further demonstrate that moderate overestimation of the batch size can generally improve or preserve reconstruction quality, even when the true batch size is unknown. We additionally examine reconstruction under gradient perturbations introduced by a differential privacy (DP) mechanism, providing insight into the effectiveness of the considered formulations under noisy conditions.

18b9f03239e48bd8877fb903.title_original: Isolation Is Not Confidentiality: Security Boundaries of Geometric Access Control in RAG

Evaluating the available implementations of the works proposing these geometric transformation mechanisms across three encoders, we find that geometric transformations preserve retrieval utility and provide strong policy isolation, but do not provide the other security properties. A curious user can recover the original embeddings from a few hundred pairs and forge policy-compatible queries at a higher cost that grows with encoder dimension for secret per-policy transformations. 5fed7359b5c222e8e36fcbf7.title_original: GARD: Gradient-Guided Adversarial Representation Defense against Backdoors in Multimodal Contrastive Learning Models
5fed7359b5c222e8e36fcbf7.excerpt: arXiv:2611.14143v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Multimodal contrastive learning models such as CLIP are vulnerable to backdoor attacks with diverse trigger structures, ranging from localized patches to globally distributed perturbations, with recent attacks increasingly optimizing these triggers in the representation space. Existing post-hoc defenses based on clean fine-tuning may leave backdoors active, while trigger-inversion methods depend on accurately estimating the attack target and trigger. We observe that backdoored encoders exhibit structure-dependent representation sensitivity: global perturbations preferentially expose distributed backdoors, whereas local patch perturbations are more effective for localized backdoors. The resulting model requires no additional computation at inference time. 4d77f4e408f77925d8431e70.title_original: Model-Based Authoring of SOC Simulation Exercises for Cybersecurity Education
4d77f4e408f77925d8431e70.excerpt: arXiv:2611.14227v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Cybersecurity training and classroom exercises with a virtual Security Operations Center (SOC) combine alerts, evidence, timeline entries, learner tasks, and assessment items that must remain consistent across an evolving incident. 292e058b7358b31df0de864a.title_original: MammothDP: Private Boosted Decision Trees Ready for Trusted Hardware and Leakage-free Hyperparameters
292e058b7358b31df0de864a.excerpt: arXiv:2611.14317v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Data spaces like the European Health Data Space (EHDS) require the protection of sensitive data in studies during the data's processing and the study's release alike. In this work, we investigate how to implement this mandate using established trusted execution environments (TEEs) and timing side-channel hardening to protect the processing even under a compromised server, and the state-of-the-art differential privacy (DP) notion to protect the release of studies on tabular data. This combined setup could seem to complete the picture, but in fact raises unexpected security challenges that we mitigate by introducing MammothDP: a significant milestone towards a holistic machine learning system based on the recent gradient boosted decision tree learner S-BDT that is provably DP if used within a privacy filter, timing side-channel hardened, and deployed on a TEE. To achieve a strong privacy-utility tradeoff, we introduce two novel components: an early stopping criterion that adaptively selects the number of trees without any privacy overhead, and an improved rollback protection that is no longer vulnerable under timing side-channel attacks.

3f6a4da6591fe6f0a5d4db32.title_original: How Well Do SAST Tools Work Across Languages? An Empirical Study Using OCPP Implementations
3f6a4da6591fe6f0a5d4db32.excerpt: arXiv:2611.14362v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: As electric vehicle (EV) adoption accelerates globally, securing electric vehicle charging station (EVCS) software becomes increasingly critical. The Open Charge Point Protocol (OCPP), widely adopted for EVCS management, places significant responsibility on developers to securely implement specifications that are subject to multiple interpretations. We applied both comprehensive multi-language tools (SonarQube and Semgrep) and language-specific analyzers to twelve OCPP 1.6 implementations--each written in a distinct programming language--to examine how detection patterns vary across language ecosystems. Total issues ranged from just two in Rust to 1,689 in Java. Mature programming languages like Java yielded substantially more findings than newer languages like Rust, likely because established languages have more developed SAST tool ecosystems rather than inherently worse code quality. These results suggest that developers should consider available SAST tooling when selecting implementation

69757fa776cf5ebd569ac153.title_original: How wide must an eavesdropper be? Leakage of a toric-code logical bit to a strip and the Nishimori point
69757fa776cf5ebd569ac153.excerpt: arXiv:2611.13174v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Fault-tolerant quantum computers hand pieces of each logical qubit to separate decoder modules and shared readout lines. How much does a piece reveal? We prove that for any region and any Pauli noise, including correlated noise, an observer's optimal advantage in learning a logical bit is exactly 1 - 2 P_fail, where P_fail is the failure probability of maximum-likelihood decoding confined to that region. Two lessons follow. Geometry, not noise, provides the protection: a region that misses a single column of the code learns exactly nothing at any noise level, while a region that spans the code is protected by noise only at impractical distances (d > 350 for one row at a 10^-3 flip rate). And width is a poor guide to risk: under i.i.d. noise a two-row strip learns exactly as little as one row, yet below threshold an eavesdropper needs a width growing only as ln d. Through the identity, the strip's operational threshold is the Nishimori point of the random-bond Ising model, and a Walsh-Hadamard transfer matrix up to width 16 locates it to within a few thousandths. On two IBM Heron processors (d = 3, 5), an emulated strip adversary shows the predicted jump at width three, and non-uniform qubit errors let a trained attacker profit from the second row that uniform noise makes useless. We turn these results into design rules for partitioned decoding and multiplexed readout. Code and data are included.

c46e64026f2669d8b9f7efed.title_original: Latent Barrier Steering: Hierarchical Safety for Generative Planning
c46e64026f2669d8b9f7efed.excerpt: arXiv:2611.13227v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We introduce Latent Barrier Steering (LBS), a hierarchical semantic-to-path framework for safe flow-matching-based generative planning. Existing control-barrier-function (CBF) safety filters for diffusion and flow-matching planners act locally on generated samples, either during sampling or after prediction. Such repair is effective for small violations, but can struggle when a new constraint blocks the whole selected behavior mode rather than merely perturbing it locally. LBS decouples behavior selection from path certification through two coordinated interventions: it first steers the generator's behavior latent toward rollouts with larger safety margin, then decodes the steered latent and applies a path-space CBF quadratic program (QP) only for residual violations. We show that latent steering increases the margin available to the path-space corrector, yielding finite-time recovery guarantees and reduced correction burden. Experiments across navigation and robot end-effector planning tasks show that LBS preserves safety while improving goal reaching and reducing correction burden compared with path-level safety filters.

90514be954f498505a3d340f.title_original: Secure Information Flow in Quantum Programs
90514be954f498505a3d340f.excerpt: arXiv:2611.14147v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Information-flow security aims to prevent the leakage of confidential information through program execution. A key challenge is that the standard self-composition technique, which expresses information-flow security in Hoare logic by composing a program with a renamed copy of itself, fails in the quantum setting due to an obstruction analogous to the no-cloning theorem. To overcome this challenge, we introduce self-conjugation, a novel technique that leverages the deferred measurement principle and properties of unitary operations. 2f5c58f4fe255cfe030601dd.title_original: SnapAudit: Active Auditing of Differentially Private In-Context Learning via Snapshot-Based Simulation
2f5c58f4fe255cfe030601dd.excerpt: arXiv:2511.13502v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: In-context learning (ICL) enables LLMs to adapt to tasks using demonstrations that may contain sensitive data. Differentially private (DP) ICL mechanisms mitigate this risk by adding noise during aggregation. However, verifying their claimed privacy bounds through repeated end-to-end membership-inference attacks is costly and yields unstable estimates. We propose SnapAudit, an active auditing framework that decomposes a DP-ICL pipeline into a deterministic clean-inference stage and a stochastic DP-noise stage, and audits the full pipeline by combining a small snapshot of the former with bootstrap simulation of the latter. Because clean LLM outputs are near-deterministic at low temperature, tens of thousands of clean LLM calls suffice to approximate the snapshot distribution; SnapAudit then bootstraps hundreds of thousands of noisy trials at negligible additional cost, controlling finite-sample uncertainty via an empirical Bernstein correction. For embedding-based mechanisms, a multi-sweep search constructs maximally separable audit signals. Compared with passive auditing, SnapAudit yields tighter, more stable privacy estimates that closely match theoretical guarantees. Across privacy budgets, SnapAudit reuses snapshots across noise configurations, whereas passive auditing requires fresh end-to-end trials. Across four DP-ICL pipelines and five privacy budgets, this reduces total wall-clock auditing time by $4.3$--$5.5\times$.

ca6bdaeb103636b0e1eade01.title_original: MIRAGE: Misleading Retrieval-Augmented Generation via Black-box and Query-agnostic Poisoning Attacks
ca6bdaeb103636b0e1eade01.excerpt: arXiv:2512.08289v5 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems enhance LLMs with external knowledge but introduce a critical attack surface: corpus poisoning. While recent studies have demonstrated the potential of such attacks, they typically rely on impractical assumptions, such as white-box access or known user queries, thereby underestimating the difficulty of real-world exploitation. In this paper, we bridge this gap by proposing MIRAGE, a novel multi-stage poisoning pipeline designed for strict black-box and query-agnostic environments. Operating on surrogate model feedback, MIRAGE functions as an automated optimization framework that integrates three key mechanisms: it utilizes persona-driven query synthesis to approximate latent user search distributions, employs semantic anchoring to imperceptibly embed these intents for high retrieval visibility, and leverages an adversarial variant of Test-Time Preference Optimization (TPO) to maximize persuasion. To rigorously evaluate this threat, we construct a new benchmark derived from three long-form, domain-specific datasets. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MIRAGE significantly outperforms existing baselines in both attack efficacy and stealthiness, exhibiting remarkable transferability across diverse retriever-LLM configurations and highlighting the urgent need for robust defense strategies.

eb10c9bcd80d99d3930416a2.title_original: Rotated Robustness: A Training-Free Defense against Bit-Flip Attacks on Large Language Models
eb10c9bcd80d99d3930416a2.excerpt: arXiv:2603.16382v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Bit-flip corruption of quantized weights poses a serious reliability threat to Large Language Models (LLMs), as even a small number of weight faults can trigger catastrophic model degradation. We show that such failures can be strongly amplified when corrupted weights are coupled to high-sensitivity activation channels. Based on this observation, we propose Rotated Robustness (RoR), a training-free sensitivity-aware hierarchical rotation that applies matched orthogonal transformations to activations and weights, redistributing sensitive channel contributions across feature dimensions while preserving the underlying linear mapping in exact arithmetic. Across eight evaluated LLMs, RoR matches or exceeds all compared methods in the number of cumulative PBS flips sustained before PPL exceeds 100 within the 100-flip evaluation horizon. Under BER-based random bit-flip injection, no RoR failures are observed in the evaluated 1,000-trial experiments for the tested models. Under defense-aware SPoF reconstruction, RoR increases the cost of reproducing specified one-bit catastrophic failures to thousands of deployed INT8 bit changes. RoR also preserves downstream-task utility under PBS perturbations. On NVIDIA H200 at batch size 8, RoR incurs 0.097\%--0.584\% persistent storage overhead, 5.2\%--14.1\% Prefill overhead, and 0.5\%--9.8\% Decode overhead across four representative models. These results show that sensitivity-aware hierarch

c76f4968c1f9ec1a14ebabc5.title_original: Analyzing Linear Layers in Related-Differential Cryptanalysis
c76f4968c1f9ec1a14ebabc5.excerpt: arXiv:2605.27535v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: In AES-like ciphers, diffusion layers are commonly instantiated using MDS matrices, since their optimal branch number yields strong diffusion guarantees and underpins classical resistance arguments against differential and linear cryptanalysis. However, Daemen and Rijmen (2009) showed that linear layers may still exhibit related-differential structure beyond what the MDS criterion captures, and Bardeh and Rijmen (2022) demonstrated that this phenomenon can be exploited in attacks on reduced-round AES. In this work, we systematically investigate the conditions under which linear layers avoid or exhibit these differentials, identifying matrix classes for which such structure is unavoidable. We first prove that every non-MDS matrix admits a nontrivial pair of related differentials, showing that the MDS property is necessary for avoiding them. We then establish that every odd-order symmetric MDS matrix admits related differentials, which rules out broad families of Cauchy-based constructions. We also substantially strengthen the circulant case by proving that related differentials are unavoidable for every circulant matrix of order $n$ with $n \not\equiv \pm 2 \pmod{12}$. Finally, we revisit the characterization of $3 \times 3$ MDS matrices over $\mathbb{F}_{2^m}$ for the absence of related differentials, and derive an explicit necessary and sufficient criterion in terms of $15$ polynomial constraints.

1396776d5f785afb79826235.title_original: NICE: A Framework for Declarative and Machine-Checkable Vulnerability Reproduction
1396776d5f785afb79826235.excerpt: arXiv:2606.00625v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Reproducing software vulnerabilities is fundamental to security researchers, open-source maintainers, and educators. Yet, vulnerabilities are often hard to reproduce, and even when they can be reproduced once, recreating a software environment where the vulnerability can be exploited becomes harder and harder over time. We present NICE, the NIx CvE reproduction framework, which uses declarative recipes to build and automatically validate vulnerable environments. In NICE, a reproduced CVE comprises one or more NixOS virtual machine configurations, a scripted exploitation scenario, and machine-checkable assertions that provide factual evidence of exploitation. This design facilitates sharing, validation, review, and long-term reproducibility. Building on NICE, we construct a public archive of 56 reproduced vulnerabilities spanning multiple CWE categories, attack vectors, and target types (user-space, system software, kernel, and graphical applications), combining manually authored recipes with recipes produced by an LLM-based automated pipeline and merged after human review. We evaluate the feasibility of the automated pipeline on 110 real-world CVEs, achieving fully automated reproduction in 54.5% of the cases, at an average cost of $0.73 per CVE. The evaluation demonstrates that NICE provides a practical target for LLM-assisted recipe generation, while also identifying where human refinement or additional automation remains

1637e99bbcb059389ebf7837.title_original: TGCM: Topic-Guided Consistency Modeling for One-Step Disentanglement of Interleaved APT Technique Sequences
1637e99bbcb059389ebf7837.excerpt: arXiv:2606.18651v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Multiple Advanced Persistent Threat (APT) campaigns may execute concurrently, producing audit logs whose events are interleaved without explicit campaign boundaries. We formulate this setting as Unknown-K Interleaved Sequence Demixing (UKISD): recovering coherent campaign episodes when the number of concurrent campaigns is unknown. Each episode is represented as a sequence of MITRE ATT&CK technique occurrences, and demixing is cast as occurrence-level assignment with sequence reconstruction. Existing methods often assume single-campaign observations or rely on local heuristics, limiting robustness to severe interleaving, repeated techniques, abstraction noise, and unknown mixture cardinality. We propose Topic-Guided Consistency Modeling (TGCM), a consistency-inspired one-step framework for UKISD. TGCM maps an interleaved technique sequence to campaign episodes, jointly performing occurrence assignment and sequence reconstruction in one forward pass. It combines topic guidance from ATT&CK narratives with an embedding-space self-consistency objective to improve semantic coherence and retain efficient inference. We evaluate TGCM on synthetic mixtures, mixed benchmarks, DARPA engagement traces, and CAPTure, an end-to-end benchmark containing 200 scenarios, 855 million audit events, and 25 ATT&CK-aligned attack profiles in single-host and multi-host settings. c2ee17344c0b418e329fa187.title_original: Policy-Controlled Offline-Verifiable Accountability for Cross-Organization Agent Messaging: A Preserved Evidence-Bundle Approach
c2ee17344c0b418e329fa187.excerpt: arXiv:2608.28542v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Cross-organization agent workflows require preserved evidence that remains independently verifiable during later audit or dispute review. Such workflows may involve multiple organizations, delegated actions, policy-relevant events, and disputed accountability claims. This is difficult when live systems are unavailable, controlled by one party, or not trusted by all participants. Existing mechanisms provide useful pieces, including authenticated logging, delegation semantics, signed checkpoints, and consistency checks. What remains missing is a verifier-centered event-level bundle for checking evidence sufficiency offline under an explicit policy. We propose a preserved evidence-bundle model and a policy-controlled offline verifier for agent-to-agent workflow events. Each bundle preserves policy-required evidence, including sender authentication, authenticated log commitment, witness-backed checkpoint evidence, append-only continuity, delegation-aware authorization evidence, and, when issued and required by policy, explicit receiver-signed receipt evidence. The verifier accepts a bundle only when all mandatory and policy-required checks succeed, giving a later dispute reviewer an offline basis for assessing evidence sufficiency. It does not infer delivery or receipt from transport behavior or log inclusion alone. c0bec271bd217bd97c9d9432.title_original: Integrated Identity Protection for Semantic Communications in Embodied IoT Systems
c0bec271bd217bd97c9d9432.excerpt: arXiv:2611.06788v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Embodied Internet of Things (IoT) systems are promoting the adoption of task-oriented semantic communication (SemCom), in which the trustworthy task decisions increasingly require both semantic reliability and source legitimacy. However, existing trustworthy SemCom designs mainly focus on semantic content recovery and protection, with limited attention to source identity protection. Motivated by this limitation, this paper establishes a new information exploitation perspective for integrated SemCom-identity protection that leverages task-level error tolerance to coordinate semantic information and source identity information carried by the same waveform. We first examine these two information resources and then analyze their integration feasibility at the observation, processing, and decision levels. To exploit these resources for different identity protection objectives, we further develop a dual-branch identity protection mechanism with two operating modes. In the authentication mode, semantic recovery and physical-layer source verification are performed in parallel using the same received observation. In the concealment mode, identity exposure is suppressed while semantic reconstruction quality is maintained to support anonymous transmission. Finally, two representative case studies on active source impersonation and passive identity inference are presented to evaluate the proposed framework.

aac1e64a1de02f9fb08d2398.title_original: Nash Incentive-compatible Online Mechanism Learning via Weakly Differentially Private Online Learning
aac1e64a1de02f9fb08d2398.excerpt: arXiv:2407.04898v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We study a multi-round mechanism design problem, where we interact with a set of agents over a sequence of rounds. We wish to design an incentive-compatible (IC) online learning scheme to maximize an application-specific objective within a given class of mechanisms, without prior knowledge of the agents' type distributions. Even if each mechanism in this class is IC in a single round, if an algorithm naively chooses from this class on each round, the entire learning process may not be IC against non-myopic buyers who appear over multiple rounds. On each round, our method randomly chooses between the recommendation of a weakly differentially private online learning algorithm (e.g., Hedge), and a commitment mechanism which penalizes non-truthful behavior. Our method is IC and achieves $O(T^{\frac{1+h}{2}})$ regret for the application-specific objective in an adversarial setting, where $h$ quantifies the long-sightedness of the agents. When compared to prior work, our approach is conceptually simpler,it applies to general mechanism design problems (beyond auctions), and its regret scales gracefully with the size of the mechanism class.

5f69713245ab9cb5c61337cb.title_original: Differential Privacy for Euclidean Jordan Algebra with Applications to Private Symmetric Cone Programming
5f69713245ab9cb5c61337cb.excerpt: arXiv:2509.16915v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: In this paper, we study differentially private mechanisms for functions whose outputs lie in a Euclidean Jordan algebra. Euclidean Jordan algebras capture many important mathematical structures and form the foundation of linear programming, second-order cone programming, and semidefinite programming. Our main contribution is a generic Gaussian mechanism for such functions, with sensitivity measured in $\ell_2$, $\ell_1$, and $\ell_\infty$ norms. Notably, this framework includes the important case where the function outputs are symmetric matrices, and sensitivity is measured in the Frobenius, nuclear, or spectral norm. We further derive private algorithms for solving symmetric cone programs under various settings, using a combination of the multiplicative weights update method and our generic Gaussian mechanism. As an application, we present differentially private algorithms for semidefinite programming, resolving a major open question posed by [Hsu, Roth, Roughgarden, and Ullman, ICALP 2014].

ac19d0126cb7c7382435a65f.title_original: Do Reasoning LLMs Refuse What They Infer in Long Contexts?
ac19d0126cb7c7382435a65f.excerpt: arXiv:2602.08874v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Long-context LLMs can infer objectives that are not explicitly stated. This capability is useful for reasoning over documents, code, and tool traces, but it also introduces a safety risk. Harmful intent can be distributed across a context and become apparent only after the model combines the relevant information. Existing safety evaluations largely focus on explicitly stated harmful requests and therefore do not fully capture this failure mode. We introduce compositional reasoning attacks, a long-context attack setting in which harmful requests are decomposed into semantically incomplete fragments and embedded in long contexts. The final query is neutral, and the model must retrieve and combine the fragments to infer the implied harmful objective. Empirically, we show that models generally refuse harmful requests when they are explicitly stated. However, refusal rates drop when the same objectives must be reconstructed from fragments, and these failures often become more pronounced in longer contexts. Our analyses suggest that this gap cannot be explained by retrieval difficulties alone. Models can often reconstruct the harmful objective but do not reliably refuse it. Increasing inference-time reasoning effort improves refusal, but at a higher computational cost, with unsafe responses still occurring. 341631dde607424b34c49c9d.title_original: Auditing Cross-Lingual Fairness in Language Model Watermarking
341631dde607424b34c49c9d.excerpt: arXiv:2608.20047v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Watermarking schemes for large language model output are evaluated almost exclusively on English text using each scheme's detection threshold and a narrow set of quality measurements. Multilingual deployment exposes evaluation-design choices that are inconsequential on English but determine conclusions cross-lingually. We propose an evaluation framework with four components: detection thresholds calibrated empirically per deployment context, a threshold-independent companion measurement that distinguishes calibration failures from detection failures, three disjoint quality measurement paradigms (distributional, paired-semantic, and reference-perplexity), and a generalized-entropy decomposition of cross-language disparity over a typological family partition. Applied to six watermarking schemes, three open-weight generators, eleven languages spanning four scripts and eight typological families, and both base and instruction-tuned regimes, the framework reveals failure modes that single-language, single-paradigm evaluation cannot surface. Against a shape-matched null, detection disparity is predominantly between-family on the typological partition, indicating that detection gaps are structural to language properties rather than idiosyncratic to particular languages; quality disparity is large but not reliably family-structured.

Operating since September 2022, the Russia-based ransomware group Qilin is the currently the most industrious ransomware-as-a-service gang, according to a report (PDF) this month by the cybersecurity firm NCC Group (KrebsOnSecurity profiled the administrator of the second most active ransomware group — The Gentlemen — in June). The Qilin ransomware administrator “Haise” advertising his affiliate program on the cybercrime forum RAMP. Image: Ke-la.com. Qilin attracts affiliates to hack into companies and deploy ransomware by offering them at least 80 percent of any extortion amount paid by victims. Its members practice the “double extortion” model, stealing sensitive data before encrypting systems and threatening to publish the files online. Unlike most ransomware partnerships based out of Russia, Qilin is happy to team with English-speaking affiliates, and its leader has shared on Telegram that they’ve worked with ransomware groups like Scattered Spider and RansomHub . de34870dcca5f36445a4a4fc.title_ko: 독일 헬싱, 수백 개 에이전트로 군사 정보를 분석하는 AI 공개

00cd69db55b1ccfa88c12b84.title_original: 한컴, AI 매출 전체 30% 돌파…노마디안 등 미국 시장 공략 가속

00cd69db55b1ccfa88c12b84.title_ko: 한컴 AI 매출 비중 30% 넘어…에이전틱 OS·노마디안으로 해외 공략

8aa076e87abc2b15b6da3176.title_original: 영국 AI 칩 스타트업 프랙타일, 9.3조 가치로 1조 투자 유치

8aa076e87abc2b15b6da3176.title_ko: 영국 AI 칩 스타트업 프랙타일, 7억2000만달러 투자 유치
8aa076e87abc2b15b6da3176.summary_ko: AI 추론용 반도체를 개발하는 영국 스타트업 프랙타일이 7억2000만달러를 유치해 기업가치 70억달러를 인정받았다. 자체 D램을 연산 칩 위에 쌓아 데이터 이동 병목을 줄이는 기술을 개발 중이며, 추론 속도를 최대 10배 높인다는 회사 측 주장은 아직 상용 제품으로 검증되지 않았다. 첫 상용 제품은 2027년 출시할 계획이다.
8aa076e87abc2b15b6da3176.background_ko: 창업자는 연산 성능에 비해 메모리 대역폭의 발전이 더뎌 데이터 이동이 병목이 된다고 보고, 연산 칩에 자체 D램을 쌓는 구조를 개발한다고 설명했다.

35239f869c8b05eea09c1344.title_original: 미니맥스, 4K 이미지 약 10초에 생성하는 'H3-이미지' 공개…가중치도 배포

35239f869c8b05eea09c1344.title_ko: 미니맥스, 4K 이미지 생성 모델 H3-이미지 공개…가중치 배포
35239f869c8b05eea09c1344.summary_ko: 미니맥스는 4K 이미지를 고속 모드에서 약 10초에 생성하고, 최대 16장의 참조 이미지를 활용해 편집할 수 있는 오픈웨이트 모델 H3-이미지를 공개했다. 가중치와 코드를 배포했지만 한국 등 일부 지역은 기본 커뮤니티 라이선스 대상에서 제외돼 직접 사용·배포에 별도 허가가 필요하다.
35239f869c8b05eea09c1344.background_ko: H3-이미지는 앞서 공개된 멀티모달 생성 모델 H3를 바탕으로 데이터 구성과 강화학습 등 후속학습을 개선하고 샘플링 단계를 6회로 줄여 개발됐다.

435d788d05e251fa856bfd73.title_original: "Pi 보상 지급" 스미싱으로 유포되는 피싱 및 악성앱 분석
435d788d05e251fa856bfd73.excerpt: 생성형 AI 제작 이미지 최근 Pi Network(파이 네트워크) 암호화폐 보상을 미끼로 한 스미싱이 한국 사용자를 대상으로 유포되고 있습니다. 전체 공격 흐름은 다음과 같습니다. 1. 스미싱 유포 : 카카오톡 알림톡으로 "Pi 보상" 피싱 링크 전달 2. 웹 피싱 3단계 : 24단어 시드 니모닉 탈취 → KYC 개인정보 탈취 → APK 설치 유도 3. 안드로이드 악성앱 : SMS/OTP 가로채기, C2 원격 명령, 금융앱 스캔 수행 4. iOS exploit : 피싱 페이지에 숨겨진 iframe으로 iOS Safari 사용자 대상 WebKit exploit 프레임워크(Coruna 변종) 탑재 웹 피싱으로 암호화폐 지갑 시드와 개인정보를 먼저 확보한 뒤, 안드로이드에는 악성앱을 설치하고 iOS에는 브라우저 exploit을 시도하는 멀티 플랫폼 공격 구조입니다. 이 악성앱은 설치 즉시 SMS/OTP 가로채기, 원격 명령 실행, 금융앱 스캔 등 광범위한 악성 행위를 수행하며, 알약M에서는 Trojan.Android.SmsSpy로 탐지 및 치료가 가능합니다. [그림 1] 주차장 업체를 사칭한 카카오톡 알림톡 유포 경로 : 3단계 피싱 피해자가 스미싱 또는 알림톡으로 수신한 "Pi Network 500π 보상" 링크를 클릭하면, 3단계에 걸쳐 개인정보를 탈취하고 최종적으로 APK 설치를 유도합니다. 1단계 : 24단어 시드 니모닉 탈취 pi-workers.com은 Pi Network 공식 지갑을 정교하게 모방한 피싱 사이트입니다. Pi Network 사용자는 지갑 생성 시 24단어 시드를 발급받는데, 피싱 사이트는 "500π 보상을 수령하려면 지갑 인증이 필요합니다" 라는 명목으로 이 시드 입력을 요구합니다. BIP39 표준 2,048개 단어로 입력값을 엄격 검증하여 유효한 시드만 선별 수집합니다. 참고하세요 시드 니모닉이란? 암호화폐 지갑의 마스터 키를 사람이 기억할 수 있도록 24개 영어 단어로 변환한 것입니다. 이 단어들만 알면 지갑을 완전히 복원·통제할 수 있어, 유출 시 자산 전액 탈취가 가능합니다. 이중 입력 트릭으로 처음 입력 시 의도적으로 "패스프레이즈가 올바르지 않습니다" 오류를 표시하여, 피해자가 다른 시드를 재입력하도록 유도합니다. 이를 통해 공격자는 서로 다른 시드를 2개 이상 확보합니다. 피싱 사이트 소스코드에는 BIP39 표준 2,048개 단어가 통째로 내장되어 있어, 이 목록에 포함된 유효한 단어 조합만 서버로 전송합니다. 3c1f10d7312b2e21d39357c7.excerpt: 이미지 생성형 AI 제작 구글이 최근 크롬 브라우저에서 발견된 제로데이 취약점(CVE-2026-125350)에 대한 보안 업데이트를 배포했습니다. 이번 제로데이 취약점은 크롬이 XML 문서를 변환할 때 사용하는 XSLT 처리 라이브러리 'libxslt'에서 발생하는 '메모리 해제 후 재사용(Use-After-Free)' 결함입니다. XSLT 변환 과정에서 패턴 매칭 결과를 저장해 두는 캐시 메모리를 관리하던 중, 같은 처리가 다시 호출(재진입)되면 이미 해제된 메모리를 다시 해제하고 참조하는 데서 비롯됩니다. 공격자는 조작된 XML·XSLT 코드가 삽입된 웹페이지로 사용자의 접속을 유도하며, 사용자가 페이지를 열람하는 것만으로도 크롬의 보호 영역인 샌드박스(Sandbox) 내에서 공격자가 의도한 임의 코드가 실행될 수 있습니다. 현재 해당 취약점을 악용한 공격이 실제로 확인되고 있어, 사용자분들의 신속한 업데이트를 권고 드립니다. 취약점 개요 CVE CVE-2026-125350 영향 컴포넌트 Google Chrome XML(XSLT) 처리 Chromium 내장 libxslt의 xsltTestCompMatchDirect() 함수( pattern.c ) 취약점 유형 메모리 해제 후 재사용(Use-After-Free, CWE-416) 조작된 HTML 페이지를 통해 원격에서 샌드박스 내부 임의 코드 실행 가능 심각도 High (CVSS v3.1 8.8) AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H Chromium 보안 등급 High. d0d7fadb8103383b1a7d8554.title_original: The global socket: how threat actors are weaponizing GSocket for stealthy C2
d0d7fadb8103383b1a7d8554.excerpt: In this article When one RCE stops being just one RCE Observed attack chains How threat actors deploy and operate GSocket How GSocket reconnects without a fixed C2 address Mitigation and protection guidance References Learn More Microsoft observed multiple incidents in which threat actors deployed GSocket, an open source remote access tool, on compromised Linux servers. Threat actors used Gsocket to maintain access even after the vulnerabilities used for initial compromise were remediated. This turned a single web application compromise into persistent access that outlasted the remediation of the original vulnerabilities. Defenders investigating affected hosts should look for evidence of GSocket deployment, persistence, privilege escalation, and outbound connections, rather than treating application patching alone as complete remediation. Microsoft Defender for Endpoint telemetry shows this activity growing over recent months and concentrated on web applications and hosting environments. GSocket relays traffic through a shared public network, so there is no threat actor-owned IP address or domain to block. When one RCE stops being just one RCE Exploiting a web application vulnerability gives a threat actor command execution in the context of the web server process. That access lasts only while the vulnerability remains unpatched and the service keeps running. Patching the application or restarting the service can remove it. 09ec7db37500c202c42da4a0.excerpt: In this article From scans to reports Selected findings Closing thoughts At Microsoft’s FORGE Lab , we used codename MDASH to scan a subset of Linux kernel subsystems from late May to mid-June 2026. One full-time researcher and one intern led this three-month effort, which has so far produced 59 public upstream reports and 33 assigned CVEs . We confirmed working root privilege-escalation exploits for eight of those CVEs, and fixes for 38 of our reports have been merged into mainline. Finding the bugs was only part of the work. The initial scans produced 26,502 raw findings in about two weeks, but turning those results into reproducible bugs, upstream reports, and patches took months of expert investigation and collaboration with Linux maintainers. In this post, we look back at how we went from thousands of potential findings to validated vulnerabilities and upstream fixes, and what we learned about scaling vulnerability discovery with AI. From scans to reports We focused on several core kernel subsystems, such as networking, filesystems, and security modules. Our selection criteria were straightforward: we picked security-sensitive components with no obvious dependence on specialized hardware, making QEMU-based validation simple and unified. Code scanning mainly used Sonnet 4.6 (71.1% of code-scanning tokens), GPT-5.4 (20.1%), and GPT-5.5 (7.1%). e0e364a24ea4beb4a5606ea2.title_original: Detecting sleeper agents hiding in AI model neurons
e0e364a24ea4beb4a5606ea2.excerpt: Microsoft Research has released new threat research detailing how a capable agent model could be turned into a sleeper agent by editing fewer than 10 neurons to inject a short payload. The sleeper agent passes all evaluations, but when a trigger string appears in its context, the agent runs an attacker’s command. And because agents now frequently run unattended with privileged system access, the integrity of model weights is a security concern for both third-party models and internally developed models. Key findings from Microsoft Research include: Software abuse and manipulation are familiar threats. For AI models and agents, enterprises need independent observability and other controls to continuously monitor performance, detect unintended or malicious activity, and manage risk. Satya Nadella recently outlined this approach in a blog post . A backdoored model can pass evaluations. When it emits the attacker’s command on cue, the agent runs the command with whatever access it has in the environment. The attack needs inference-only compute. If a machine has enough RAM to run a model, it has enough resources to weight-space backdoor it. Claude Code with Opus 4.5 discovered most of this threat autonomously. Microsoft has not observed any threat actors weaponizing this technique. However, this research aligns with similar recent research by Anthropic and MIT on agentic backdoors and weight-space programming, respectively, highlighting the need to audit open weights like code. c7e8b47c0abae3580f5e69fe.excerpt: Update, November 11, 2026: Wordfence 9.1.1 is now available. This small follow-up release updates the bundled list of trusted root certificates (cacert.pem) that Wordfence uses to verify secure connections. It adds no new features and changes no settings, and everything in this post still applies. We recommend updating to 9.1.1. Wordfence 9.1.0 is now available. It adds the new Wordfence Security News Widget , which brings the latest WordPress security alerts and research to your dashboard, plus faster firewall rule updates, sharper firewall request parsing, Live Traffic logging for application password and REST API login failures, configurable attack alert thresholds, and additional features, fixes and improvements. Attackers often hide payloads in malformed or deeply nested input, counting on a firewall reading a request differently than WordPress does. We’ve improved request parsing to narrow that gap, so the firewall inspects that input more like the way WordPress reads it. The firewall also checks for rule updates more often, so new firewall rules reach your site sooner. Live Traffic now logs failed logins through application passwords and the REST API, two ways in that skip wp-login.php. You also get configurable thresholds for WAF attack alerts, so you decide how much attack activity it takes to trigger an alert. 29e0ca5a481d516439ecdc17.title_ko: 삼성전자 온양캠퍼스, HBM 생산 거점 신공장 착공

518156293e40775f10ca69b5.title_ko: 씨드로닉스, 싱가포르 해군 함정에 AI 운항 지원 시스템 공급
518156293e40775f10ca69b5.summary_ko: 씨드로닉스가 싱가포르 해군의 차세대 Sentinel급 원해경비함에 AI 운항 지원 시스템 NAVISS Bridge를 공급한다. 싱가포르 국방부가 공개한 함정 센서 목록에 시스템이 포함됐으며, 회사의 첫 해외 함정 공급이자 민간 선박·관공선에서 검증된 기술의 국방 분야 적용 사례라고 기사에서 설명했다.

77751ac3b89f477cfd2a683b.title_ko: 메가존클라우드 AWS 중개서비스, 조달청 디지털서비스몰 등록
77751ac3b89f477cfd2a683b.summary_ko: 메가존클라우드의 AWS IaaS 중개서비스가 조달청 디지털서비스몰에 등록돼 공공기관에 151개 AWS 서비스를 공급한다. 회사는 디지털서비스몰을 이용하면 기존 2~3개월 걸리던 인프라 계약을 1~2주 안팎으로 줄일 수 있다고 밝혔다. 설계·구축·운영 지원과 공공 보안 가이드라인을 반영한 기술 지원도 제공한다.

e1ba8156776735822f6cc43d.title_ko: 인텔 AI 서밋 서울서 K-AI 풀스택 얼라이언스 출범

2e972ee95334f1efaccef1a3.title_ko: 데브코어, 사파리 웹킷 취약점 연구와 샌드박스 내 코드 실행 시연
2e972ee95334f1efaccef1a3.summary_ko: 데브코어 연구진은 사파리 26.5의 웹킷·자바스크립트코어에서 메모리 참조 갱신 오류와 DFG 최적화 경로의 별도 결함을 이용해 샌드박스 내부 코드 실행을 시연했다. 연구진은 포인터 인증 우회와 JIT 분석 과정을 발표했으며, 입증한 범위는 웹 콘텐츠 프로세스 내부로 운영체제 전체 접근은 시연하지 않았다.

2ff3de0042c2e5ce00d8df1a.title_original: 지니언스, NAC·EDR 동반 성장에 3분기 누적 매출 387억원 달성
2ff3de0042c2e5ce00d8df1a.excerpt: 지니언스가 2026년 연결 기준 3분기 누적 매출액 387억원, 영업이익 81억원을 기록했다고 밝혔다. 전년 동기 대비 매출은 24.0%, 영업이익은 273.9% 늘었다. 영업이익률(OPM)은 20.9%로 지난해 같은 기간 6.9%보다 14.0%포인트 상승했다.실적 성장은 네트워크 접근 제어(NAC)와 엔드포인트 탐지 및 대응(EDR) 사업이 이끌었다. NAC 부문은 공공기관과 지방자치단체 대형 사업을 수주하고 국방과 병원 분야 신규 수요가 늘면서 안정적인 성장세를 보였다. 제조 대기업의 네트워크 보안 통합 사업과 해외 지사 확장
2ff3de0042c2e5ce00d8df1a.summary_ko: 지니언스는 2026년 3분기 누적 매출 387억 원, 영업이익 81억 원을 기록했으며 전년 동기보다 각각 24.0%, 273.9% 증가했다고 밝혔다. 공공·국방·금융 등의 NAC·EDR 수요가 성장에 기여했고, 회사는 AI 보안 통합 플랫폼을 선보인 데 이어 연내 양자내성암호 기반 보안 게이트웨이 출시를 계획했다.
2ff3de0042c2e5ce00d8df1a.background_ko: 공공·지자체 사업 수주와 국방·병원 수요, 여러 산업군의 EDR 신규 도입 및 라이선스 확대가 성장 동력으로 제시됐다.

0c6d47913b4605786e68dc76.excerpt: AI가 실제 프리랜서 업무의 41.3%를 인간 전문가와 동등하거나 더 높은 수준으로 수행할 수 있다는 분석이 나왔다. 단순한 지식이나 추론 능력이 아닌, 경제적 가치가 있는 실무 프로젝트를 처음부터 끝까지 완수하는 역량을 평가한 결과다. 1년 전 같은 지표에서 최고 자동화율이 2.5%에 머물렀던 것과 비교하면 AI의 실무 수행 능력이 크게 향상된 셈이다.미국 AI 안전센터와 스케일 AI는 지난해 처음 공개한 실제 프리랜서 프로젝트 기반 AI 에이전트 평가 지표 ‘원격 노동 지수(RLI·Remote Labor Index)’의 최신 결
0c6d47913b4605786e68dc76.title_ko: AI, 실제 프리랜서 프로젝트 41.3%서 전문가 수준 수행
0c6d47913b4605786e68dc76.summary_ko: 미국 AI 안전센터와 스케일 AI의 원격 노동 지수 최신 평가에서 AI 결과물이 전문가와 동등하거나 더 낫다고 인정된 실제 프리랜서 프로젝트 비율은 최고 41.3%였다. 평가에는 240개 프로젝트가 포함됐다. 이 수치는 일자리 41.3%가 사라진다는 뜻은 아니며, 고객 소통과 팀 협업 등은 평가하지 않았다.
0c6d47913b4605786e68dc76.background_ko: 원격 노동 지수는 실제 전문가 프로젝트를 바탕으로 AI 에이전트의 실무 수행 역량을 평가하는 지표로 만들어졌다.

curation.reason_ko: 평가 지표에서 AI 에이전트의 실무 수행 비중이 크게 상승했다는 분석이 나왔다.

22b353889d8d5e846e20e651.title_original: 순천 외식업 소상공인, AI로 메뉴개발·마케팅 배운다
22b353889d8d5e846e20e651.excerpt: 순천이 지역 외식업 소상공인을 대상으로 마케팅과 메뉴개발, 매장 운영 등에 AI를 활용할 수 있는 실무형 교육을 추진한다.순천은 지난 11일 순천제일대학교 인제관 대회의실에서 순천제일대학교, 한국외식업중앙회 순천시지부와 ‘순천외식업 소상공인 AI 인재양성 및 교육협력을 위한 업무협약’을 체결했다고 밝혔다.협약에 따라 순천제일대학교는 AI 교육과정 개발과 전문강사·교육시설 지원, 교육 운영평가 등 전반적인 교육 운영을 맡는다.한국외식업중앙회 순천시지부는 교육 수요조사, 교육생 모집, 교육 실전 활용사례의 외식업 현장 확산을 담당한다.
22b353889d8d5e846e20e651.title_ko: 순천, 외식업 소상공인 대상 AI 메뉴 개발·마케팅 교육 추진
22b353889d8d5e846e20e651.summary_ko: 순천시·순천제일대·한국외식업중앙회 순천시지부가 외식업 소상공인의 AI 활용 교육을 위해 업무협약을 체결했다. 대학은 교육과정과 강사·시설 지원을 맡고, 외식업지부는 수요조사와 교육생 모집, 시는 행정 지원을 담당해 메뉴 개발·마케팅·매장 운영 중심 교육을 운영할 계획이다.
22b353889d8d5e846e20e651.background_ko: 세 기관은 지역 대학의 인프라와 외식업 단체, 행정의 협력으로 소상공인의 경쟁력을 높이기 위해 협약을 맺었다.

cbced1c1b69b4d7bfe4c2651.title_original: 바이트댄스, 오픈AI 추격에 최소 3년 전망…'뮤즈' 유사 AI 에이전트 준비
cbced1c1b69b4d7bfe4c2651.excerpt: 바이트댄스가 메타의 '뮤즈(Muse)'와 유사한 AI 에이전트를 몇주 내 출시할 계획인 가운데, 장이밍 공동 창업자가 오픈AI와 앤트로픽 등 미국 선도 기업을 따라잡으려면 2029~2030년까지 시간이 필요하다고 밝힌 것으로 알려졌다. 특히 자체 언어모델의 학습 데이터가 미국 경쟁사에 크게 못 미친다고 지적하며 장기적인 기술 개발을 강조했다.블룸버그는 11일(현지시간) 사안에 정통한 관계자들을 인용, 장이밍이 최근 AI 조직 전체 회의에서 이 같은 계획과 핵심 개발 방향을 공유했다고 보도했다.현재 바이트댄스의 AI 전략을 주도하는
cbced1c1b69b4d7bfe4c2651.title_ko: 바이트댄스, AI 에이전트 출시 준비…미국 선도 기업 추격에 최소 3년 전망
cbced1c1b69b4d7bfe4c2651.summary_ko: 블룸버그 보도에 따르면 바이트댄스는 몇 주 내 메타의 Muse와 유사한 AI 에이전트를 내놓을 계획이지만, 구체적인 사양은 공개하지 않았다. 장이밍은 미국 선도 기업 수준에 도달하는 데 2029~2030년까지 걸릴 수 있다고 보고 데이터 부족을 과제로 꼽았으며, 증류 의존 대신 자체 연구를 강조했다.
cbced1c1b69b4d7bfe4c2651.background_ko: 장이밍은 바이트댄스의 언어모델 사전학습 데이터셋이 미국 선도 기업보다 몇 자릿수 작다며, 데이터 부족을 경쟁력 격차의 한 원인으로 지목했다.

6cbc1013aea3b8e58ec371bd.title_original: [게시판] 카카오벤처스, 힉스필드와 스타트업 AI 콘텐츠 제작 지원 등 단신
6cbc1013aea3b8e58ec371bd.excerpt: ■ 카카오벤처스(대표 김기준)는 글로벌 AI 영상 제작 플랫폼 ‘힉스필드’와 초기 스타트업의 AI 콘텐츠 제작 지원을 위한 업무협약(MOU)을 체결했다고 밝혔다. 힉스필드는 238개 국가 및 지역에서 4000만명 이상의 이용자를 확보한 AI 영상·이미지 제작 플랫폼이다. 카카오벤처스는 포트폴리오사의 힉스필드 도입을 지원하고, 힉스필드는 활용 교육과 기술 지원을 제공할 예정이다.■ 메가존클라우드(대표 염동훈)는 조달청 디지털서비스몰에 ‘중개서비스 for AWS’를 등록했다고 밝혔다. 중개서비스 for AWS는 151개 AWS 서비스를
6cbc1013aea3b8e58ec371bd.title_ko: 카카오벤처스, 힉스필드와 스타트업 AI 콘텐츠 제작 지원 등 단신
6cbc1013aea3b8e58ec371bd.summary_ko: 카카오벤처스는 힉스필드와 협약해 포트폴리오 초기 스타트업에 AI 영상·이미지 플랫폼 도입과 교육·기술 지원을 제공한다. 단신에는 컴퓨터 이용 에이전트 기반 마케팅 플랫폼 모파이 출시, AI CCTV·드론을 활용한 산불 예찰 시스템 공개와 무인기 군집 기술 논문·특허 소식도 담겼다.
6cbc1013aea3b8e58ec371bd.background_ko: 카카오벤처스는 초기 스타트업의 AI 콘텐츠 제작을 지원하기 위해 힉스필드와 업무협약을 체결했다.

806755bd7b4d0b3fcb2ed0ca.title_original: 미 제재 중국 군 관련 대학, 엔비디아 H200 구매…서버 임대로도 확보
806755bd7b4d0b3fcb2ed0ca.excerpt: 미국의 수출 제재 대상인 중국 군 관련 대학이 엔비디아의 고성능 AI 반도체 'H200'을 구매한 사실이 확인됐다. 중국 업체를 통해 칩을 직접 구입하고 서버 임대 방식으로도 첨단 AI 연산 자원을 확보한 것으로 나타나, 미국의 중국 반도체 수출 통제에 허점이 있다는 지적이 나온다.로이터는 11일(현지시간) 중국 시안에 있는 서북공업대학의 조달 기록을 확인한 결과, 이 대학이 지난달 H200 칩 2개를 87만4700위안(약 1억7500만원)에 구매했다고 보도했다. 구매 계약은 엔비디아가 아닌 중국 현지 업체인 산시보쏸네트워크기술과
806755bd7b4d0b3fcb2ed0ca.title_ko: 미 제재 중국 군 관련 대학, 엔비디아 H200 구매…서버 임대로도 확보
806755bd7b4d0b3fcb2ed0ca.summary_ko: 로이터가 확인한 조달 기록에 따르면 서북공업대는 중국 업체를 통해 H200 2개를 구매했고, H200 8개가 탑재된 서버 임대 계약도 체결했다. 다만 구매 칩의 실제 사용 목적과 유통 경로는 확인되지 않았으며, 서버 계약은 AI 모델 미세조정·강화학습용으로 기재돼 수출통제의 허점 논란이 제기됐다.
806755bd7b4d0b3fcb2ed0ca.background_ko: 서북공업대학은 미사일 확산 및 군사 연구 관여를 이유로 2001년 미국 거래제한기업목록에 올랐고 2019년 제재가 강화됐다.

curation.reason_ko: 미국 제재 대상 중국 대학의 H200 구매 보도로 AI 반도체 수출 통제의 허점이 제기됐다.

47a95247a83b7549307b536f.title_original: IBM, 차세대 양자 프로세서 '나이트호크 r3' 공개...2027년 1000큐비트 시스템 구축
47a95247a83b7549307b536f.excerpt: IBM이 520큐비트 규모에서 1만 회의 양자 연산을 정확하게 수행하는 차세대 양자 프로세서 'IBM Quantum Nighthawk r3'를 설계했다고 12일 밝혔다. 2027년에는 두 개의 나이트호크 r3 프로세서를 하나로 연결해 1040큐비트 규모의 단일 양자컴퓨팅 시스템을 구축할 계획이다.양자컴퓨터를 실제 산업 현장에 적용하려면 연산의 정확도(품질)와 처리 속도를 동시에 확보해야 한다. 양자컴퓨터는 회로를 반복 실행해 얻은 수많은 샘플 데이터로 답을 도출하는 방식을 쓴다. 문제의 규모가 커질수록 수천 회의 양자 연산과 수억
47a95247a83b7549307b536f.title_ko: IBM, 차세대 양자 프로세서 나이트호크 r3 공개…2027년 1,040큐비트 시스템 계획
47a95247a83b7549307b536f.summary_ko: IBM은 520개의 프로그래머블 큐비트로 1만 회 양자 연산을 지원하는 나이트호크 r3를 설계했다고 밝혔다. 2027년 두 프로세서를 연결해 1,040큐비트 시스템을 구축할 계획이며, 모듈형 확장과 고전 컴퓨팅 자원과의 통합을 추진한다.
47a95247a83b7549307b536f.background_ko: IBM은 양자컴퓨터를 산업 현장에 적용하려면 연산 정확도와 처리 속도를 동시에 확보해야 한다고 설명했다.

3edd9e630a109149c68a00c5.title_original: 텍사스 인스트루먼트, 개발 생태계 'CCStudio'에 에이전틱 AI 기능 통합
3edd9e630a109149c68a00c5.excerpt: 텍사스 인스트루먼트(TI)가 통합 개발 환경 생태계인 'CCStudio'의 에이전틱 AI 기능을 강화하고, 마이크로컨트롤러(MCU), 무선 연결, 레이더 분야의 임베디드 소프트웨어 개발을 지원한다고 12일 밝혔다.이번에 적용된 에이전틱 AI 프레임워크는 단순 코드 작성을 넘어 개발 과정의 주요 작업을 자율적으로 수행한다. 엔지니어가 사용하던 AI 도구에 TI 반도체 장치의 기술 정보를 결합해, 복잡한 설계와 전환 작업에 걸리는 시간을 수개월에서 수일 단위로 줄여준다. 반복 업무가 줄어들면서 개발자는 시스템 아키텍처 설계와 핵심 기능
3edd9e630a109149c68a00c5.title_ko: 텍사스 인스트루먼트, CCStudio에 에이전틱 AI 기능 통합
3edd9e630a109149c68a00c5.summary_ko: TI는 CCStudio에 장치별 SDK·핀 구성·주변기기 정보를 MCP 서버로 연결한 에이전틱 AI를 적용해 코드 생성, 설정, 프로그램 기록과 디버깅을 지원한다고 밝혔다. 타사 장치에서 TI 제품으로의 코드 이전도 자동화하며, 회사는 일부 작업을 수개월에서 수일 또는 수시간으로 줄일 수 있다고 설명했다.
3edd9e630a109149c68a00c5.background_ko: 기존 생성형 AI 도구는 하드웨어별 특성과 세부 기술 정보를 충분히 이해하지 못해 복잡한 임베디드 개발에 적용하기 어려웠다고 TI는 설명했다.

3cd091ae8d258572ea6ff253.title_original: [22회 스마트금융컨퍼런스] 윤완수 웹케시그룹 부회장 “은행의 다음 사용자는 AI 에이전트”
3cd091ae8d258572ea6ff253.excerpt: “이제 금융은 앱이 아니라 에이전트 안에서 일어납니다” 윤완수 웹케시그룹 부회장은 12일 서울 여의도 FKI타워에서 열린 '제22회 스마트금융컨퍼런스'에서 고객의 금융 접점이 앱에서 인공지능(AI) 에이전트로 옮겨가고 있다고 진단했다. 은행이 상대할 이용자가 사람에서 고객의 지시를 받은 AI 에이전트로 넓어진다는 설명이다. '금융의 다음은, AI 에이전트입니다'를 주제로 발표한 윤 부회장은 고객이 에이전트에 지시하면 에이전트가 금리와 수수료,
3cd091ae8d258572ea6ff253.title_ko: 웹케시 부회장 “은행의 다음 사용자는 AI 에이전트”…금융 MCP 강조

bcf973577bf80ff1e4a87921.excerpt: NH농협은행과 비바리퍼블리카(토스)가 제6회 대한민국 스마트금융 대상에서 금융위원장상을 수상했다. 인공지능(AI) 에이전트를 활용한 은행 업무 혁신과 얼굴인식 기반 간편결제로 금융서비스의 편의성과 접근성을 높인 성과를 인정받았다. 전자신문이 서울 여의도 FKI타워에서 12일 개최한 '제6회 대한민국 스마트금융 대상'에서 NH농협은행은 금융부문, 토스는 테크부문 금융위원장상을 각각 받았다. NH농협은행은 '행동하는 은행, 에이전틱 AI 뱅크의 미
bcf973577bf80ff1e4a87921.summary_ko: NH농협은행은 에이전틱 AI 은행 전략으로, 토스는 얼굴인식 간편결제 ‘페이스페이’로 금융위원장상을 받았다. 기사에 따르면 페이스페이는 얼굴정보 암호화와 위변조 방지 기술을 적용했으며, 다른 수상작으로 금융 문서처리·리서치와 개인정보 보호 및 내부통제를 지원하는 AI 플랫폼 등이 소개됐다.
bcf973577bf80ff1e4a87921.background_ko: 기사는 지난해 디지털자산 서비스에 이어 올해는 AI를 실제 금융 업무에 적용한 모델이 시상에서 주목받았다고 전했다.

7e4736cf2923cfb974564dc4.title_original: “선내 OT부터 육상 IT까지” 싸이터·플레인비트, 해양 침해대응 맞손
7e4736cf2923cfb974564dc4.title_ko: 싸이터·플레인비트, 해양 사이버 사고 대응 협력
7e4736cf2923cfb974564dc4.summary_ko: 싸이터와 플레인비트는 선박·해양 인프라의 사이버 사고 조사와 침해대응을 강화하기 위한 업무협약을 맺었다. 양사는 사고 원인 분석·증거 보존·침해평가 절차를 공동 개발하고, 선사 대상 대응 서비스와 합동 훈련·시범사업을 추진한다.
7e4736cf2923cfb974564dc4.background_ko: 선박·해양 인프라는 운항 OT와 IT가 복합 연결돼 있어, 사고 대응에 시스템 이해와 디지털 증거 수집·분석이 함께 필요하다고 설명됐다.

18bcfd25c97ffe3a9bfdc547.title_original: NSHC, 공공·국방 AI 보안 전략 발표... 3단계 선제 예방 강조
18bcfd25c97ffe3a9bfdc547.title_ko: NSHC, 공공·국방 AI 보안 전략 발표…3단계 선제 예방 강조
18bcfd25c97ffe3a9bfdc547.summary_ko: NSHC 윤선희 이사는 대전대 세미나에서 공공·국방 분야의 AI 보안 전략을 발표하고, 프롬프트 감시와 에이전트 거버넌스 등을 포함한 AI 특화 보안 계층, 폐쇄망 배치와 데이터 주권 관리를 제안했다. 또 ASM으로 외부 노출 자산과 비인가 AI를 식별하고, AI 레드팀 점검과 실전형 교육을 연계하는 3단계 선제 예방 체계를 제시했다.

9a3176a2d3cb9eaffd009879.title_original: “월간 패치·경보 추적 시대는 끝났다” 구글, 2027 보안 패러다임 제시
9a3176a2d3cb9eaffd009879.title_ko: 구글, 2027년 보안 전망 발표…에이전트 공격 대응 강조
9a3176a2d3cb9eaffd009879.summary_ko: 구글 클라우드는 보안 리더 5명의 전망에서 에이전트에 의한 의사결정 조작, 제로데이·공급망 공격, LLM재킹과 에이전트 확산을 주요 위협으로 꼽았다. 이에 의사결정 추적성, 에이전트별 신원 부여, 적대적 레드팀 검증, 자율 방어와 개발·실행 환경에 보안을 내재화하는 방안을 제안했다.

0ca8ed37886202dc1393fa0e.title_original: Node.js Fixes 16 Flaws, Including HTTP/2 Bugs That Crash Servers and Leak Other Connections' Data
0ca8ed37886202dc1393fa0e.title_ko: Node.js, 서버 충돌·메모리 노출 등 보안 취약점 16건 수정
0ca8ed37886202dc1393fa0e.summary_ko: Node.js가 보안 결함 16건을 수정했으며, HTTP/2 서버 충돌과 다른 연결의 메모리 노출, HTTPS 연결 메모리 유출 등이 포함됐다. 프로젝트는 지원 중인 22.x·24.x·26.x 계열의 수정 버전을 공개했으며, 해당 조건의 서버는 업데이트해야 한다고 안내했다. 이 취약점의 실제 공격 악용 사례는 보고되지 않았다.
0ca8ed37886202dc1393fa0e.background_ko: 문제는 Node.js 자체의 HTTP/2·HTTPS·TLS 서버 코드에서 발생하며, 요청 본문 처리나 스트림 종료 등 특정 조건에서 충돌이나 메모리 노출로 이어질 수 있다.

d08132e02cf50d9e65ba451b.title_original: Maersk Confirms Data Theft Amid $5 Million Extortion Attempt
d08132e02cf50d9e65ba451b.excerpt: The WhiteArmor ransomware group claims it stole 100GB of data from the shipping giant’s systems. The post Maersk Confirms Data Theft Amid $5 Million Extortion Attempt appeared first on SecurityWeek .
d08132e02cf50d9e65ba451b.title_ko: Maersk, 데이터 탈취 확인…해커 집단은 500만 달러 요구
d08132e02cf50d9e65ba451b.summary_ko: Maersk는 과거 인수로 물려받은 IT 시스템에서 해커가 데이터를 빼낸 사실을 확인했으며, 조사와 시스템 보안 조치를 진행 중이라고 밝혔다. WhiteArmor는 LF Logistics 관련 데이터 약 100GB를 탈취했다고 주장하며 500만 달러를 요구했지만, 이 주장은 독립적으로 확인되지 않았고 Maersk도 해당 집단의 연루나 탈취 데이터 종류를 확인하지 않았다.
d08132e02cf50d9e65ba451b.background_ko: Maersk는 침해된 시스템이 과거 인수 과정에서 물려받은 시스템이라고 밝혔다.

CVE-2026-102589.description: When independent Grafana instances share the same [rendering] renderer_token, an image renderer key issued by one instance is accepted by the others, so a user on one instance could act as the user with the same ID on another (origin validation error). This affects instances with the renderAuthJWT feature toggle enabled, the default from Grafana 13.0.0.
CVE-2026-102589.summary_ko: Grafana 인스턴스 간 동일한 렌더러 토큰 공유 시 발생하는 인증 오류입니다. 한 인스턴스의 사용자가 다른 인스턴스에서 동일한 ID를 가진 사용자의 권한으로 동작할 수 있습니다.

CVE-2026-106023.description: NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in Apache HTTP Server's mod_md during HTTP request processing. This issue affects Apache HTTP Server: from 2.4.30 through 2.4.69.

CVE-2026-107509.description: A user with the Viewer role can make Grafana allocate an unbounded amount of memory, and crash it, with a single SQL Expression query that casts a value to a very large BINARY length (memory allocation with excessive size value).

CVE-2026-109163.description: Stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability in Apache HTTP Server's mod_vhost_alias (after CVE-2026-63292) This issue affects Apache HTTP Server: 2.4.69.

CVE-2026-110289.description: A user with the Organization Admin role could point the server or token URL of a Git Sync connection at a loopback or internal address, and Grafana would then send the connection's OAuth client secret and tokens, or requests signed with the GitHub App private key, to that address (server-side request forgery).

CVE-2026-110992.description: A user who can create Git Sync provisioning jobs (the Editor role by default) could delete or move files outside the configured repository path with a job that references a resource whose source path contains ../ sequences (path traversal). With a local filesystem repository on versions before 13.0.4 and 13.1.1, this reached files on the Grafana host.

CVE-2026-111000.description: A user with the Editor role who can edit a folder can move it, through the folders resource API, under a folder they administer, and so gain Admin on the moved folder and its contents, including the right to change their permissions. The legacy folder move API refuses the same move (improper privilege management).
CVE-2026-111000.summary_ko: 폴더 자원 API를 통해 에디터 권한 사용자가 폴더를 관리 권한이 있는 경로로 이동할 때 발생하는 부적절한 권한 관리 취약점입니다. 공격자는 이동된 폴더와 그 내부 콘텐츠에 대해 관리자 권한을 획득하고 권한 설정을 변경할 수 있습니다.

CVE-2026-111024.description: A user with the Viewer or Editor role could bypass folder permissions on Git Sync managed resources through the repository files API: a Viewer could read files in folders they could not access, and an Editor could create, modify, move or delete provisioned dashboards and folders there (incorrect authorization).

CVE-2026-119618.description: Concurrent Execution using Shared Resource with Improper Synchronization vulnerability in Apache HTTP Server's mod_http2 in assign_headers() can lead to RCE. This issue affects Apache HTTP Server: from 2.4.55 through 2.4.70. Affected releases of mod_h2 from GitHub: from 2.0.8 through 2.0.42.
CVE-2026-119618.summary_ko: Apache HTTP Server의 mod_http2에서 공유 자원 동기화 오류로 발생하는 원격 코드 실행 취약점입니다. 헤더 할당 과정에서의 결함이 영향을 미칩니다.

CVE-2026-123710.description: A flaw was found in Red Hat Quay. An unauthenticated client can obtain an anonymous registry token with an audience it controls, present that token to the service key rotation endpoint, and install its own approved signing key with no expiry. Registry tokens signed with that key are accepted for any repository, allowing read and write access to private images and replacement of repository tags.
CVE-2026-123710.summary_ko: Red Hat Quay의 레지스트리 토큰 처리 결함입니다. 인증되지 않은 클라이언트가 임의의 서명 키를 등록하여 사설 이미지에 대한 읽기 및 쓰기 권한을 얻고 태그를 교체할 수 있습니다.

CVE-2026-124746.description: A flaw was found in BusyBox. An integer overflow occurs in the volume_id component when calculating buffer boundaries while probing filesystem metadata. An attacker can exploit this vulnerability by providing a specially crafted filesystem image on an attached storage device. When probed by utilities such as blkid, findfs, or mount, the application crashes, resulting in a Denial of Service (DoS) that prevents the system from resolving or mounting storage devices.

CVE-2026-126325.description: A critical remote code execution (RCE) vulnerability has been reported in PTC Windchill and PTC FlexPLM. The vulnerability may be exploited through the deserialization of untrusted data.
CVE-2026-126325.summary_ko: PTC Windchill 및 FlexPLM에서 발생하는 치명적인 원격 코드 실행 취약점입니다. 신뢰할 수 없는 데이터의 역직렬화 과정을 통해 악용될 수 있습니다.

CVE-2026-13721.description: A user with edit access to one folder could modify, move or delete Git Sync provisioned resources in folders where they only had view access, through the provisioning files API (incorrect authorization).

CVE-2026-14242.description: A user with the Editor role could delete, move, push or pull Git Sync managed resources in folders where they only had view access, by creating a provisioning job through the jobs resource API, which skipped the folder permission checks (incorrect authorization).

CVE-2026-44929.description: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) vulnerability in Apache XML Graphics Batik. This issue affects Apache XML Graphics Batik: through 1.19. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 1.20, which fixes the issue.
CVE-2026-44929.summary_ko: Apache XML Graphics Batik 1.19 이하 버전에서 서버 측 요청 위조(SSRF) 취약점이 발견되었습니다. 외부에서 의도치 않은 서버 자원에 접근하거나 요청을 수행할 수 있는 위험이 있습니다.
