CVE-2026-71395.description: unsafe deserialization in hyphenation loading vulnerability in Apache XML Graphics FOP. This issue affects Apache XML Graphics FOP: through 2.11. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 2.12, which fixes the issue.

CVE-2026-82014.description: Any authenticated user, including a Viewer, could change the preferences of any team, such as its home dashboard, theme and timezone, through an undocumented endpoint with no access control, and so redirect every member of that team to a dashboard of their choice (missing authorization).

CVE-2026-85632.description: Missing authentication for critical function and Improper validation of integrity check value vulnerability in Sipay Electronic Money and Payment Services Inc. WooCommerce Virtual POS Module allows Authentication Bypass and Application API Message Manipulation via Man-in-the-Middle. This issue affects WooCommerce Virtual POS Module: from 26.8.3 before 26.9.1.
CVE-2026-85632.summary_ko: Sipay WooCommerce Virtual POS 모듈 26.8.3 버전에서 인증 누락 및 무결성 검증 미흡 취약점이 발견되었습니다. 중간자 공격을 통해 인증 우회 및 API 메시지 조작이 가능합니다.

CVE-2026-89326.description: Origin Validation Error vulnerability in Apache XML Graphics Batik: the external resource same-origin check does not compare the URL protocol This issue affects Apache XML Graphics Batik: through 1.19. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 1.20, which fixes the issue.

CVE-2026-100290.description: The regcomp and regexec functions in the GNU C Library version 2.3 to version 2.44 may read freed memory and free the same heap block twice when a memory allocation fails while a regular expression is compiled or matched. The re_dfa_add_node (the NFA node table) and build_range_exp (bracket ranges) grow several arrays with consecutive realloc calls and store the new pointers only after all of them succeed. When a later call fails, the pattern buffer keeps pointers to blocks that were already freed, and the error cleanup frees them again. In regexec, the back-reference cache (match_ctx_add_entry) frees its array when a realloc fails but keeps the pointer, which is freed again on the error path. An attacker does not need to supply a crafted regular expression: patterns large enough to grow these arrays are common. The failure has to hit a specific allocation, though, so the issue can only be reached when the system is already under memory pressure. An attacker who supplies the pattern or the subject string has little control over which allocation fails, so the expected impact is a crash of the process. This issue affects all architectures and ABIs supported by the GNU C Library.
CVE-2026-100290.summary_ko: GNU C Library 2.3부터 2.44 버전의 regcomp 및 regexec 함수에서 메모리 할당 실패 시 해제된 메모리를 참조하거나 동일한 힙 블록을 중복 해제하는 취약점이 발견되었습니다. 이는 시스템 메모리 부족 상황에서 프로세스 충돌을 유발할 수 있습니다.

CVE-2026-105440.description: Missing authorization in the JSON-RPC web services interface of Extreme Networks Switch Engine (EXOS) allows an authenticated, low-privileged (read-only) user to execute CLI show commands that are restricted to that role through the command line interface. Successful exploitation results in disclosure of sensitive information, including the device configuration and the password hashes of local accounts. Configuration, enable, and debug commands are not affected. Disclosed password hashes can be attacked offline, and a weak password could lead to administrative access to the device. This issue is fixed in Switch Engine 33.7.1-patch1-11, 33.1.100.133-patch1-9, and 32.7.4.15-patch1-11. Extreme Networks would like to thank Toàn Lê (GitHub: https://github.com/toanln-cov) for responsibly disclosing this vulnerability and for working with our PSIRT team through coordinated disclosure.

CVE-2026-115819.description: Calling the wide scanf family of functions (swscanf, fwscanf, wscanf, vswscanf, vfwscanf and vwscanf) with a %s or %[ conversion without the 'l' length modifier in the GNU C Library version 2.2 to version 2.44 writes an extra null byte one past the end of the destination array when the converted multibyte string and its terminating null byte exactly fill that array. These conversions store each wide input character into the caller's char array as a multibyte sequence. The conversion ends with the sequence that returns to the initial shift state, which also stores the terminating null byte, and the functions then append a second null byte. A destination sized for the converted string and one terminator, as the C standard requires the caller to provide, is therefore written one byte past its end. The out-of-bounds byte is always a null byte, which may corrupt adjacent data or crash the process. An attacker who supplies the input can trigger the overflow with a string whose converted length exactly fills the destination. The narrow scanf functions, the %ls and %l[ conversions into a wchar_t array, and the 'a' and 'm' allocation modifiers are not affected, and storing a wide scanf conversion into a narrow char array is uncommon. This issue affects all architectures and ABIs supported by the GNU C Library.

CVE-2026-124686.description: In Progress® Kendo® UI for jQuery versions prior to 2026.4.1111, kendo.init() compiles data-* attribute values with new Function when an invalid JSON object is supplied. An attacker with low privileges who can control these attribute values can inject JavaScript that executes during declarative widget initialization when a user loads or interacts with an affected page. Successful exploitation can compromise the confidentiality and integrity of data accessible in the user's browser context. The issue was reported in version 2022.3.1109; the first affected release has not been established.

CVE-2026-64855.description: soapbar is a SOAP library for Python — client, server, and WSDL handling. Prior to version 0.13.0, verify_envelope_bsp() derived its trust anchor from the message it was verifying. It read the X.509 certificate out of the caller-untrusted wsse:BinarySecurityToken, validated only that certificate's not-before / not-after dates, and then verified the signature against that same certificate. There was no CA-chain validation, no issuer/subject allowlist, and no pinning. A successful verify_envelope_bsp() therefore proved only that the envelope was signed by whoever supplied the embedded certificate — never that it was signed by a trusted party. An attacker who mints their own certificate, signs a forged envelope, and embeds that certificate in the token passes verification. Any consumer that treats a successful BSP verification as authentication can be impersonated (signature forgery / authentication bypass). verify_envelope() (which pins a caller-supplied x509_cert) was not affected — the flaw was specific to the BSP variant whose trust anchor came from the message. This issue has been patched in version 0.13.0.

CVE-2026-110697.description: A flaw was found in Quay where the robot account listing function constructs a SQL LIKE pattern from user-controlled namespace names without escaping wildcard metacharacters. An attacker who creates a namespace containing an underscore character can match and retrieve robot accounts and their decrypted authentication tokens from other tenants' namespaces, leading to cross-tenant credential theft and unauthorized image operations.
CVE-2026-110697.summary_ko: Quay의 로봇 계정 목록 기능에서 SQL LIKE 패턴 생성 시 와일드카드를 적절히 처리하지 않아 발생하는 취약점입니다. 공격자가 특정 네임스페이스를 생성하여 타 테넌트의 로봇 계정 정보와 복호화된 인증 토큰을 탈취하고 무단 이미지 작업을 수행할 수 있습니다.

CVE-2026-116633.description: A potential vulnerability was reported in some Lenovo Tablets that could allow a third-party application to perform an arbitrary file write with elevated privileges.

CVE-2026-119233.description: proxygen's HTTP/3 codec buffered an incomplete non-DATA frame, such as a control-stream frame, a frame of an unknown or reserved type, or a HEADERS frame, until its entire declared length had arrived, without limiting that length, and re-scanned all buffered data each time more bytes arrived. A remote, unauthenticated HTTP/3 peer could declare a very large frame and deliver it slowly, causing unbounded memory growth and CPU usage that grows quadratically with the number of fragments, leading to denial of service. This issue affects proxygen versions prior to v2026.11.09.00.
CVE-2026-119233.summary_ko: proxygen v2026.11.09.00 이전 버전의 HTTP/3 코덱은 불완전한 프레임을 제한 없이 버퍼링하여 메모리 고갈과 CPU 과부하를 유발합니다. 원격의 인증되지 않은 공격자가 조작된 프레임을 통해 서비스 거부 상태를 초래할 수 있습니다.

CVE-2026-119234.description: mvfst did not adequately merge or compact out-of-order STREAM frame data, and a small received fragment could keep a much larger receive buffer alive. QUIC flow control limits the number of buffered stream bytes, but not this per-fragment memory and bookkeeping. A remote, unauthenticated QUIC peer could send many small, non-contiguous stream fragments to make an endpoint consume memory far in excess of its advertised receive window and spend increasing CPU time reassembling stream data, leading to denial of service. This issue affects mvfst versions prior to v2026.11.09.0.

CVE-2026-119235.description: proxygen's QPACK decoder enforced its size limit on a string literal in an encoder-stream instruction only after the entire literal had been received. A remote, unauthenticated HTTP/3 peer could send an insert instruction on the QPACK encoder stream that declares an arbitrarily large literal and then keep sending data, causing the decoder to buffer it without bound for the lifetime of the connection and exhaust memory, leading to denial of service. The issue occurs regardless of the advertised QPACK dynamic table capacity, including when the dynamic table is disabled. This issue affects proxygen versions prior to v2026.11.09.00.

CVE-2026-119236.description: An mvfst QUIC server retained CRYPTO frame data received at an encryption level (Initial or Handshake) that the TLS handshake had already moved past. Because the transport treated this data as delivered, it did not count against the CRYPTO stream buffer limit. A remote, unauthenticated client could complete a handshake, withhold its acknowledgment of the server's HANDSHAKE_DONE frame so that Handshake keys stay in use, and keep sending Handshake-level CRYPTO data at increasing offsets, causing unbounded memory growth on the server and leading to denial of service. This issue affects mvfst versions prior to v2026.11.09.00.

CVE-2026-119237.description: In proxygen's HTTP/3 session, when a HEADERS block referenced QPACK dynamic table entries that had not yet been received, header decoding for that stream was paused, but the session continued to read the stream from the QUIC transport. The unread data bypassed the session's ingress buffer limit, returned flow-control credit to the peer, and was re-scanned in full on every read. With QPACK blocked streams enabled (the default), a remote, unauthenticated HTTP/3 peer could send a HEADERS block that references a dynamic table insert it never sends, followed by a continuous stream of data, causing memory growth until the request timed out and CPU usage that grows quadratically, leading to denial of service. This issue affects proxygen versions prior to v2026.11.09.00.

CVE-2026-119238.description: A potential improper permissions vulnerability was reported in Lenovo XiangBangbang that could allow a local application to perform unauthorized touch gestures.

CVE-2026-119723.description: When parsing request variables such as query-string and form parameters, HHVM did not check that appending a nested array succeeded before descending into it. A remote, unauthenticated attacker could send a GET or POST request which would crash the HHVM server process before any application code runs, leading to denial of service. This issue affected HHVM prior to 23c061f4e804a51badd5f85227e65185651253b5.

CVE-2026-121737.description: When a remote, unauthenticated HTTP/1.1 client pipelined the start of a second request and then stopped reading, proxygen's coroutine-based HTTP session could free that pipelined stream while resetting the connection's streams on the resulting write timeout, then go on to use it. This can crash the server, leading to denial of service, and may allow memory corruption with further impact. This issue affects proxygen versions prior to v2026.11.09.00.

CVE-2026-122043.description: repmgr 4.0.0 through 5.5.0 is affected by an OS command injection vulnerability (CWE-78) in event notifications. When event_notification_command is configured, repmgr substitutes the %a (node name), %c (connection string) and %d (details) placeholders into the command and runs it through the shell. %a and %c are inserted without escaping, and %d escapes only double quotes, so shell command substitution still works inside the quoting the documentation recommends. The node name and connection string come from node records in the repmgr.nodes table. An attacker with the credentials of a non-superuser repmgr database user can write a crafted node record and run OS commands, as the operating system user that runs repmgr or repmgrd (usually postgres), on other cluster nodes that process an event using these placeholders. The %a placeholder of failover_validation_command has the same flaw. Deployments whose repmgr database user is a superuser gain no new capability, because a superuser can already run OS commands, and deployments that do not use these placeholders are not affected. The issue is fixed in repmgr 5.5.1. After upgrading, operators must remove any quotes they placed around these placeholders, because a placeholder left inside double quotes is still open to command injection.

CVE-2026-124687.description: In Progress® Kendo® UI for jQuery versions from 2022.2.621 prior to 2026.4.1111 the DropDownButton and SplitButton allow markup injection through the `id` and `target` attributes. An attacker who can influence these item values can break out of the attributes and inject markup, including event handlers. The issue is fixed in 2026.4.1111.

CVE-2026-124688.description: In Progress® Kendo® UI for jQuery prior to 2026.4.1111 the TabStrip, PanelBar, and Menu widgets support mapping a dataSource field to `spriteCssClass`. If an attacker can control the mapped data, they can break out of the attribute and inject markup, including event-handler attributes. The resulting JavaScript executes in the application's origin when a victim loads a page that renders the affected widget, allowing access to data and actions available in the victim's authenticated session.

CVE-2026-124689.description: In Progress Kendo UI for jQuery versions 2026.3.1014 up to, but not including, 2026.4.1110, ActionSheet does not encode title, subtitle, and header button label values before rendering them. An attacker who can influence these values can inject markup that executes as JavaScript when a user opens the ActionSheet. Successful exploitation may compromise the confidentiality and integrity of data available in the user's browser context. The report identifies version 2026.3.1014; the first affected release has not been established.

CVE-2026-124690.description: In Progress Kendo UI for jQuery, sanitizeSvgContent() parses custom icon markup into a live DOM before filtering it. An attacker who can influence custom icon content can cause JavaScript to execute during icon creation, before an unsafe element is removed. The issue was reported in version 2026.3.1015; the first affected release has not been established. The issue is fixed in version 2026.4.1110.

CVE-2026-124692.description: In Progress Kendo UI for jQuery versions 2026.3.1015 up to, but not including, 2026.4.1110, the Grid and TreeList column-reorder drag clue reparses header text as HTML. An attacker who can influence a column field or title used by an affected application can cause JavaScript to execute when a user drags a column header while column reordering is enabled. Successful exploitation may compromise the confidentiality and integrity of data available in the user's browser context. The first affected release has not been established.

CVE-2026-124693.description: In Progress Kendo UI for jQuery versions 2026.3.1015 up to, but not including, 2026.4.1110, PivotGrid and PivotConfigurator axis field names are passed to a chip template without appropriate encoding. An attacker who can influence an axis field name can cause JavaScript to execute when a user views the rendered chip. The field name can be interpreted as HTML in both attribute and element contexts. Successful exploitation may compromise the confidentiality and integrity of data available in the user's browser context. The first affected release has not been established.

CVE-2026-124694.description: In Progress Kendo UI for jQuery versions 2026.3.1015 up to, but not including, 2026.4.1110, PropertyGrid does not encode bound property values and items[].description in its default configuration. An attacker who can influence either value can cause JavaScript to execute when a user views the grid. Successful exploitation may compromise the confidentiality and integrity of data available in the user's browser context. The first affected release has not been established.

CVE-2026-126720.description: Rooxis RXR-12 Wi-Fi router contains an unauthenticated remote code execution vulnerability in /usr/bin/cloud_manage, where a server-controlled JSON diagnoseParameter field is passed unsanitized to popen(), enabling arbitrary command execution as root over cleartext HTTP when an attacker is positioned on-path and has access to the hard-coded cloud endpoint. Firmware 20260813_c2169ea5 fixes the vulnerability, and your router can be updated through the local web interface.

CVE-2026-126722.description: Rooxis RXR-12 Wi-Fi router contains an undocumented telnet backdoor daemon (/usr/bin/telnetd_startup) that, upon receipt of a precomputed AES-128-CBC magic packet using a firmware-wide static key and IV, enables telnet service with default credentials, providing remote root access. Firmware 20260813_c2169ea5 removes the UDP listener entirely, and users can update through their local web interface.

CVE-2026-126723.description: Rooxis RXR-12 Wi-Fi router contains an authenticated command injection vulnerability in the LuCI white_list RPC handler (/usr/lib/lua/luci/data/white_list_plt.lua), where unsanitized user-supplied MAC addresses are concatenated into os.execute() without validation, yielding root command execution via a malformed mac parameter. Firmware 20260813_c2169ea5 fixes the vulnerability, and users can update their router through the local web interface.

CVE-2026-126724.description: Rooxis RXR-12 Wi-Fi router contains an undocumented UID-0 backdoor account (dg) with a firmware-wide default password (ivanlee) and interactive shell (/bin/ash), allowing authentication as root via SSH or local console without device-specific secrets. Firmware 20260813_c2169ea5 removes the account from the shipped root filesystem and disables root password authentication in SSH. Users can update their router can be through the local web interface.
CVE-2026-126724.summary_ko: Rooxis RXR-12 라우터에 포함된 문서화되지 않은 관리자 계정 백도어입니다. 기본 암호와 쉘 접근 권한이 설정되어 있어 SSH 등을 통한 루트 접근이 가능합니다.

CVE-2026-77873.description: An improper permissions vulnerability was reported in Lenovo System Update that could allow a local authenticated user to execute code with elevated privileges.
CVE-2026-77873.summary_ko: Lenovo System Update에서 부적절한 권한 관리 취약점이 확인되었습니다. 로컬에 인증된 사용자가 권한 상승을 통해 임의 코드를 실행할 수 있는 위험이 있습니다.

CVE-2026-77882.description: A deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability was discovered in Lenovo System Update that could allow a local authenticated user to execute code with elevated privileges.
CVE-2026-77882.summary_ko: Lenovo System Update에서 신뢰할 수 없는 데이터의 역직렬화 취약점이 발견되었습니다. 로컬의 인증된 사용자가 권한을 상승시켜 코드를 실행할 수 있습니다.

CVE-2026-89061.description: During an internal security assessment, a potential vulnerability was discovered in Lenovo PC Manager, distributed exclusively in the Chinese market, that could allow a local user to escalate privileges.

CVE-2026-106133.description: In Progress® Telerik® Report Server prior to version 12.3.26.1110, an incorrect authorization vulnerability in the Web Report Designer allows an authenticated attacker with low privileges to perform unauthorized operations on shared report resources, affecting their integrity and availability.

CVE-2026-106137.description: In affected versions of Progress® Telerik® UI for ASP.NET MVC `2012.2.710` through `2026.3.811`, ClassFactory updates a shared class dictionary without exclusive write protection and emits non-collectible dynamic assemblies that remain loaded for the AppDomain's lifetime. The dictionary lookup and insertion are not atomic, and case variations in aggregate descriptors can produce distinct retained types even though member resolution is case-insensitive. An unauthenticated remote attacker can exploit this if the application exposes an aggregation endpoint that is reachable without authentication, by submitting concurrent or repeated crafted requests. These requests may corrupt dictionary state or increase CPU and memory use, potentially degrading availability. The issue is fixed in version `2026.3.1015`.
CVE-2026-106137.summary_ko: Progress Telerik UI for ASP.NET MVC의 클래스 팩토리에서 발생하는 원자성 결함입니다. 동시 요청을 통해 딕셔너리 상태를 손상하거나 자원 사용량을 증가시켜 가용성을 저하시킬 수 있습니다.

CVE-2026-106152.description: In Progress® Telerik® Report Server prior to version 12.3.26.1110, an external control of a system configuration setting vulnerability allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to influence the server address used by Report Server when generating links and notifications. With user interaction, this can lead to disclosure of sensitive information and account takeover.

CVE-2026-106156.description: In Progress® Telerik® UI for ASP.NET Core versions `2015.1.318` through `2026.3.811`, repeated server-side aggregation requests, with or without grouping, cause dynamic assemblies and load contexts to be retained, resulting in accumulating process memory consumption. An unauthenticated remote attacker can exploit this if the application exposes an aggregation endpoint that is reachable without authentication. Repeated requests can cause memory growth that may exhaust available resources and affect application availability. Disabling grouping in the client-side interface does not prevent direct requests containing these descriptors. The issue is fixed in version `2026.3.1015`.

CVE-2026-107247.description: An authorization bypass in Revive Adserver 6.0.0 through 6.0.8 allows an authenticated manager restricted to one agency to access or modify resources belonging to another agency. Global input registration gives GET parameters precedence over POST parameters, while submitted administration forms use POST values. By supplying authorized object identifiers in the query string and different identifiers in the POST body, an attacker can cause permission checks and subsequent operations to target different objects. This permits unauthorized cross-agency changes, campaign ownership reassignment and disclosure of campaign and banner data. The regression was introduced in commit 156dee7bc3283c128f35e5a31bb305054cc8de1b and is fixed in Revive Adserver 6.0.9 by restoring POST precedence in global input registration.

CVE-2026-107662.description: Blind SQL injection in Revive Adserver 6.0.8 and earlier allows an authenticated manager restricted to one agency to extract arbitrary database values through the banner-zone.php and campaign-zone.php administration pages. Permission checks and database queries obtain identifiers through inconsistent request-input precedence, allowing an authorized numeric identifier to pass validation while a different, attacker-controlled value reaches an SQL query. Extracted data can include password hashes and active session identifiers. Reusing an unexpired administrator session can grant administrative access, allowing modification of configuration and disruption of ad delivery. The issue is fixed in Revive Adserver 6.0.9 by consistently selecting POST values before GET values in both global input registration and common input helpers, and excluding cookies from these helpers. Both commits e301dbbb7 and 0aa9d0124 are required for the complete correction.

CVE-2026-108558.description: A reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability in the conversion-statistics pages of Revive Adserver 6.0.8 and earlier allows an unauthenticated attacker to execute JavaScript in an authenticated user's browser by persuading them to visit a crafted URL. An incorrect ownership check validates the advertiser identifier instead of the supplied website identifier, allowing malicious website input to reach HTML output without appropriate encoding. A related output issue affects the hour parameter. The issue is fixed in Revive Adserver 6.0.9 by validating the correct website identifier and normalising the hour parameter before formatting.
CVE-2026-108558.summary_ko: Revive Adserver의 통계 페이지에서 발생하는 반사형 교차 사이트 스크립팅(XSS) 취약점입니다. 부적절한 소유권 검사로 인해 악성 입력값이 인코딩 없이 출력되어 공격자가 스크립트를 실행할 수 있습니다.

CVE-2026-108559.description: A reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability in the iframe invocation options of Revive Adserver 6.0.8 and earlier allows an unauthenticated attacker to execute JavaScript in an authenticated user's browser by persuading them to visit a crafted URL. When generating invocation tags for an any-size zone, the frame_width and frame_height request parameters are included in HTML attributes without appropriate encoding. The issue is fixed in Revive Adserver 6.0.9 by HTML-encoding the affected values in the invocation-option form fields.

CVE-2026-108560.description: A reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability in updates-history.php in Revive Adserver 6.0.8 and earlier allows an unauthenticated attacker to execute JavaScript in a victim's browser by persuading them to visit a crafted URL. Attacker-controlled values are included in XML command attributes without appropriate encoding, allowing injection of executable XHTML into the response. The preliminary session check omits GET xajax requests, exposing an unauthenticated attack path, while authenticated administrator requests also reach the unsafe output. The issue is fixed in Revive Adserver 6.0.9 by applying the session check to both GET and POST requests and encoding XML command attribute values in both response serializers.

CVE-2026-108561.description: A stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in the report date-selection controls of Revive Adserver 6.0.8 and earlier allows an unauthenticated attacker to execute JavaScript in a victim's browser by persuading them to follow a crafted report URL and complete normal reauthentication. An attacker-controlled period_preset value can be saved in the victim's session and inserted into JavaScript without appropriate encoding. The payload can execute on the initial report view and subsequent report views using the stored defaults. The issue is fixed in Revive Adserver 6.0.9 by applying JSON encoding appropriate for the JavaScript context to date-selection values.

CVE-2026-108562.description: A stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in maintenance-appendcode-check.php in Revive Adserver 6.0.8 and earlier allows an authenticated manager to execute JavaScript in an administrator's browser. A manager can store a malicious tracker name and cause the tracker to appear in the append-code maintenance results. When an administrator opens the affected maintenance page, the tracker name is included in HTML without appropriate encoding. The issue is fixed in Revive Adserver 6.0.9 by HTML-encoding tracker names when displaying the maintenance results.

CVE-2026-108563.description: Spreadsheet formula injection in conversion-tracking report exports in Revive Adserver 6.0.8 and earlier allows an unauthenticated attacker to submit conversion values that are written as formulas instead of text in an XLS workbook. When a user opens the exported report in a spreadsheet application, attacker-supplied formulas can be evaluated. The confirmed impact is formula execution within the workbook; disclosure of information to the attacker has not been established. The issue is fixed in Revive Adserver 6.0.9 by sanitising conversion values before writing them to the affected XLS report sections.

CVE-2026-108564.description: A reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability in the invocation-tag generation interface of Revive Adserver 6.0.8 and earlier allows an unauthenticated attacker to execute JavaScript in an authenticated user's browser by persuading them to visit a crafted URL. When Direct Selection is enabled, an attacker-controlled banner identifier can be included in HTML form fields without appropriate encoding. Direct Selection is disabled by default. The issue is fixed in Revive Adserver 6.0.9 by HTML-encoding banner identifier values in the invocation-option form fields.

CVE-2026-108565.description: A reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability in the popup invocation options of Revive Adserver 6.0.8 and earlier allows an unauthenticated attacker to execute JavaScript in an authenticated user's browser by persuading them to visit a crafted URL. The top, left, timeout and delay request parameters are included in HTML attributes without appropriate encoding. Exploitation requires an existing popup zone, which can be created through the administrator API but is not offered by the normal zone-creation interface. The issue is fixed in Revive Adserver 6.0.9 by HTML-encoding the affected popup option values.

CVE-2026-117373.description: Janus WebRTC Server 1.2.3 through 1.4.0 is vulnerable to Directory Traversal. The application accepts a caller supplied media path when an ondemand stream is created. The path is validated only by checking whether it contains one of the audio extensions and is then passed to the file source which opens it. No canonicalization is performed and no directory allowlist is enforced, so an unauthenticated caller can make the server open an arbitrary local file and use it as a media source, with the content delivered to viewers as RTP audio.

CVE-2026-61619.description: The OWASP core rule set (CRS) is a set of generic attack detection rules for use with compatible web application firewalls. Prior to versions 3.3.10, 4.25.1, and 4.28.0, regular-expression denial of service (ReDoS) affects a shared regex-assembly include used to build 12 Unix RCE detection rules in CRS v4, and the same ambiguous pattern was present in the manually-assembled regexes in 4 rules in CRS v3.3. With a single, unauthenticated, crafted request, the generated pattern drives PCRE2 past its backtracking limit. When PCRE2 exceeds that limit, the @rx operator returns an error rather than a match result, which results in detection bypass and CPU denial of service. This issue has been patched in versions 3.3.10, 4.25.1, and 4.28.0.
CVE-2026-61619.summary_ko: OWASP Core Rule Set의 정규표현식에서 발생하는 서비스 거부(ReDoS) 취약점입니다. 조작된 요청을 통해 PCRE2 엔진의 제한을 초과하게 함으로써 탐지를 우회하거나 CPU 자원 소모를 유발할 수 있습니다.

CVE-2026-62971.description: The OWASP core rule set (CRS) is a set of generic attack detection rules for use with compatible web application firewalls. Prior to versions 3.3.10, 4.25.1, and 4.28.0, CRS rules in the 921 (protocol-attack), 930 (LFI), 931 (RFI), 932 (RCE), 933 (PHP), 934 (generic), 941 (XSS), 942 (SQLi), and 943 (session-fixation) families inspect XML request bodies via the XPath expression XML:/*. That expression matches only element text nodes — it does not match XML attribute values. As a result, an attacker who places an attack payload inside an XML attribute (e.g. or ) bypasses CRS detection entirely. This is verified empirically against a local CRS test instance and against the public CRS sandbox. The bypass affects approximately 159 rules across 9 rule files and applies at every paranoia level (PL1 through PL4), since the variable list is more or less shared across PLs. The 944 (Java) family is the only one that correctly includes XML://@* in addition to XML:/* and is therefore unaffected. This issue has been patched in versions 3.3.10, 4.25.1, and 4.28.0.
CVE-2026-62971.summary_ko: OWASP 코어 룰셋(CRS)의 XML 검사 방식 결함입니다. XPath 표현식이 XML 속성값을 검사하지 않아 공격자가 속성에 페이로드를 삽입하여 보안 검사를 우회할 수 있습니다.

CVE-2026-64858.description: vulnerability-operator scans SBOMs and Images for vulnerabilities. Prior to version 0.28.16, an unauthenticated information-disclosure vulnerability exposes all vulnerability scan reports served by the operator. The /report/ HTTP endpoint mounts a raw http.FileServer over the reports directory (default /reports) with no authentication, authorization, or middleware. Any client that can reach the operator's HTTP port (default 8080) can list and download every JSON vulnerability report, disclosing CVE IDs, affected package names/versions, and container image identifiers for every workload scanned in the cluster. This issue has been patched in version 0.28.16.

CVE-2026-65820.description: aeon is a scikit-learn compatible Python library for learning from time series. Prior to version 1.5.0, a GitHub Actions workflow used pull_request_target for pre-commit checks on pull requests from forks. In this configuration, fork-controlled code could be checked out and executed in a privileged context. The vulnerable workflow also generated/used elevated credentials and could automatically commit or push fixes back to pull request branches. This created a potential token exposure and repository write path if an attacker submitted a malicious fork pull request designed to execute during the privileged workflow run. This issue has been patched in version 1.5.0.

CVE-2026-68485.description: An authorization bypass in website-index.php in Revive Adserver 6.0.8 and earlier allows an authenticated manager restricted to one agency to view another agency's website listing by changing the agencyid request parameter. Disclosed information includes website names, identifiers and timestamps. Detailed website pages continue to enforce ownership checks. The issue is fixed in Revive Adserver 6.0.9 by obtaining the agency identifier from the authenticated account rather than the request.

CVE-2026-68486.description: An authorization bypass in campaign-zone linking in Revive Adserver 6.0.8 and earlier allows an authenticated manager, or a trafficker with zone-linking permissions, to associate another agency's campaign with their own zone. Campaign ownership checks are missing from the bulk-linking and single-link operations in zone-include.php and the XML-RPC campaign-linking method. Although agency filtering prevents foreign banners from being linked, the unauthorized association can expose the foreign campaign's name, type and identifier in the linked-campaign listing. The issue is fixed in Revive Adserver 6.0.9 by validating campaign ownership in the affected operations.

CVE-2026-68862.description: Dell Terraform Provider for Dell PowerFlex contain(s) an OS Command Injection Vulnerability in the SDC host provisioning component. A high privileged remote attacker with access to the PowerFlex management plane could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to the execution of arbitrary OS commands on provisioned SDC hosts. Exploitation may lead to full compromise of affected SDC hosts.

CVE-2026-77168.description: A cross-site request forgery vulnerability in tracker-invocation.php in Revive Adserver 6.0.8 and earlier allows an attacker to modify a tracker's name, description or advertiser assignment using an authenticated victim's permissions. A leftover state-changing handler accepts request parameters without verifying a CSRF token, although it is not used by the normal invocation-tag interface. Exploitation requires victim interaction and a request path that carries the victim's session credentials. The issue is fixed in Revive Adserver 6.0.9 by removing the unused tracker-modification handler.

CVE-2026-82978.description: An authorization bypass in channel-edit.php in Revive Adserver 6.0.8 and earlier allows an authenticated manager to create a delivery rule set belonging to another agency by changing the submitted agencyid parameter. The server trusts the submitted agency identifier when inserting the new rule set, allowing unauthorized creation of objects in another agency's account. The issue is fixed in Revive Adserver 6.0.9 by obtaining the agency identifier from the authenticated account rather than submitted form data and removing the agency identifier from the form's hidden fields.

CVE-2026-86363.description: Dell Live Optics Collector, versions prior to 27.3.13.330 contains a Generation of Predictable IV with CBC Mode vulnerability. A low privileged attacker with local access could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to Information exposure.

CVE-2026-86364.description: Dell Live Optics Collector, versions prior to 27.3.8.317 contains a Use of Insufficiently Random Values vulnerability. A low privileged attacker with local access could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to Information exposure.

CVE-2026-91870.description: Dell Ansible Storage for PowerFlex, versions prior to 3.2.0, contains an Improper Certificate Validation vulnerability in the API client component. An unauthenticated attacker with remote access could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to information exposure and unauthorized access.
CVE-2026-91870.summary_ko: Dell Ansible Storage for PowerFlex 3.2.0 이전 버전의 API 클라이언트 구성 요소에 부적절한 인증서 검증 취약점이 존재합니다. 인증되지 않은 원격 공격자가 이를 악용해 정보 노출이나 비인가 접근을 시도할 수 있습니다.

CVE-2026-91871.description: Dell Ansible Storage for PowerStore, versions prior to 3.9.0, contains an Improper Certificate Validation vulnerability in the API client component. An unauthenticated attacker with remote access could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to information exposure and unauthorized access.

CVE-2026-91872.description: Dell Ansible Storage for PowerStore, versions prior to 3.9.0,contains an Insertion of Sensitive Information into Log File vulnerability in the configuration module. A low privileged attacker with local access could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to information exposure.

CVE-2026-91879.description: Dell Terraform for ObjectScale and Powerstore, versions prior to 1.1.1 (ObjectScale) and versions 1.2.1 through 1.3.0 (PowerStore) contains an insertion of sensitive information into Log File vulnerability in the client initialization component. A low privileged attacker with remote access could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to information exposure and unauthorized access.

CVE-2026-91890.description: Dell Ansible Storage for Unity , versions prior to 1.2.13 contains an Improper Certificate Validation vulnerability in the UnityRESTConnector component. An unauthenticated attacker with remote access could potentially exploit this vulnerability,leading to information exposure and unauthorized access.

CVE-2026-108472.description: A flaw was found in the xfs_admin utility in xfsprogs. The tool does not properly validate user-supplied parameters, allowing operating system command injection. A local attacker can exploit this issue by providing crafted input arguments, which may result in arbitrary command execution and local privilege escalation depending on how xfs_admin is executed.

CVE-2026-119055.description: CWE- 416: Use After Free vulnerability exists that could cause arbitrary code execution when a local attacker could trick the end user to open a specially crafted malicious SSD file.

CVE-2026-123747.description: A flaw was found in pappl-retrofit. The application fails to properly sanitize user-supplied filenames when handling the upload and deletion of PostScript Printer Description (PPD) files. A remote, unauthenticated attacker can exploit this directory traversal flaw by submitting filenames containing path traversal sequences. This allows the attacker to upload or delete arbitrary files on the system, which can result in data corruption, denial of service, or arbitrary command execution.

CVE-2026-123828.description: A one-byte heap buffer overflow in Node.js HTTP/2 Alt-Svc handling lets a remote, unauthenticated attacker corrupt process memory. When an application passes an attacker-controlled value such as a request's :authority header to Http2Session.altsvc(), the AltSvc implementation in src/node_http2.cc allocates a buffer sized to the origin length and then writes it with a null terminator, placing one byte past the end of the allocation. A single request carrying a long but syntactically valid :authority triggers the out-of-bounds write, which aborts the process and serves as a remote heap-corruption primitive. This vulnerability affects Node.js 26.x and 24.x.

CVE-2026-123829.description: A Permission Model bypass in Node.js recursive file watching discloses the names of files and directories the process is not permitted to read. On macOS and Windows, fs.watch() and fs.promises.watch() in recursive mode are backed by the native libuv watcher: FSEventWrap::Start checks kFileSystemRead only once, on the watched root, and FSEventWrap::OnEvent then forwards every filename libuv reports (relative paths at any depth) to the JavaScript callback without checking that each path is covered by the read grant. Code running under --permission with an exact read grant on a directory can therefore learn names such as sub/secret.txt even though readdir on that subdirectory is denied. The flaw exposes names and timing metadata, not file contents, and requires macOS or Windows plus files created under the watched directory by another actor. This vulnerability affects Node.js 26.x, 24.x, and 22.x.

CVE-2026-123862.description: An uncatchable exception in the Node.js zlib streaming API lets a peer crash a process by disconnecting while data is being compressed. zlib.params() queues a flush and completes its work in that write's callback; if the stream is destroyed first, as pipeline() does when the peer goes away, Writable still invokes the callback with an error, but the callback ignores its arguments and asserts that the native handle still exists. The handle is gone, so an ERR_INTERNAL_ASSERTION is thrown from inside stream internals and bypasses the stream's error event, the params() callback, and the pipeline() callback, terminating the process. An application is affected only if it calls deflate.params() while streaming to a peer, which is uncommon. This vulnerability affects Node.js 26.x, 24.x, and 22.x.

CVE-2026-123863.description: A reachable assertion in Node.js HTTP/2 session teardown lets any unauthenticated client abort the server, over both TLS and cleartext. A client can arrange for an Http2Stream that still holds nghttp2-allocated header buffers to outlive its session: the stream is removed from the session's stream set but never detached, so when ~Http2Session() runs the memory accounting is nonzero and the CHECK_EQ(current_nghttp2_memory_, 0) assertion fails, terminating the process. The trigger needs only a default http2 server whose handler responds before the request body has ended, which is typical. It is a variant of CVE-2024-27983 that the earlier fix did not cover, because that fix only detached streams still tracked in the session. This vulnerability affects Node.js 26.x (since 26.9.0) and 24.x (since 24.22.0).
CVE-2026-123863.summary_ko: Node.js HTTP/2 세션 종료 과정의 검증 취약점으로, 인증되지 않은 클라이언트가 서버 프로세스를 종료시킬 수 있습니다. Node.js 26.x와 24.x가 영향을 받습니다.

CVE-2026-123864.description: A re-entrancy flaw in Node.js HTTPS lets an unauthenticated client read memory belonging to other connections, including TLS private keys and other users' requests. TLSWrap::DoWrite() calls ClearOut() directly when asked to write zero bytes; if that write is issued from JavaScript running inside the HTTP parser's on_body callback, ClearOut() decrypts the next TLS record while the parser is still mid-body, re-entering llhttp_execute() and causing a use-after-free and an out-of-bounds heap read. The server then copies that freed or unrelated heap memory into the response for the request body. Triggering it requires a handler that calls res.flushHeaders() before the request body ends and later calls res.end() with a non-empty chunk, and reading the leaked memory requires any ordinary route that echoes or stores a request body. Cleartext node:http is not affected. This vulnerability affects Node.js 26.x, 24.x, and 22.x.
CVE-2026-123864.summary_ko: Node.js HTTPS 모듈의 재진입 결함으로 인한 메모리 유출 취약점입니다. TLS 비공개 키를 포함한 타인의 요청 데이터를 공격자가 읽을 수 있으며, 힙 메모리 손상이 발생합니다.

CVE-2026-123865.description: An unauthenticated HTTP/2 client can permanently leak Node.js server memory and file descriptors. If a peer triggers a protocol error, for example an oversized frame header, while the session is already shutting down, nghttp2 tears the session down internally but Node.js never notices, leaving a dangling session: the socket stays in CLOSE_WAIT and all of Node.js's HTTP/2 state for that connection is held in memory indefinitely, with no further cost to the attacker. The attacker can start the shutdown remotely by sending GOAWAY(NO_ERROR), so it is reliable against default HTTP/2 servers. It is an incomplete-fix case of CVE-2026-48937: that fix detected nghttp2 internal terminations by watching for GOAWAY sent while not shutting down, but missed terminations that arrive while the session is already shutting down. This vulnerability affects Node.js 26.x, 24.x, and 22.x.

CVE-2026-123866.description: A use-after-free in Node.js HTTP/2 stream teardown can leak response memory, including the contents of other connections' response buffers, to a peer. When a stream is torn down while a write is still backpressured, for example by a peer RST_STREAM or by the server's own per-stream timeout destroying the stream, the stream's response buffer is freed but a reference to it is still used, so freed or unrelated heap memory is written to the socket instead of the intended response. On Node.js 26.x and 24.x the teardown can be driven purely by a remote peer once the window-size change from 26.9.0 and 24.22.0 is present, and on all supported lines the same defect is reachable through an application-initiated teardown such as a per-stream idle timeout. This vulnerability affects Node.js 26.x, 24.x, and 22.x.
CVE-2026-123866.summary_ko: Node.js HTTP/2 스트림 종료 과정의 해제 후 사용 취약점으로, 의도한 응답 대신 다른 연결의 응답 버퍼를 포함한 메모리 내용이 상대방에게 노출될 수 있습니다. Node.js 26.x, 24.x, 22.x가 영향을 받습니다.

CVE-2026-123867.description: A per-host mutual-TLS authorization bypass in Node.js lets a client authorized for the default hostname reach a protected hostname it is not authorized for. When a TLS server assigns a hostname a different client-certificate CA with server.addContext(host, { ca: protectedCA }) but no server certificate in that SNI context, the per-host client CA is never installed and the handshake falls back to the default client CA. In src/crypto/crypto_tls.cc, CertCbDone installs the SNI context's CA only when setSniContext succeeds, but setSniContext returns false for a context with no server certificate, so a CA-only SNI context silently keeps the default CA. A client holding a certificate trusted by the default CA, but not the protected CA, can therefore complete mTLS to the protected hostname and read its response even with requestCert and rejectUnauthorized enabled, while a client certified by the protected CA is rejected. This vulnerability affects Node.js 26.x, 24.x, and 22.x.

CVE-2026-123868.description: An unauthenticated HTTP/2 client can exhaust Node.js server memory because inbound DATA queued on an undrained stream is charged to no session budget. Each inbound DATA frame creates one JavaScript Buffer view in the receiving stream's readable queue, but nothing charges that queue to current_session_memory_: the socket read buffer is accounted only during parsing and released immediately, so whatever stays queued is accounted to nothing. A peer that fills a stream's receive window with one-byte DATA frames pays about 10 wire bytes per frame while the server retains about 114 bytes per frame, so a single stream on one connection can retain hundreds of megabytes from tens of megabytes sent. maxSessionMemory neither bounds the growth nor refuses new streams, because Http2Session::CanAddStream gates admission on the same counter that never sees the queue. This vulnerability affects Node.js 26.x and 24.x.

CVE-2026-123871.description: Node.js discloses proxy credentials in ERR_PROXY_INVALID_CONFIG error messages. CVE-2026-48615 established that a proxy credential must not appear in a Node.js error message and redacted the username and password from ProxyConfig.href, but that fix missed four error paths in the same subsystem, one of them inside the same constructor, which interpolate the raw proxy URL, credentials included, into an ERR_PROXY_INVALID_CONFIG message. The proxy URL comes from the environment, but the defect is the sink: a secret that Node.js redacts everywhere else is emitted verbatim into a much wider audience than the process environment, such as stderr, container logs, log aggregation, and crash reporting services. This vulnerability affects Node.js 26.x, 24.x, and 22.x.

CVE-2026-123872.description: A client certificate authentication bypass in Node.js TLS lets a client change the servername during TLS 1.2 renegotiation to reach endpoints it was not authorized for. On a server that applies different client-certificate policies per hostname, for example stricter admin-only client-cert auth on one host and ordinary client-cert auth on another, a client that authenticates for a permitted host can renegotiate the TLS 1.2 connection under a different servername and carry its existing authentication to the protected host, bypassing the stricter policy. This vulnerability affects Node.js 26.x, 24.x, and 22.x.
CVE-2026-123872.summary_ko: Node.js 26.x, 24.x, 22.x의 TLS에서 클라이언트 인증서 인증 우회가 발생할 수 있다. TLS 1.2 재협상 중 서버 이름을 바꾸면 허용된 호스트의 기존 인증이 더 엄격한 정책의 보호 호스트에 적용될 수 있다.
CVE-2026-123872.background_ko: TLS 1.2 재협상 중 서버 이름을 변경해 기존 클라이언트 인증을 다른 호스트에 적용할 수 있는 것이 원인이다.

CVE-2026-123874.description: A use-after-free in Node.js HTTP/2 lets an unauthenticated client corrupt server memory, over both TLS and cleartext, when the server serves files with respondWithFile() or respondWithFD(). A client can make the server free an Http2Stream while a write request that points to it is still queued on the socket; when that write completes, the code dereferences and makes a virtual call through the freed object. The only precondition is that the application serves a file with stream.respondWithFile() or stream.respondWithFD(), with default settings otherwise. This vulnerability affects Node.js 26.x (since 26.9.0) and 24.x (since 24.22.0).

CVE-2026-123875.description: A NULL pointer dereference in Node.js HTTP/2 lets an unauthenticated client crash the server, over both TLS and cleartext, by cancelling file downloads. When the server serves a file with stream.respondWithFile() or stream.respondWithFD() and the client cancels the request, a StreamPipe used for the transfer is torn down in an order that leaves a NULL pointer which is then dereferenced, aborting the process. No crafted frames are needed, and a handful of cancelled requests against a default file-serving handler is enough. This vulnerability affects Node.js 26.x, 24.x, and 22.x.

CVE-2026-123877.description: A certificate validation bypass in Node.js https.Agent lets a cached TLS session authenticated under one CA policy be reused by a later request with a stricter policy. https.Agent.prototype.getName() assigns the same Agent and session-cache key to a request that omits ca and one that explicitly supplies ca: [], because an omitted value appends nothing to the key while an empty array stringifies to an empty string. The two policies differ: omitting ca uses the default trust store, while supplying ca replaces it. Since they share a key, a TLS session authenticated under the broader default policy is handed to a new connection made under the later ca: [] policy, and TLS 1.3 session resumption carries the earlier authentication forward, so the second request reports authorized === true and transmits confidential data to a server its own CA policy would reject on a fresh connection. This vulnerability affects Node.js 26.x, 24.x, and 22.x.

CVE-2026-126051.description: A deferred-callback use-after-destroy in Node.js TLS server handshake handling allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to terminate the server process. When a TLS server uses any of the SNICallback, OCSPRequest, newSession, or resumeSession hooks, or server.addContext(), the corresponding OpenSSL callbacks are deferred, and the deferred code does not handle the underlying socket being destroyed between scheduling and execution. By sending a client hello that reaches the vulnerable path (for example, no SNI together with an OCSP request) followed by padding and a socket FIN, an attacker makes OpenSSL deliver the client hello and the end-of-file in the same tick, so the socket is destroyed before the deferred callback runs and the process raises an uncaught exception instead of emitting an 'error' event. This vulnerability affects Node.js 26.x and 24.x.

CVE-2026-126766.description: OpsTree REMS through 1.0.0 contains an improper authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated users to set an incident's reporter to another user by supplying a client-controlled reporter field. Attackers can send crafted POST /api/v1/incidents or PATCH /api/v1/incidents/{id}/status requests to falsify incident attribution and corrupt the accountability audit trail.

CVE-2026-126767.description: OpsTree REMS through 1.0.0 contains a prompt injection vulnerability that allows authenticated users to disclose the hidden system prompt by submitting crafted chat input to POST /api/v1/rca/chat. Attackers can instruct the assistant to ignore its rules and reveal internal orchestration instructions, aiding the crafting of further prompt injection attacks.

CVE-2026-126768.description: OpsTree REMS through 1.0.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to obtain valid JWTs by setting the client-controlled is_local_auth field. Attackers can send a POST /api/v1/user/login/ request for the admin account with an invalid password and is_local_auth true to gain SuperUser administrative access.
CVE-2026-126768.summary_ko: OpsTree REMS의 인증 우회 취약점입니다. 클라이언트가 조작 가능한 필드를 통해 관리자 계정으로 로그인하여 슈퍼유저 권한을 획득할 수 있습니다.

CVE-2026-126769.description: OpsTree REMS through 1.0.0 contains a missing authentication vulnerability that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to access Governance API endpoints, including /api/v1/databases. Attackers can send requests without an Authorization header, or with invalid or tampered JWT tokens, to retrieve stored database hosts, usernames, and passwords.
CVE-2026-126769.summary_ko: OpsTree REMS 1.0.0 이하에서 인증 없이 Governance API에 접근해 저장된 데이터베이스 호스트, 사용자 이름, 암호를 조회할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-126769.background_ko: 인증 확인이 누락되어 인증되지 않은 요청도 Governance API에 접근할 수 있는 것이 원인이다.

CVE-2026-126770.description: OpsTree REMS through 1.0.0 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows authenticated users to make the backend connect to arbitrary destinations through the database Test Connection feature. Attackers can set a database entry's host and port to localhost, internal addresses, or attacker-controlled servers to probe internal hosts and ports reachable from the REMS server.

CVE-2026-126771.description: OpsTree REMS through 1.0.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated attackers to inject scripts by uploading attachments with spoofed text/html Content-Type. Attackers can upload HTML files named like test.html.pdf that render in the REMS origin via Preview, executing JavaScript in victims' browsers.

CVE-2026-126772.description: OpsTree REMS through 1.0.0 contains an improper attribution vulnerability that allows authenticated users to post comments as the incident creator via POST /api/v1/incidents/{incident_id}/comment. Lower-privileged attackers can comment on incidents owned by users such as a Super User to impersonate them and corrupt the incident timeline and audit trail.

CVE-2026-126774.description: @tinacms/mdx before 2.4.2 contains a code injection vulnerability in its MDX serializer, which writes rich-text values into MDX expressions without escaping them. Authenticated content editors can save crafted values that break out of list field or highlightColor expressions in the stored .mdx file, executing JavaScript in visitors' browsers or on build and server-side rendering hosts.
CVE-2026-126774.summary_ko: @tinacms/mdx 2.4.2 이전 버전은 MDX 직렬화 과정에서 입력값을 적절히 이스케이프 처리하지 않아 코드 삽입 취약점이 존재합니다. 인증된 사용자가 악성 콘텐츠를 저장하여 방문자 브라우저나 서버 측에서 임의의 자바스크립트를 실행할 수 있습니다.

CVE-2026-126775.description: Social-auth-core 4.7.0 before 7.0.0 contains a login cross-site request forgery vulnerability in the SAML backend that restores sessions named in the unsigned RelayState parameter. Attackers can deliver their own valid IdP response and RelayState to a victim's browser via an auto-submitting form, signing the victim into the attacker's account to capture entered data.

CVE-2026-126776.description: SiYuan 3.7.0 before 3.8.10 on Windows contains a path traversal vulnerability in kernel/util/webfetch.go that allows attackers to write files outside the import directory via backslash-encoded filenames. Attackers controlling a URL fetched by the MCP web_fetch or http_request tools can use %5C-encoded ..\ sequences to write chosen response bytes to directories above temp/import that are writable by the SiYuan user.

CVE-2026-126777.description: Traccar 3.15 before 6.17.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in LdapProvider.login() that fails to reject empty passwords, causing LDAP binds to be performed as unauthenticated binds when LDAP authentication is enabled. Unauthenticated attackers who know a valid username can log in via POST /api/session or HTTP Basic authentication with an empty password against directories that permit unauthenticated binds, obtaining sessions for any account including administrators.
CVE-2026-126777.summary_ko: Traccar의 LDAP 인증 처리 과정에서 발생하는 인증 우회 취약점입니다. 빈 암호를 허용하여 공격자가 사용자 이름만으로 관리자를 포함한 계정의 세션을 탈취할 수 있습니다.

CVE-2026-126778.description: Wallos 4.4.0 before 5.10.3 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in endpoints/cronjobs/sendnotifications.php that allows registered users to inject scripts via unescaped notification service responses. Attackers can point their Mattermost webhook URL or Web Push endpoint at a controlled server returning JavaScript, which executes in the administrator's session when sendnotifications.php is opened.

CVE-2026-126779.description: Spatie Browsershot 2.2.0 before 5.5.0 contains a local file read vulnerability that allows attackers to read server files by supplying root-relative references in HTML passed to setHtml(). Attackers can embed iframe, img, link or script elements referencing paths like /etc/passwd, which resolve to file:// URLs and render file contents into the returned PDF or screenshot.

CVE-2026-126780.description: Webmin through 2.670 contains a privilege escalation vulnerability in acl/save_group.cgi that allows delegated administrators to grant unauthorized modules by submitting arbitrary module lists in the mod parameter. Attackers with Webmin Users module access can create or edit groups holding modules like Command Shell and assign themselves membership to execute commands as root.
CVE-2026-126780.summary_ko: Webmin의 권한 상승 취약점입니다. 위임된 관리자가 모듈 목록을 임의로 수정하여 권한이 없는 모듈을 추가하거나 루트 권한으로 명령을 실행할 수 있습니다.

CVE-2026-126781.description: Webmin through 2.670 contains a users file injection vulnerability in acl/cert_issue.cgi that allows authenticated Webmin users to inject lines by supplying unvalidated certificate DN fields containing newlines. Attackers can end a DN field with a backslash and newline to add a second root entry with a known password hash, gaining Webmin root access after miniserv restarts.

CVE-2026-57500.description: REVA is an interoperability platform. Prior to versions 2.40.5 and 2.46.4, Reva exposes internal metadata folders in the spaces of an authenticated user. This can lead to unwanted ways of interaction with the data. This issue has been patched in versions 2.40.5 and 2.46.4.

CVE-2026-58505.description: geojson-vt is a JavaScript library for slicing GeoJSON data into vector tiles on the fly, primarily designed to enable rendering and interacting with large geospatial datasets on the browser side (without a server). Prior to version 6.1.1, @maplibre/geojson-vt contains an uncontrolled recursion vulnerability in its GeoJSON conversion logic. When a GeoJSONVT instance is constructed with a deeply nested GeometryCollection object, the mutually recursive functions featureToInternal and convertGeometryCollection in src/convert.ts exhaust the Node.js call stack, causing an unhandled RangeError: Maximum call stack size exceeded that terminates the process. Because the library is widely used in server-side tile services that accept GeoJSON over the network, a remote unauthenticated attacker can trigger a denial-of-service by sending a single crafted payload. No authentication is required, and no non-default library options are needed. This issue has been patched in version 6.1.1.

CVE-2026-61637.description: Icinga Web 2 is an open source monitoring web interface, framework and command-line interface. Prior to versions 2.12.7 and 2.13.1, an attacker can craft a URL that, once visited by an authenticated user (or one that is able to authenticate), allows to manipulate the backend to redirect the user to any location. For this to succeed, the victim's locale in Icinga Web must be different from en_US. This issue has been patched in versions 2.12.7 and 2.13.1.

CVE-2026-63505.description: Probo is a self-hostable governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) platform built for engineering and security teams. Prior to version 0.223.1, Probo's console GraphQL API is a multi-tenant GRC platform where all data is scoped to an organization. A Finding can reference a Risk via finding.riskId. That reference is stored without validating that the risk belongs to the caller's organization, and the Finding.risk field resolver authorizes the finding (caller's org) instead of the risk, then loads the risk with a tenant scope derived from the risk's own global ID. As a result, an authenticated member of organization A can attach an arbitrary organization B risk GID to a finding they own and then read organization B's Risk (name, description, treatment, category, severity, owner) — with no membership in B. The stored cross-tenant reference also blocks B from deleting its own risk (ON DELETE RESTRICT), a cross-tenant integrity/DoS. This issue has been patched in version 0.223.1.

CVE-2026-64861.description: Probo is a self-hostable governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) platform built for engineering and security teams. Prior to version 0.222.0, the GraphQL endpoint does not enforce restrictions on alias count, query depth, or query complexity. An attacker can send a single request containing thousands of aliased resolver calls, causing excessive server-side resource consumption and service degradation. This issue has been patched in version 0.222.0.

CVE-2026-65833.description: iopress is a native HTTP server for Node.js with platform-specific async I/O. Prior to version 1.0.5, the chunked-transfer-encoding HTTP request parser in @iopress/core reads past the end of the input buffer when a request declares a chunk size larger than the body actually received. This results in a heap-buffer-over-read. This issue has been patched in version 1.0.5.

CVE-2026-65840.description: Fider is a feedback portal for feature requests and suggestions. Prior to version 0.36.0, in multi-tenant mode (HOST_MODE=multi), an attacker can use an email verification key issued by Tenant A to authenticate as the same email address on Tenant B. This completely bypasses tenant isolation and allows unauthorized account takeover across tenants. Single-host deployments (HOST_MODE=single, the default) are NOT affected. This issue has been patched in version 0.36.0.

CVE-2026-65843.description: sync-rpc runs asynchronous commands synchronously by putting them in a separate proces. Prior to version 1.3.7, if an attacker could guess the correct port and it was not blocked via a firewall, it was possible to load and execute arbitrary JavaScript files stored on the server running sync-rpc. This issue has been patched in version 1.3.7.

CVE-2026-65967.description: Fider is a feedback portal for feature requests and suggestions. Prior to version 0.34.0, a Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) vulnerability exists in Fider due to insufficient validation of webhook URLs. The application allows user-controlled URLs to be fetched by the server without restricting access to internal or external network resources. This enables attackers with administrative privileges to make arbitrary HTTP requests from the server, potentially accessing internal services or cloud metadata endpoints. This issue has been patched in version 0.34.0.

CVE-2026-76078.description: Probo is a self-hostable governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) platform built for engineering and security teams. Prior to version 0.224.0, the public Trust Center GraphQL API exposes acceptElectronicSignature and recordSigningEvent, both gated only by @authentication(required: PRESENT) @sessionOnly — any self-provisioned trust center identity can call them. The underlying esign.Service.AcceptSignature and esign.Service.recordEvent build the tenant scope from the client-supplied signatureId GID (coredata.NewScopeFromObjectID(req.SignatureID)) and load the signature by that GID. At no point do they verify that the signature belongs to the caller or that the caller's email matches the signature's SignerEmail. As a result, any authenticated trust-center visitor who possesses another visitor's signature GID can: (1) complete that visitor's NDA signature — overwriting signer name/IP/UA with attacker data and setting status to Accepted, which triggers the sealing worker to generate a completion certificate; (2) inject arbitrary audit-trail events into any signature's log. Both attacks defeat the non-repudiation and integrity guarantees of the e-signature system. This issue has been patched in version 0.224.0.

CVE-2026-76079.description: Probo is a self-hostable governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) platform built for engineering and security teams. Prior to version 0.224.0, an organization ADMIN can mint an OWNER membership via createUser, bypassing the owner-only set-owner authorization gate. This issue has been patched in version 0.224.0.

CVE-2026-76080.description: Probo is a self-hostable governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) platform built for engineering and security teams. Prior to version 0.224.0, the public Trust Center GraphQL API exposes Query.node(id:) with @authentication(required: OPTIONAL) — an unauthenticated internet visitor to any published trust center can call it. Six of its type branches — Organization, Framework, Audit, ThirdParty (subprocessor), TrustCenter, and TrustCenterReference — resolve the object with a tenant scope derived from the client-supplied GID itself (coredata.NewScopeFromObjectID(id)) and load it with a bare Get(scope, id) that performs no comparison to the current trust center's OrganizationID and no showOnTrustCenter/visibility check. (The Document and File branches, by contrast, correctly pass trustCenter.OrganizationID and check visibility). This issue has been patched in version 0.224.0.

CVE-2026-91150.description: A flaw was found in Cockpit. This vulnerability allows a remote attacker, without prior authentication, to send specially crafted fragmented WebSocket messages. These messages accumulate without a total-size limit, leading to unbounded memory exhaustion and a denial of service in the `cockpit-ws` service.
CVE-2026-91150.summary_ko: Cockpit의 cockpit-ws 서비스에서 원격 공격자가 조작된 조각난 WebSocket 메시지를 전송할 수 있는 결함이 확인되었습니다. 이 메시지들이 무제한으로 쌓여 메모리 소진 및 서비스 거부 현상을 발생시킵니다.

CVE-2026-91873.description: Dell OpenManage Ansible Modules, versions 2.1.2 through 10.0.3, contains an Improper Certificate Validation vulnerability in the iDRACRedfishAPI component. An unauthenticated attacker with remote access could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to information exposure and unauthorized access.

CVE-2026-91874.description: Dell OpenManage Ansible Modules, versions 5.0.0 through 10.0.3, contains an Improper Certificate Validation vulnerability in the iDRACConnection component. An unauthenticated attacker with remote access could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to information exposure and unauthorized access.

CVE-2026-91875.description: Dell OpenManage Ansible Modules, versions 9.2.0 through 10.0.3, contains an Improper Certificate Validation vulnerability in the SessionAPI component. An unauthenticated attacker with remote access could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to information exposure and unauthorized access.

CVE-2026-91876.description: Dell OpenManage Ansible Modules, versions 2.0.4 through 10.0.3, contains an Improper Restriction of XML External Entity Reference vulnerability in the XML parsing component. A low privileged attacker with local access could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to information exposure.

CVE-2026-91877.description: Dell OpenManage Ansible Modules, versions 2.0.2 through 10.0.3, contains an Improper Neutralization of Special Elements in Data Query Logic vulnerability in the OData filter processing component. A low privileged attacker with remote access could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to unauthorized data access, authorization bypass, and denial of service.

CVE-2026-91878.description: Dell OpenManage Ansible Modules, versions 6.0.0 through 10.0.3, contains an Improper Neutralization of Special Elements in Output Used by a Downstream Component ('Injection') vulnerability in the XML data conversion component. A low privileged attacker with remote access could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to XML injection, malicious content injection, and XML parsing errors

CVE-2026-91880.description: Dell Terraform Provider for PowerFlex, versions 1.5.0 through 1.8.0, contains an Improper Certificate Validation vulnerability in the SSH client component.Terraform PowerFlex provider uses ssh.InsecureIgnoreHostKey() as the default SSH host key callback. An unauthenticated attacker with remote access could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to information exposure and unauthorized access.

CVE-2026-91891.description: Dell Terraform Provider for PowerStore, versions prior to 1.3.1 , contains a vulnerability that may cause sensitive authentication data to be insufficiently redacted in diagnostic logs. An unauthenticated attacker with remote access could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to information exposure.

CVE-2026-91892.description: Dell Terraform Provider for PowerFlex, versions prior to 1.9.0, contains a vulnerability that may permit the use of deprecated cryptographic protocols during secure communications. An unauthenticated attacker with remote access could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to information exposure.

CVE-2026-0323.description: A server-side request forgery vulnerability in Palo Alto Networks Checkov by Prisma® Cloud enables a local unauthenticated user to make unauthorized network requests from host to internal services.

CVE-2026-0324.description: An incorrect privilege management vulnerability in the OPSWAT MetaDefender Endpoint Security SDK used by the Palo Alto Networks GlobalProtect™ app on Windows devices allows a locally authenticated non-administrative Windows user to escalate their privileges to NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM.

CVE-2026-0325.description: An authorization bypass vulnerability in the GlobalProtect gateway of Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS® software enables an authenticated attacker with valid GlobalProtect credentials to bypass IP address restrictions and circumvent network access controls that rely on source IP filtering. Cloud NGFW is not affected by this vulnerability.

CVE-2026-0326.description: A buffer overflow vulnerability in Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS software enables an unauthenticated attacker to disrupt service processing by causing a service process crash or memory corruption. Panorama and Prisma® Access are not affected by this vulnerability.

CVE-2026-0327.description: A privilege escalation vulnerability in the GlobalProtect gateway of Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS® software enables an authenticated, lower-privileged user to obtain the privileges and configuration of a higher-privileged user. Cloud NGFW and Panorama are not affected by this vulnerability.

CVE-2026-0328.description: Authentication bypass vulnerabilities in the GlobalProtect™ portal and gateway of Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS® software enables an unauthenticated user to bypass security restrictions and establish an unauthorized VPN connection. Panorama, Cloud NGFW, and Prisma® Access are not affected by this vulnerability.

CVE-2026-0329.description: A buffer overflow vulnerability in Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS® software enables an unauthenticated attacker with network access to cause a denial of service (DoS) condition by sending specially crafted network traffic to or through a dataplane interface. Cloud NGFW and Panorama are not affected by this vulnerability.

CVE-2026-0330.description: A remote code execution (RCE) vulnerability in Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS® software on Panorama enables an authenticated administrator with network access to execute arbitrary code with root privileges. The security risk posed by this issue is significantly minimized by restricting access to the management interface to only trusted internal IP addresses according to our recommended best practice deployment guidelines https://live.paloaltonetworks.com/t5/community-blogs/tips-amp-tricks-how-to-secure-the-management-access-of-your-palo/ba-p/464431 . Cloud NGFW, Prisma® Access, and standalone PAN-OS firewalls are not affected by this vulnerability.

CVE-2026-0331.description: An information disclosure vulnerability in Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS® software enables an unauthenticated remote attacker with network access to obtain sensitive firewall and session information by sending traffic to or through a dataplane interface. Panorama is not affected by this vulnerability.

CVE-2026-122095.description: AsiaInfo BSS Platform 9.2 before 9.2.38 has a stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability in the menu icon upload function. An authenticated user with ordinary application privileges can upload an SVG file containing embedded JavaScript, which is served from the application origin. Normal menu rendering uses an HTML element and does not execute the SVG script; exploitation requires a victim to load the uploaded SVG as a document (by directly navigating to its URL, or via

CVE-2026-126784.description: Missing rate limiting, per-account submission quota and geographic validation in the publicar_aviso RPC function in Lagarto Chivato 0.4.1 and earlier on Web allows remote authenticated attackers to flood the moderation queue via unlimited submission of notices with arbitrary coordinates.

CVE-2026-126815.description: Pre-account hijacking in the authentication flow in Lagarto Chivato 0.4.1 and earlier on Web allows remote unauthenticated attackers to take over arbitrary accounts via a password planted on an unregistered email address that becomes valid upon the victim’s first passwordless login.

CVE-2026-91151.description: A flaw was found in Cockpit. A local authenticated user with control over a target account's home directory can exploit a privileged symlink dereference vulnerability in the `ssh-add-public-key.sh` helper. When this helper runs with elevated privileges, it can be tricked into following attacker-controlled symlinks within the `.ssh` or `authorized_keys` paths. This allows the attacker to arbitrarily change file ownership and modes, potentially leading to local privilege escalation and impacting the integrity, confidentiality, and availability of the system.

CVE-2026-100307.description: Missing authorization in the external management API in Amazon mcp-gateway-registry 1.0.9 through 1.24.7 might allow an authenticated remote user to assign the registry administrator scope to their own identity group and obtain administrative control of every registered gateway asset via a crafted group import request. To remediate this issue, users should upgrade to version 1.25.0.
CVE-2026-100307.summary_ko: Amazon mcp-gateway-registry 1.0.9~1.24.7의 외부 관리 API에 권한 확인 누락 취약점이 있어, 인증된 원격 사용자가 자신의 그룹에 레지스트리 관리자 권한을 부여하고 등록된 모든 게이트웨이 자산을 관리할 수 있습니다. 설명에 따르면 1.25.0으로 업그레이드해 조치할 수 있습니다.

CVE-2026-103980.description: ideon is a self-hosted visual workspace. Prior to version 0.9.6, the SSRF protection in safeFetch is bypassed by IPv6 transition addresses that embed private IPv4 addresses. The isPrivateIP function in src/app/lib/ssrf.ts checks only a narrow set of IPv6 ranges (loopback ::1, ULA fc/fd, link-local fe80) but does not recognize IPv4-mapped (::ffff:), NAT64 well-known (64:ff9b::/96, RFC 6052), NAT64 local-use (64:ff9b:1::/48, RFC 8215), 6to4 (2002::/16, RFC 3056), or Teredo (2001::/32, RFC 4380) encodings. An authenticated user can supply these addresses in link URLs to reach cloud metadata endpoints (169.254.169.254), localhost services, and RFC 1918 internal networks through the link preview metadata fetcher. This issue has been patched in version 0.9.6.

CVE-2026-125926.description: Server-side request forgery (SSRF) in the server registration and update API in Amazon mcp-gateway-registry before 1.35.0 might allow an authenticated remote user to send requests from the gateway to internal network services and cloud instance metadata endpoints and read the responses via a crafted request. To remediate this issue, users should upgrade to version 1.35.0.

CVE-2026-126797.description: NextScan 1.1.0 through 1.2.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in ns-admin that allows unauthenticated attackers to forge administrator tokens using a hardcoded JWT signing key. Attackers can sign an HS256 X-Access-Token carrying the public super administrator role ID to gain full access to user management, scan tasks and stored vulnerability results.
CVE-2026-126797.summary_ko: NextScan의 ns-admin 구성 요소에서 하드코딩된 JWT 서명 키를 사용하는 인증 우회 취약점입니다. 공격자는 조작된 관리자 토큰을 생성하여 사용자 관리, 스캔 작업 및 저장된 취약점 결과에 대해 완전한 접근 권한을 얻을 수 있습니다.

CVE-2026-126798.description: NextScan 1.1.0 through 1.2.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in the ns-admin URL asset detail dialog that renders crawled form request bodies (Asset_URL.data) via innerHTML without encoding. Attackers can host crafted forms on crawled sites to store JavaScript that executes when users view asset details, stealing localStorage access tokens to hijack sessions, including administrators.

CVE-2026-126799.description: Gotenberg 8.31.0 before 8.38.0 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in IsPublicIP() that allows unauthenticated attackers to bypass private-IP deny-list protections using IPv6 zone identifiers.
